izzyondroid:com.signalsense.app.description:
Frustrated by silent drops from 5G to 4G? SignalSense alerts you the instant your network changes – giving you the power to pause downloads, save your data, and avoid unexpected charges.
 SignalSense continuously monitors your mobile network and notifies you whenever your connection switches between 5G, 4G, 3G, or 2G – helping you identify network issues before they affect calls, streaming, gaming, or downloads.
 FEATURES
 Instant Alerts
Get notified the moment your network drops from 5G to 4G, or 4G to 3G. Stop wondering why your video buffered – know exactly why.
 5G SA and NSA Detection
Accurately distinguishes between 5G Standalone (SA) and Non-Standalone (NSA) connections – not just "5G".
 Custom Ringtones & Vibration Control
Choose your own custom ringtone and control vibration settings for network alerts.
 Live Speed and Ping
See real-time download and upload speeds in the persistent notification, and live ping on the home screen.
 Call-Aware Alerts
Alerts are automatically held during active phone calls and fired after the call ends. No interruptions at the wrong moment.
 Anti-Spam Debouncing
Rapid signal fluctuations are detected and grouped into a single "unstable signal" alert instead of spamming your notification shade.
 Switch History Log
Every network change is logged with a timestamp and network speed. Review your full connection history at any time.
 Fully Customizable Alerts
Choose exactly which transitions alert you: Network Upgrade
 Network Downgrade
 Mobile Data Lost / Restored
 Any Network Change
 Smart Auto-Start / Auto-Stop
Monitoring can automatically start when mobile data turns on and stop when it turns off – completely hands-free.
 Boot Auto-Start
Optionally start monitoring automatically every time your phone boots.
 Dual SIM Support
Choose which SIM slot to monitor or use Auto mode to always follow your active data SIM.
Switches instantly when you change your default data SIM.
 Battery-Friendly
Uses a lightweight foreground service with minimal battery impact. Built for all-day use.
 No ads. No tracking. No data collected. 100% private and open source.

izzyondroid:com.starapps.tools.tnefextra.name: TNEF Extractor
izzyondroid:com.starapps.tools.tnefextra.summary: Get the real files out of the pesky winmail.dat
izzyondroid:com.starapps.tools.tnefextra.description:
Got a mail from some MS Outlook user which has a strange attachment going by the file name „winmail.dat” – and no idea what to do with that? Well, you’re not alone. What’s behind that is MS’ TNEF format, full name „Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format”, which no other software (but Outlook and Exchange) uses. And especially your Android device knows nothing about.
 So this app comes to your rescue: whenever you open a „winmail.dat” attachment from a mail in e.g. K-9 Mail, ''TNEF Extractor'' jumps in, looks what’s inside, asks you where to extract it to – and even offers you to open the enclosed file. So if that was e.g. a PDF file, and you have a PDF viewer app like MuPDF installed on your device, the file is opened with just two taps. Easy going, finally!
 PS: Don't wonder that there won’t be an app icon in your drawer. ''TNEF Extractor'' doesn’t need one, and neither do you. There’s nothing to configure – the app just pops up when needed.
 How got it started? Check out on Mastodon . I (Izzy) called for help – and just a week later, Fabio had it ready. Amazing!

fdroid:com.georgernstgraf.polishedrecogn.name: Polished Recognition
fdroid:com.georgernstgraf.polishedrecogn.summary: Voice input for any keyboard — transcribe with your own API endpoints
fdroid:com.georgernstgraf.polishedrecogn.description:
Polished Recognition is a voice keyboard powered by your own AI. Switch to it, speak, and polished text lands in whatever app you are typing in — transcribed by the speech provider you choose, refined by the language model you choose, with a prompt you write.
Switch to the Polished keyboard and recording starts instantly. Pause and resume mid-sentence, switch to your typing keyboard and back without losing dictation, then tap send: audio goes to your STT provider, the LLM polishes the text — fixing filler words and punctuation, restructuring, or translating to another language — and flawless text is typed into the field. Raw mode skips the LLM entirely and inserts the plain transcription; Polish only refines without translating.
 Bring your own provider. 19 presets (OpenAI, GROQ, OpenRouter, Cortecs, Google AI, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, local Ollama/LM Studio, …) or any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. GROQ's free tier covers a complete STT-plus-polish pipeline at zero cost. The system prompt is fully editable, with variables for source and target language; searchable model pickers with per-provider caching handle hundreds of models.
 Gboard will never use this. Gboard's microphone is hardcoded to Google's voice typing and cannot be redirected to any third-party voice input. Use a keyboard that delegates its mic: the AOSP keyboard (LineageOS and derivatives), HeliBoard (F-Droid only), Fossify Keyboard, or OpenBoard.
 Privacy-first: No analytics, no tracking, no proprietary SDKs, no account, no central server. All data flows directly between your device and your chosen endpoints — or nowhere at all, if you run Ollama locally.
Permissions:
• RECORD_AUDIO — required to capture microphone input
• INTERNET — required to send audio to your configured STT/LLM endpoints

fdroid:com.olaf.rereminder.name: reReminder
fdroid:com.olaf.rereminder.summary: Open-source recurring reminders, many timers, own schedules, no tracking.
fdroid:com.olaf.rereminder.description:
reReminder keeps you in the loop. Set up as many recurring reminders as you need — a nudge to correct your posture, a break every hour, water, medication, a Pomodoro timer, and let each one run on its own schedule.
 Several reminders, side by side 
Run "Take a walk" every 50 minutes and "Sit or stand" every 20 minutes at the same time. Every reminder has its own interval, name, message and color, and counts down independently, changing one never disturbs the others. One master switch pauses everything and shows you which reminder is up next.
 Reminders that fit your day 
Limit a reminder to certain weekdays and to a time window, for example Monday to Friday between 08:00 and 17:00. Windows may cross midnight for night shifts. Outside its window a reminder stays quiet and tells you when it starts again. Schedules are optional, a new reminder simply runs at any time.
 Notification text that writes itself 
Drop values into your message, and they are filled at the moment the reminder fires: the current time, the date, the weekday, the reminder's name, its interval, or when the next one is due. A live preview shows the result while you type.
 Made to actually fire 
reReminder uses exact alarms that survive Doze, reboots, app updates and timezone changes, and it arms the next alarm before it even shows the current one, so the loop cannot break. A reliability check in the settings tells you whether the system is holding your reminders back, and takes you straight to the setting that fixes it.
 Features: 
 Unlimited reminders: each with its own interval, from one minute to many hours.
 Schedules: pick weekdays and a daily time window per reminder.
 Dynamic text: insert time, date, weekday, name, interval or next due time.
 Text-to-Speech: have your reminder read aloud, in your device language.
 Personalized alerts: choose a notification sound or vibration pattern, and mute either one per reminder.
 Master switch: pause everything at once without losing your setup.
 Material 3 design: dynamic colors on Android 12+, full dark mode.
 English and German , with per-app language support.
 Private by design: no ads, no tracking, no accounts, no network access. Everything stays on your device. reReminder is free and open source.
🇪🇺 Made with passion in Europe.

fdroid:io.github.kennethchoinfosec.haven.summary: Isolate and run multiple instances of apps using Work Profiles
fdroid:io.github.kennethchoinfosec.haven.description:
Haven is a Free and Open-Source app that leverages the "Work Profile" feature of Android to provide an isolated space that you can install or clone apps into.
Haven uses the application id io.github.kennethchoinfosec.haven, so it installs as a separate app and does not upgrade or replace existing installs of the original app.
The main use-cases of Haven include:
- Installing apps inside a work profile for isolation
- "Freeze" apps inside the work profile to prevent them from running or being woken up when you are not actively using them
- Installing two copies of the same app on the same device
Note that Haven depends on the Work Profile feature of the Android system, so any bugs related to Work Profiles in the Android-derived system you are using will affect Haven. In addition, Haven can only be as secure as the Work Profile implementation.

fdroid:net.tigr.navyfleetbattle.name: Navy Fleet Battle
fdroid:net.tigr.navyfleetbattle.summary: The classic Russian sea battle game, for one player or two
fdroid:net.tigr.navyfleetbattle.description:
Navy Fleet Battle is an Android version of Морской бой, the sea battle game played on squared paper across Russia for generations. It follows the classic Russian rules exactly, with no variants and nothing to configure.
Two ways to play:
- Against the computer
- Two players, passing one device between them
The rules:
- A field of 10 by 10 cells, ten ships, twenty cells of fleet
- Ships stand in straight lines and may not touch each other, not even at the corners
- A hit earns another shot, and the turn passes only on a miss
- Sinking a ship marks the water around it automatically, because no ship can stand there
Made to be handed to a child:
- Large boards and touch targets a small finger cannot miss
- Every shot is aimed first and fired second, so a stray tap costs nothing
- The outcome of a shot is revealed by its animation and never before it, on both sides of the board
- A sinking plays as two beats: the hit lands first, then the hull goes down
- The end of a game is shown as a picture as well as in words, so a child who cannot yet read still knows who won
- A hand-off screen between turns leads with a large player number, so the device changes hands without anyone reading anything
- Sound throughout, with a mute button on every screen that remembers its setting
Russian and English, changed with a button in the corner at any moment, including in the middle of a battle. The board is lettered in the alphabet of the language in use: А Б В Г Д Е Ж З И К in Russian, A to J in English.
Navy Fleet Battle is free and open source under the MIT licence. Every sound in it is a public domain recording. There are no adverts, no trackers, no accounts and no network access of any kind, and the app asks nothing of the system: no storage, no location, no camera, no microphone.

apple-macos:1642185952.name: Caffeine Utility
apple-macos:1642185952.description:
Whether you’re reading a long article, downloading a large file, listening to music, watching a video, or maybe even rendering a video—sometimes you want your Mac to not display the screensaver or go to sleep. Caffeine offers you exactly that—and not much else.
No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No user tracking. No “analytics,” “telemetry,” “data collection,” “product improvement”—or any other euphemism for surveillance. Just a tiny, single-purpose utility that runs locally, on your hardware. You buy it once—you own it.
Caffeine inherits the open-sourced code from the well-known 2000s-era application but adds the modern security and performance on top of it. Today’s Caffeine is written in Swift—the fast, safe, and modern programming language—and is fully optimized for both Intel and Apple silicon (M-series) chips. It features support for the Dark Mode, high-resolution Retina displays, App Sandbox, Hardened Runtime, and more—all while retaining the same low resource footprint: Caffeine takes about 8 MB on the disk and uses under 20 MB of RAM in total (that’s less than an empty browser tab). It’s hard to believe such a tiny app can be improved that much. Download, launch, and enjoy!

apple-macos:6765947055.name: Voyager – Travel Planner
apple-macos:6765947055.description:
Voyager is a visual trip planner for organizing complex travel.
Flights, hotels, Airbnbs, trains, rental cars, tours, and reservations often end up scattered across emails, PDFs, apps, and booking websites. Voyager brings them together into one clear itinerary, so you can see where you’ll be, when you’ll be there, and what still needs attention.
Build trips with stays, travel, activities, and open time. Voyager lays everything out in a timeline, making it easier to spot gaps, pending bookings, and days that still need planning.
Paste booking confirmations and Voyager can help turn them into structured trip details using Apple Intelligence. It’s fast, private, and processed on device — no forwarding emails, no uploading confirmations, and no giving another service access to your inbox.
Voyager is especially useful for multi-stop trips, longer vacations, and travel where dates matter. See your booked stays, planned transportation, and scheduled activities in one place. Check how complete your trip is, identify unplanned time, and keep the whole plan organized from start to finish.
Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway or a 25-day trip across Europe, Voyager helps you keep the moving parts together.
Features include:
* Visual itinerary timeline
* Stays, travel, activities, and open time
* Trip planning percentage
* Pending and booked status tracking
* Gap detection for unplanned time
* Apple Intelligence-powered booking parsing
* Private copy-and-paste import
* Support for flights, trains, taxis, buses, ferries, rental cars, and more
* Mac, iPhone, and iPad support
Voyager helps turn scattered travel plans into one organized trip you can actually trust.

Curo Calculator is the ultimate tool for anyone needing to calculate loan, lease, and hire

 Key Features Include:
 Customizable Interface: Tailor the calculator's layout to suit your needs, whether for
 straightforward daily calculations or advanced financial scenarios.

 features like payment weighting, deferred settlements, and 0% interest calculations. With
 just 3 clicks or taps, navigate from simple to complex calculations effortlessly.
 User-Defined Templates: Save time on repetitive tasks with templates tailored to your
 frequent calculations.
 Day Count Conventions: Supports multiple conventions like 30/360, Actual/365,
 Actual/Actual, and the EU's APR for consumer credit, ensuring accuracy across various
 financial contexts.

 Actual/365, Actual/Actual, and the EU APR, US Appendix J APR, and Brazil CET APR for
 consumer credit, ensuring accurate calculations across different regulatory environments and
 markets.

 further analysis or record-keeping.
 Comprehensive Online Support: Access an extensive help website that explains all features,

 Curo library available on GitHub.

flathub:com.ktechpit.ultimate-media-down.description:
Ultimate Media Downloader is a fast and open source YouTube downloader for Linux and a video
 downloader for more than 1500 other websites. It saves videos, playlists, channels, live streams
 and music from YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), Reddit, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Twitch,
 Kick, Dailymotion, Rumble, Odysee, Bilibili, Bandcamp, Mixcloud, Pinterest, Tumblr, Streamable
 and the Internet Archive. Copy a link from Chrome, Firefox or any browser, paste it, pick a preset
 and download.
 Why choose Ultimate Media Downloader?
 YouTube video downloader: save videos as MP4, MKV or WEBM in any quality from 144p and 720p
 HD to 1080p Full HD, 4K and 8K, including 60 fps
 YouTube to MP3 converter, MP3 downloader and music downloader: download YouTube Music songs,
 albums and playlists, and extract audio as MP3 at 128 to 320 kbps, M4A, Opus or lossless FLAC
 with tags and cover art
 YouTube playlist downloader and channel downloader: list an entire playlist or channel in
 seconds and pick exactly the items you want
 YouTube Shorts, live streams and premieres: download Shorts, record a live stream while it
 runs and grab the VOD afterwards
 Batch downloader and download manager: queue many links, download them all at once, watch
 progress and open finished files from the download library
 Subtitles and closed captions: download or embed subtitles in the languages a video offers,
 including auto-generated captions, as SRT, VTT or ASS
 Sign-in required, private, members-only and age-restricted videos: log in once with your
 Google account in the built-in Chromium-based browser and download what your account can watch
 YouTube search built in: find videos and playlists inside the app and play them without ads
 Custom format selector: choose the exact resolution, codec, container and bitrate when a
 preset is not enough
 Dark theme, drag and drop, clipboard link detection and a download engine that updates itself
 so website changes are handled quickly
 More than a YouTube downloader
 Social video downloader: Facebook video downloader, Instagram Reels and video downloader,
 TikTok downloader, X (Twitter) video downloader, Reddit video downloader with audio, Pinterest
 and Tumblr
 Streaming and live: Twitch VOD and clip downloader, Kick, Dailymotion, Rumble, Odysee, Bilibili,
 Streamable and live stream recording
 Music and podcasts: SoundCloud downloader, Bandcamp, Mixcloud and podcast downloader, saved
 as MP3, M4A, Opus or FLAC
 Any page with a video: HLS (m3u8) and DASH streams, direct MP4 and MP3 links, embedded players
 on news sites, blogs, forums and the Internet Archive
 Built on yt-dlp. Ultimate Media Downloader is a graphical yt-dlp GUI and a friendly front end
 for the youtube-dl successor: every site, format and option yt-dlp supports is available from the
 interface, with no command line and no terminal. The yt-dlp engine updates itself inside the app,
 so a YouTube or TikTok change is fixed in hours, not at the next release.
 Works with the browser you already use. Copy a video link from Google Chrome, Chromium, Firefox,
 Brave or Edge and the app picks it up from the clipboard. The built-in Chromium-based browser lets
 you sign in to YouTube, Google, Twitch or Instagram once, so private, unlisted, subscriber-only
 and age-restricted videos download like any other link.
 Free, open source and offline: nothing is uploaded to a server, there are no ads, no watermarks
 added and no daily limits. A native YouTube desktop app, video downloader app and 4K video downloader
 for any Linux desktop (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, openSUSE and Steam Deck via Flatpak), and
 a free alternative to 4KTUBE, 4K Video Downloader, SnapTube, online video downloaders and YouTube
 to MP3 converter websites.

fedora-packages:ax25-tools/ax25-tools.summary: Tools used to configure an ax.25 enabled computer
fedora-packages:ax25-tools/ax25-tools.description: ax25-tools is a collection of tools that are used to configure an ax.25 enabled computer. They will configure interfaces and assign callsigns to ports as well as Net/ROM and ROSE configuration. This package only contains the command line programs; the GUI programs are contained in ax25-tools-x package. * m6pack - handle multiple 6pack TNCs on a single interface * ax25d - general purpose AX.25, NET/ROM and Rose daemon * axctl - configure/Kill running AX.25 connections * axparms - configure AX.25 interfaces * axspawn - allow automatic login to a Linux system * beacon - transmit periodic messages on an AX.25 port * bpqparms - configure BPQ ethernet devices * mheardd - display AX.25 calls recently heard * rxecho - transparently route AX.25 packets between ports * mheard - collect information about packet activity * dmascc_cfg - configure dmascc devices * sethdlc - get/set Linux HDLC packet radio modem driver port information * smmixer - get/set Linux soundcard packet radio modem driver mixer * kissattach - Attach a KISS or 6PACK interface * kissnetd - create a virtual network * kissparms - configure KISS TNCs * mkiss - attach multiple KISS interfaces * net2kiss - convert a network AX.25 driver to a KISS stream on a pty * netromd - send and receive NET/ROM routing messages * nodesave - saves NET/ROM routing information * nrattach - start a NET/ROM interface * nrparms - configure a NET/ROM interface * nrsdrv - KISS to NET/ROM serial converter * rsattach - start a ROSE interface * rsdwnlnk - user exit from the ROSE network * rsmemsiz - monitor the ROSE subsystem * rsusers.sh - monitor AX.25, NET/ROM and ROSE users * rsparms - configure a ROSE interface * rsuplnk - User entry into the ROSE network * rip98d - RIP98 routing daemon * ttylinkd - TTYlink daemon for AX.25, NET/ROM, ROSE and IP * ax25_call - Make an AX.25 connection * netrom_call - Make a NET/ROM connection * rose_call - Make a ROSE connection * tcp_call - Make a TCP connection * yamcfg - configure a YAM interface

It adds some new duration types, and new time_point types. It also adds "field" types such as year_month_day which is a struct {year, month, day}. And it provides convenient means to convert between the "field" types and the time_point types. - "tz.h" / "tz.cpp" are a timezone library built on top of the "date.h" library. This timezone library is a complete parser of the IANA timezone database. It provides for an easy way to access all of the data in this database, using the types from "date.h" and <chrono>. The IANA database also includes data on leap seconds, and this library provides utilities to compute with that information as well. firefox-addons:3003948.name: A-Wholesale Scraper: Export Products, Suppliers
firefox-addons:3003948.summary: Alibaba Scraper: Extract Alibaba product details, supplier profiles & more. Export to CSV, JSON, XLSX effortlessly.
firefox-addons:3003948.description:
Extract product, supplier, and review data from Alibaba with this comprehensive browser extension. This tool captures information from search results, category pages, supplier stores, and individual product listings. All processing runs locally in your browser, and the built-in monitoring feature lets you track listing changes automatically.
Key Features
✓ Monitor product or supplier pages for changes with scheduled checks
✓ All scraping and exports run locally in your browser
✓ Export to CSV, Excel (XLSX), JSON, HTML Table, and Raw JSON
✓ Automatic pagination across multi-page search results
✓ Batch processing for scraping multiple URLs in sequence
✓ Customizable field selection and conditional formatting
✓ Supports both search result pages and supplier store pages
What Data You Can Extract
Products: Product ID, title, price, minimum order quantity, images, supplier name, review scores, shipping time, trade assurance status, and transaction level.
Product Details: Brand name, category, specifications, features, place of origin, model number, certification status, currency, and media counts.
Reviews: Review content, star ratings, timestamps, product quality score, supplier service score, shipping time score, user country, buyer level, and associated media.
Suppliers: Company name, profile URL, location, gold years, verified status, response rate, reorder rate, on-time delivery, online revenue, and main products.
Supplier Details: Business type, staff count, trading staff count, total floorspace, years in industry, operational address, identity verification, and assessment details.
Monitoring & Alerts
Use the Page Watcher add-on to track changes on any Alibaba page. Set conditions on specific fields, such as price changes or supplier rating updates, and receive instant notifications via webhook or ntfy.sh when your criteria are met.
Batch Processing
The Batch URL Opener add-on lets you queue multiple Alibaba URLs for sequential scraping. Add URLs manually or auto-collect them from a search results page, then batch-process and export all results in one operation.
Export Formats
CSV, Excel (XLSX), JSON, HTML Table, Raw JSON
Perfect For
This tool is ideal for sourcing professionals, market researchers, and procurement teams who need to compile and compare supplier data on Alibaba. It automates the collection of product specifications, pricing, and supplier credentials across multiple categories.
Supported Regions
This extension supports the global Alibaba.com domain, covering international suppliers and product listings across all regions.
Privacy & Security
All scraping and data exports are processed locally on your machine. General usage metrics are collected to improve the extension, but your scraped data is never sent to external servers.
Usage Notice
This extension provides tools for extracting publicly available data. Users are responsible for ensuring their use complies with applicable terms of service and local regulations. The developer provides the tool and is not liable for how it is used.
Technical Support
For assistance or questions, contact hello@nifty.codes.
Trademark
Alibaba is a registered trademark of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. This extension is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, authorized, maintained, or sponsored by Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.

firefox-addons:3024286.name: Live Subtitle & Translator
firefox-addons:3024286.summary: Real-time audio captioning and translation for browser tabs using AI speech recognition and translation APIs.
firefox-addons:3024286.description:
Live Subtitle & Translator provides real-time speech-to-text captioning and instant translation directly in your browser. Whether you're watching videos, attending web conferences, or listening to audio on any website, this extension captures the audio and displays live subtitles in a floating, draggable overlay.
 Key Features: 
- Real-time Captioning — Captures tab audio and generates subtitles word-by-word using AI-powered speech recognition (STT), with smooth typing animation for natural readability.
- Live Translation — Translates recognized speech in real-time using streaming AI translation APIs, displaying results token-by-token alongside the original text.
- Separate STT & Translation Providers — Mix and match any combination of speech recognition and translation services. Use one provider for STT and a different one for translation.
- Multi-Provider Support — Works with OpenAI Whisper, Alibaba Cloud Paraformer, Zhipu GLM-ASR, Volcengine ASR, Tencent Cloud ASR, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, Qwen, Moonshot, Baichuan, MiniMax, SiliconFlow, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Smart Audio Capture — Automatically detects page media elements (video/audio) for zero-dialog capture. Falls back to microphone or screen sharing when needed.
- Pause-Aware Line Breaks — Detects natural speech pauses and starts a new subtitle line automatically, keeping the flow synchronized with the speaker.
- Customizable Appearance — Set font color and background color for both original and translated text independently. Supports transparent backgrounds with automatic text shadows for readability.
- Draggable Subtitle Overlay — Move the subtitle box anywhere on the page by dragging the handle.
- Bilingual UI — Switch between Chinese and English interface.
- Privacy First — All API keys are stored locally. Audio is processed only by your chosen provider. No data is collected by the extension itself. How to Use: 
1. Open the extension popup and go to API Settings.
2. Configure your speech recognition provider and API key.
3. Optionally configure a translation provider.
4. Toggle "Subtitle" on in the popup.
5. Click the start button in the subtitle overlay to begin capturing audio.
6. If prompted, select the current tab and check "Share audio" in the dialog.

- Интерфейс на русском и английском.
 Вход в Яндекс не обязателен. Обычная озвучка работает без входа. Вход через Яндекс (OAuth) нужен только для озвучки видео "живыми" голосами, которые ранее еще не были озвучены другими пользователями; выйти и удалить данные можно в настройках в один клик.
 Какие данные уходят наружу 
- Сервису перевода Яндекса: ссылка на видео, его заголовок и выбранные языки.
- В зависимости от региона или настроек запросы могут идти через открытые прокси-воркеры проекта VOT (сторонние серверы). OAuth-токен на них не отправляется.
- Раз в сутки расширение обращается к cloudflare-dns.com , чтобы определить страну и выбрать режим доступа. Cloudflare при этом видит ваш IP-адрес.
- Телеметрии, аналитики и сбора истории просмотров нет. Ничего не отправляется разработчику.
Подробности: политика конфиденциальности (ссылка ниже).
 Важно знать 
Это неофициальное расширение. Оно не связано с Яндексом, YouTube и Google и является независимой реализацией открытого протокола (проект VOT, лицензия MIT). Сервис перевода видео Яндекса не имеет публичной документации для сторонних разработчиков, поэтому работа расширения зависит от этого сервиса и может измениться или прекратиться в любой момент без предупреждения. 
Работает ТОЛЬКО на youtube.com .

firefox-addons:2943328.name: Tip Translator
firefox-addons:2943328.summary: Quick text translator: Hold Ctrl + select to instantly translate words/phrases/paragraphs in to your language, filling knowledge gaps without full-page changes.
firefox-addons:2943328.description:
Tip Translator: Instant Text Translation for Firefox
 Tip Translator is a lightweight Firefox add-on that lets you instantly translate selected words or phrases on any webpage. Perfect for users who know a language partially and want to fill in gaps for specific terms or phrases without translating entire pages. Just hold Ctrl, select text, and see the translation in a sleek dark-themed tooltip after 2 seconds!
Key Features
 🚀 Instant Translation with Ctrl+Hold : Select text, hold Ctrl for 2 seconds, and view translations in a tooltip (includes alternative translations for single words).
 🌐 Multi-Language Support : Auto-detects source languages (English, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech, Russian, Turkish, Korean, Japanese, China) and translates to Ukrainian, English, or others. Interface available in English, German, Ukrainian, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech—set in options.
 📚 Alternative Translations : Get multiple translation options for single words via MyMemory API.
 ⚡ Caching & Backup APIs : Fast repeat translations with in-memory caching; switches between LibreTranslate and MyMemory for reliability.
 ⌨️ Customizable Hotkeys : Set your preferred hotkey (default: Ctrl+Y) for instant translation without delay.
 🎯 Adaptive Tooltip : Dark-themed, auto-positioned tooltip with a 1000-character limit for quick performance.
Who Is It For?
 Students & Learners : Quickly translate unfamiliar terms while reading articles or books online, enhancing language learning without full-page changes.
 Travelers & Expats : Fill gaps in foreign texts (news, social media) to understand key phrases on the go.
 Professionals : Perfect for multilingual work—translate phrases in emails, chats, or documents seamlessly.
 Language Enthusiasts : Practice languages with on-demand translations as helpful hints.
 Privacy Note : Tip Translator collects no user data. It uses public APIs (LibreTranslate, MyMemory) for translations. Permissions: activeTab for page access, storage for settings, scripting for tooltip injection, and host permissions for APIs.
How to Use
 Highlight text on any webpage.
 Hold Ctrl (or use your custom hotkey) to see the translation in a tooltip.
 Adjust target language, interface language, and activation modes in the popup or options page.
Limitations
 Maximum text length: 1000 characters.
 Requires internet for API access.
 No translation to Russian (source language supported).
Support the Developer
Love Tip Translator? Support its development:
- ☕ Ko-fi 
- ₿ Crypto 
Acknowledgments
 LibreTranslate and MyMemory for free APIs.
 Mozilla for developer tools.
Make web reading effortless—install Tip Translator today! Share feedback in reviews. © 2025 Sviatoslav.

firefox-addons:645352.name: Text Contrast for Dark Themes
firefox-addons:645352.summary: Fixes low-contrast text when using a dark desktop theme.
firefox-addons:645352.description:
This extension is intended for Firefox users that have a light text/dark background system theme.
Users who don't want any native styling in their content should consider an alternate solution as detailed in the first few paragraphs here: https://github.com/DmitriK/darkContrast#text-contrast-for-dark-themes 
This extension can help users who wish to keep some dark-theme styling where possible.
The primary purpose of this extension is to fix input elements, which are drawn with a native dark style, but may have an explicit foreground or background color which assumes a light style, resulting in low contrast text. This extension checks if only one of the colors has been defined (foreground color, or background color/image), and defines the unset property as needed. Elements with both colors defined or both colors undefined remain unchanged.
The extension will also autodetect if the user has set inverted colors as their porimary colors (via use system colors option or manually setting light-on-dark colors). In this case the extension will also attempt to adjust all page colors.
(Note: Anyone considering leaving a review, please be aware that this extension will not work on addons.mozilla.org , so you will still have poor contrast on the input boxes. See https://github.com/DmitriK/darkContrast#amo-addonsmozillaorg for details. No, the irony is not lost on me, but there is nothing that I can do)

Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Metro Market app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Metro Market grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Fresh Perks Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track Metro Market Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Metro Market store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.metromarket.net/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.metromarket.net/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Metro Market app, you need a Metro Market digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Metro Market Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Metro Market's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.metromarket.net/i/terms/website-and-app.

bluejetty:00188422:android.name: American Van Driving Game
bluejetty:00188422:android.summary: Van Police Game – Van Driving is an immersive open-world simulation that transforms you into a daring police officer with a powerful van simulator at your command. In this exhilarating game, you navigate complex cityscapes, rural backroads,
bluejetty:00188422:android.description:
Van Police Game – Van Driving is an immersive open-world simulation that transforms you into a daring police officer with a powerful van simulator at your command. In this exhilarating game, you navigate complex cityscapes, rural backroads, and high-speed highways while responding to emergencies and maintaining law and order. Every van drive is a real-life adventure, as you experience realistic physics, challenging missions, and amazing weather conditions that shape each pursuit. The richly detailed environments and lifelike sound effects set a new standard in van police simulation gaming, drawing you into a world where split-second decisions have major consequences.
Step into the police van driver officer's shoes as you patrol busy urban centers and quiet countryside roads. Engage in intense chases with your police van, intercept speeding vehicles, and solve intricate cases that test your strategic skills and reflexes. With advanced van driving mechanics and various customizable vans, the game offers unparalleled depth and realism. From the glow of city neon lights at night to the serene hues of dawn in remote areas, the game’s graphics and lighting effects create an atmosphere that is both cinematic and captivating in the police van game.
The gameplay is designed to challenge both novice and experienced van driving simulator gamers with a range of difficulty levels that ramp up as you progress. Practice your van simulator driving skills on twisting roads, master emergency braking techniques, and execute high-stakes maneuvers during thrilling pursuits. Along with adrenaline-pumping chase sequences, the Van game introduces strategic elements like route planning and time management to ensure that every mission is unique and engaging. The authentic simulation of vehicle mechanics and dynamic traffic patterns offers a genuine sense of urgency and responsibility.
Moreover, Van Police Game – Van Driving innovates with its intuitive control system, making it accessible to players of all ages. Whether you are a van simulator enthusiast seeking a challenge or a casual gamer exploring a new virtual universe, the game provides an exceptionally balanced experience. Detailed tutorials and in-game tips guide you through complex maneuvers, ensuring that you get the most out of your time on the road. Every mission you undertake fosters a deeper connection with the life of a police officer, as you work to protect citizens and enforce the law with honor and precision.
From challenging pursuits to serene patrols, every moment in Van Police Game – Van Driving feels authentic and engaging. The developers continue to introduce exciting updates and new missions that expand the gaming universe, ensuring that the experience remains fresh and filled with new challenges. The rich storyline and meticulously crafted missions are designed to keep you engrossed for hours, building anticipation for what awaits around every corner of your expansive city. This van police game is crafted for players who are passionate about realistic van driving simulations and compelling law enforcement adventures.
Van Police Game - Van Driving Features:
- Immersive open-world environment with realistic graphics
- Advanced driving mechanics, customizable vans, and authentic vehicle physics. 
- Intense chase sequences, strategic mission planning, and responsive controls. 
- Detailed tutorials and in-game tips for an accessible yet challenging experience. 
- Realistic sound design that amplifies the excitement of high-speed chases and city patrols.
- Comprehensive police simulation experience that balances action with strategic gameplay.
- A richly detailed game environment that captures the essence of law enforcement and urban life.
This Game is developed by ESPtech.

bluejetty:00113652:ios.name: Farm Animal Games! Barnyard
bluejetty:00113652:ios.summary: Moooo your way into some fun with the Farm Animal Games Barnyard App! Developed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play this app educates along with having fun. Featuring flashc
bluejetty:00113652:ios.description:
Moooo your way into some fun with the Farm Animal Games Barnyard App! Developed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play this app educates along with having fun. Featuring flashcards of real animals your little ones will hear the name and the sound, then to add to the fun they can play the sound game and try to pick which animal makes what sound. Also included are some delight filled games like making the animals dance to and tap sounds where they can make the animals do tricks and change colors. It’s a barn load of fun for everyone!
Flashcards
Farm Animal Games Barnyard features 20 different flashcards with pictures of the real animal for your little farmers to learn about. They can tap on the picture to hear the sound the animal makes and they can tap on the word to hear what the animal is called. Have a mooo-riffic time learning about farm animals!
Sound Game
Now that your little ones have heard all the sounds and names of the animals they can test their knowledge in a cute and fun way- the sounds game! With 10 different games they can tap on the question mark and hear the sound and then choose which farm animal makes that sound. It’s engaging and fun!
Old McDonald Song
Of course every little farmer loves the Old McDonald song and when they tap on the barn on the main menu they will hear the song with vocals and see every animal the song makes reference to dancing along. It’s a great way to identify each animal as the song is playing, and is entertaining and fun!
Dancing Animals
Now that they have seen the animals dancing along to Old McDonald Had A Farm they can make the animals dance themselves by tapping on them. The really engaging part is the different music that plays with each animal includes the sound that animal makes! Little ones love to dance and the funky and fun music is sure to get them up and moving and dancing along. 
Tap Sounds
Another entertaining game is the tap sounds! Your little farmers can tap the animal and make it do tricks, like all the feathers appearing on a turkey, and a pig doing a flip. They will also see some of the animals change colors to further enhance the learning elements. This game will promote color recognition and is cute sweet fun!
Come to the farm and have a fun and musical time learning and playing with barnyard animals! A perfect app for first time users this engaging trip to the farm will get your little ones excited and knowledgeable about farm animals. Let their imagination and creativity blossom while they play and learn about barnyard animals!

bluejetty:00046729:ios.summary: Are you tired of the endless cycle of "What do you want to eat? I don't know, what do you want?" Fear not, because we're here to simplify your dining decisions and support your local community. The trend of dining locally is gaining momentu
bluejetty:00046729:ios.description:
Are you tired of the endless cycle of "What do you want to eat? I don't know, what do you want?" Fear not, because we're here to simplify your dining decisions and support your local community. The trend of dining locally is gaining momentum, and our mission is to help you reconnect with your community roots. We share your passion for food and take pleasure in discovering those hidden gems known only to locals. Whether you're at home or planning a trip, let us assist you in uncovering authentic local dining experiences. Just tell us what you're looking for, and we'll present you with a variety of options.
Our primary focus lies in bolstering small to mid-sized local eateries, deliberately avoiding involvement with large national chains. Through this approach, our aim is twofold: to fortify the foundation of the restaurant industry and to provide choices that directly contribute to the prosperity of your community.
Do you have a favorite local spot? You can easily save and share it on social media by creating a free account with us. Effortlessly showcase your preferred dishes through our add photo feature, crafting a captivating slideshow that highlights all the reasons why it's worth a visit. Furthermore, your account ensures you stay updated on the latest from your favorite places via emailed updates and push notifications. Should your preferred establishment not be featured, a simple click can prompt us to extend an invitation to them.
Stay abreast of local events and developments nationwide by subscribing to our newsletter via the app. Need help finding a restaurant's location? Navigate to the map section for a clear visualization of their whereabouts. Explore local dining options that match your preferences, and uncover nearby sponsoring restaurants offering a variety of cuisines. Delve into the last five reviews, operating hours, website links, and, for sponsored establishments, explore their unique offerings such as specials, accolades, and menus (if available). With over 50 customized keyword search options, we're sure to help you find what you're looking for. Each restaurant has its own captivating narrative, and we're here to help share it!

bluejetty:00177723:ios.summary: Welcome to Oxide: Survival Island, the ultimate multiplayer survival simulator that strands you on a brutal island where every moment tests your grit. With nothing but your instincts, can you craft, build, and thrive in this unforgiving ope
bluejetty:00177723:ios.description:
Welcome to Oxide: Survival Island, the ultimate multiplayer survival simulator that strands you on a brutal island where every moment tests your grit. With nothing but your instincts, can you craft, build, and thrive in this unforgiving open-world adventure? This mobile survival game delivers heart-pounding action and endless possibilities. Gather resources, team up with friends, and dominate the wild—your survival saga begins now!
A HARDCORE SURVIVAL EXPERIENCE
In Oxide: Survival Island, you’re dropped into a world of danger across three unique biomes—cold, temperate, and hot. Chop trees, mine rocks, and hunt predators to survive the elements. Craft tools, weapons, and shelters to fend off threats, from wild beasts to rival players. This isn’t just a survival simulator—it’s a relentless fight for dominance in a treacherous environment. Will you outlast the island’s perils?
MULTIPLAYER SURVIVAL UNLEASHED
Go it alone or squad up—Oxide: Survival Island brings multiplayer survival to life. Use the in-game friends system to team up seamlessly with your crew, building bases or raiding enemies together. Whether you’re scavenging solo or forging alliances, the multiplayer action keeps you hooked. Face off against other survivors, trade resources, or wage war—the island is yours to conquer!
CRAFT, BUILD, AND EXPLORE
Master your fate with a deep crafting system. From crude axes to sturdy defenses, every item you craft is a step toward survival supremacy. Build sprawling bases or hidden camps to claim your territory. Explore an expanded map packed with secrets, loot, and danger across diverse landscapes. Oxide: Survival Island fuses the best of survival simulators with open-world freedom—perfect for those craving a mobile survival challenge.
SURVIVE THE ISLAND’S WRATH
The island doesn’t mess around. Battle predators, scavenge for scraps, and outsmart hostile players in a world where survival is never guaranteed. Helicopters patrol the skies, adding an edge of unpredictability, while every biome—icy peaks to scorching plains—challenges your skills. This is more than a game; it’s a mobile survival epic that demands cunning and courage.
WHY PLAY OXIDE?
— Dynamic Biomes: Conquer cold, temperate, and hot zones.
— Friends System: Team up effortlessly with your squad.
— Intense Survival: Face the ultimate mobile survival test.
— Expanded Map: Roam a growing world full of surprises.
— Constant Updates: New events and anti-cheat fixes keep it fresh.
JOIN THE SURVIVAL ELITE
Oxide: Survival Island is your ticket to a next-level survival adventure. Download now and prove you’ve got the guts to rule the island. Craft your destiny, survive the odds, and etch your name as a legend in this epic mobile survival game!
================================

Monthly : $9.99
Weekly : $2.99
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Privacy policy: https://hyperhug.io/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://hyperhug.io/terms.html

### Safeguard Your Digital Environment
In today's interconnected world, maintaining the security of your network is more critical than ever. With advanced tools like Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scanning capabilities, you can analyze your network to identify unauthorized or unfamiliar devices. By regularly monitoring connected devices, you take an essential step in preserving your digital safety and ensuring a secure online environment.
### Unveiling the Unseen
Modern threats often involve concealed surveillance tools that are difficult to detect with the naked eye. Leveraging sophisticated features such as a Magnetic Detector and an IR Scanner, our app empowers you to identify hidden cameras and maintain your privacy. These cutting-edge technologies enable you to uncover potential risks and act proactively to protect your personal space.
### Staying One Step Ahead
Wherever you go, staying vigilant against suspicious devices is essential. Equipped with robust scanning tools and user-friendly guides, you can confidently spot unusual gadgets and remain secure. By embracing advanced detection methods, you can navigate the digital landscape with peace of mind, knowing that your safety is a priority. 
This multi-faceted approach ensures not only your protection but also fosters a collaborative ecosystem where continuous improvement thrives.
Analyze Networks - Use our Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scanning capabilities to find unauthorized or unfamiliar devices connected to your network and ensure your digital safety.
Contribute to Improvement - Your insights drive our progress! Share your thoughts and let us know how we can enhance your experience and make the app even more valuable.
Enhanced Detection - Our app provides a Magnetic Detector and an IR Scanner to expose hidden cameras that may
not be visible to the human eye.
Spot Suspicious Devices - With cutting-edge scanning features and comprehensive guides, you can detect suspicious gadgets and remain protected wherever you are.

bluejetty:00013865:ios.description:
BILnet: simple, fast, and easy to use. You can perform all of your essential transactions on your mobile!
Manage, group, and rename your accounts independently
- View your account and credit card balances and transactions in real time
- Log in as the account holder or an agent
- When you log in to BILnet as an agent, your accounts are now grouped. Tip: to make organising your accounts easier, feel free to rename your accounts and/or change the order in which they are displayed.
Free instant payments, made in a few seconds and in just a few clicks! 
- Your eligible SEPA (single euro payment area) payments are now made instantly, within a few seconds, 24/7, and for free! *
- If your instant payment cannot be made, for example if the receiving bank does not accept instant payments, then your payment will be treated as a standard transfer under the relevant time frame.
The interface for your transfers and standing orders has been tweaked
- Extra fields are now provided when entering details about the beneficiaries of your transfers. From your computer you can set up a standing order directly from the transfer entry screen. Just tick the “Make this a standing order” box. Tip: to avoid making a mistake when you enter your new beneficiary’s IBAN, you can copy/paste it straight into the appropriate field.
Better loan management 
- Your mortgages and your personal, student and investment loans appear in the dedicated “Loan” section of BILnet. These loans now take the form of a contract rather than an account on which movements are recorded. 
- You can now find additional information about your loans in BILnet, including:
o type of loan
o amount borrowed/used
o current interest rate
o next due dates
o capital outstanding
Find all your electronic documents easily
- Download your banking documents in PDF format
- Take advantage of the free and environmentally friendly paper-free option so that you no longer receive your documents by post
- Sign your documents electronically
- All electronic documents are now sorted by date
Contact us whenever you need to
- Communicate with the bank using secure messaging and share any attachments required 
Don’t have an account yet? Visit bil.com for more information. 
The app is available in three languages (FR, DE, EN).
*For more information about our tariffs, visit bil.com

bluejetty:00043172:ios.summary:
O‘zbekistonda unumli va xavfsiz xarid va sotuvlar uchun onlayn platforma.
BirBir nomi tasodifan tanlanmagan — bu nom ikki tomon uchun ham foydali kelishuvlarni anglatadi. Platforma halollik, shaffoflik va har ikki tomon uchun foyda prinsip
bluejetty:00043172:ios.description:
O‘zbekistonda unumli va xavfsiz xarid va sotuvlar uchun onlayn platforma.
BirBir nomi tasodifan tanlanmagan — bu nom ikki tomon uchun ham foydali kelishuvlarni anglatadi. Platforma halollik, shaffoflik va har ikki tomon uchun foyda prinsiplariga asoslangan. Bu tanishuv sayti emas, ammo har bir foydalanuvchi xavfsiz chat orqali sotuvchi bilan bevosita, "birga-bir" muloqotga chiqib, muhim savollarni berishi, tafsilotlarni muhokama qilishi, savdolashib eng yaxshi narxni olishi, to‘lov usulini kelishib olishi va xavfsiz bitim tuzishi mumkin.
BirBir — bu yangi avlod e’lonlar doskasi bo‘lib, bu yerda hammasi ikki tomonning foydasi atrofida aylanadi.
Qulaylik
Ilova qulaylikka alohida urg‘u berilgan holda yaratilgan. Oddiy interfeys va aqlli qidiruv tufayli xaridorlar O‘zbekistonda kerakli arzon tovarni bir necha daqiqada topadilar. Sotuvchilar esa ortiqcha byurokratiyasiz va qiyinchiliklarsiz e’lon joylashtirishlari mumkin. Telefonni foydali narxda sotmoqchimisiz yoki eng yaxshi narxda mahsulot va xizmat topmoqchimisiz? Faqat BirBir ilovasini oching — foydali xarid sari yo‘lingizning yarmi bosib o‘tilgan bo‘ladi.
Keng tanlov
BirBir yangi va ishlatilgan tovarlar hamda xizmatlar quyidagi toifalarda jamlangan: kiyim-kechak va poyabzal, smartfonlar, noutbuklar, quloqchinlar, maishiy texnika, gadjetlar, elektronika, aksessuarlar va zargarlik buyumlari, bolalar o‘yinchoqlari va aravachalari, uy hayvonlari va o‘simliklar, O‘zbekistonda ish — Toshkent, Farg‘ona, Samarqand va Buxorodagi jozibali bo‘sh ish o‘rinlari, transport, avtomobillar va ko‘chmas mulk — uy-joy sotish, kvartira va avtomobil ijarasi (sotib olish shartlari bilan yoki holda), “bepul beraman” belgili mahsulotlar, chegirmalar va yana ko‘p narsalar. Hatto uzum do‘koni va katta chegirmalar bilan noyob takliflar ham mavjud.
Bu yerda har kim o‘ziga kerakli narsani topadi — ish, qo‘shimcha daromad, vaqtinchalik turar joy yoki O‘zbekistonda foydali narxlarda gadjet va avtomobil xaridi bo‘lishi mumkin. Agar uyingiz yoki kvartirangiz bor-u, hayotda o‘zgarish istasangiz — bor-yo‘g‘i bir necha bosish bilan e’lon joylashtirib, qiziqqan xaridorlarga chiqishingiz mumkin.
Aqlli qidiruv
BirBirning tavsiya tizimi va aqlli qidiruvi sizning e’lon qiziqishlaringizga moslashadi. Siz uchun muhim bo‘lgan mavzularda takliflar ko‘rsatiladi — ish, avtomobil xarid-sotuvi, maishiy texnika yoki ijara bo‘lishi mumkin. Narx, joylashuv va savdolashish imkoniyati bo‘yicha filtrlar esa eng yaxshi narxni topib, to‘g‘ri qaror qabul qilishingizga yordam beradi.
Xavfsizlik
BirBir sifatli moderatsiya mavjud, sotuvchi va xaridorlar esa MyID orqali shaxsini tasdiqlashi mumkin — bu platformada ishonch darajasini ancha oshiradi. Ya’ni, bitimlar bozorchalik xavfsiz bo‘ladi. Ayniqsa savdo sohasida bu juda muhim: har kim biladi — tovarni sotib olayotgan yoki kvartirani ijaraga olayotgan odamga ishonish kerak.
Innovatsiyalar
BirBir — bu oddiy internet-do‘kon emas va marketpleys ham emas. Bu — turmush va biznes uchun butun bir ekotizim bo‘lib, ichida ko‘plab foydali funksiyalar mavjud: qiziqishlarga mos mavzular va to‘plamlar, qulay va xavfsiz chat, e’lonlarni tahrirlashda yordam beruvchi sun’iy intellekt, Telegram-kanaldan e’lonlarni ko‘chirish imkoniyati, “bezovta qilmaslik” rejimi va boshqa funksiyalar. Eng muhimi — butun foyda faqat sizga tegadi, chunki barcha bitimlar to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri, vositachilarsiz va yashirin komissiyalarsiz amalga oshiriladi.
Shaffoflik
BirBir — bu nafaqat xarid, balki ish, savdo, uy-joy, avtomobil va kundalik hayotni yengillashtiradigan hamma narsalar haqida. Bizda e’lon joylashtirish uchun soliq yo‘q, yashirin to‘lovlar mavjud emas va foydalanuvchilar shaxsiy muloqotiga aralashmaymiz. Hammasi shaffof, halol va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri.
BirBir — bu sizning cho‘ntagingizdagi onlayn bozor, u orqali O‘zbekistonda foydali va xavfsiz xarid-sotuvni bitta ilova orqali amalga oshirishingiz mumkin. Qulay. Tez. Ishonchli.

bluejetty:00179155:ios.name: Portable Inventory
bluejetty:00179155:ios.summary: Portable Inventory helps you to keep track of the count of anything you want. Personal stuff, office supplies, product storage, etc. You can add different items into the app, set its initial count, warning count, and separate items by group
bluejetty:00179155:ios.description:
Portable Inventory helps you to keep track of the count of anything you want. Personal stuff, office supplies, product storage, etc. You can add different items into the app, set its initial count, warning count, and separate items by groups.
Each item will be displayed as different colors on the main page, so that you can add or reduce the count. When an item’s count is equal or less than the warning count, a little yellow triangle with an excalmatory mark will be display on the item, and the group it belongs to.
In addition, the app provided various functions to see statistics for your items or groups. You can check out the increasing, or decreasing ranking list of your items or groups in a specified time period. You can also see the change logs for all items and groups.
The app works both on iPhone and iPad, and fully supports iCloud. You may edit your items across all your devices and your data will be safely stored in iCloud. And of course you can wipe out all data as you need.

bluejetty:00138253:ios.description:
Are you ready to join Carnival Tycoon?
Carnival Tycoon - an idle simulation game that you can play together with friends.In-game purchases (includes random items). In this idle game, you start with a small theme park where visitors can ride roller coasters and Ferris wheels. To build the most interesting theme park in the world, you unlock and upgrade more rides, strive to manage and expand the scale of the park. With hard work and dedication, you make it and become a true tycoon!
Features:
Manage a theme park: Build more creatively designed rides to attract visitors to your park. To provide them with a more comfortable and enjoyable experience, continuously upgrade and renovate the rides, add more seats, and improve the efficiency of the rides.
Simple and Easy: Upgrading a large-scale ride can be done with just a few taps of your finger. This is the charm of idle simulation games. Becoming a tycoon is actually not that difficult!
Earning Coins: You can generate income and earn coins even when you are away. You can also hire secret agent dogs to steal coins from your competitors. After earning more coins, you can expand your business. There is more than one way to get rich.
Friends Club: You are not fighting alone. Find like-minded friends and invite them to join Carnival Tycoon as a team, and together build the most interesting and spectacular theme park in the world.
Island Adventures: In Carnival Tycoon, there are not only different rides but also different themed islands. As the park upgrades and expands, themed islands are continuously unlocked, and you can also obtain more revenue.
Call up a few good friends, enjoy the sense of accomplishment from building, immerse yourself in the joy of making money, join Carnival Tycoon, and experience the addictive idle simulation game!

bluejetty:00168333:ios.description:
Download maps for Offline GPS Navigation. No mobile data connection required.
Your favorite maps and charts from OS, Hema, NOAA, and many more.
Immersive 3D World map view
Fully customizable map, data display and toolbar buttons.
Powerful overlay data management, using nested categories and GPX files
Backup and load maps from thumb drive.
Use the same maps and sync your overlay data to other mobile devices and desktop computers
Interactive Route Profile showing terrain elevation
Track Altitude and Speed profile graphs
Show terrain ascent, descent, max elevation and estimated time for planned route
The Memory-Map for All app turns your phone or tablet into a full-featured Outdoor GPS or Marine Chart Plotter, and allows you to navigate with USGS Topo maps, NOAA Marine charts, and many other specialist maps, without needing a mobile internet signal.
Maps are downloaded on-the-fly and can be pre-loaded in bulk, so they are ready to be used offline. Once the app and maps are loaded to the phone or tablet, cellular network coverage or internet connection is not required for real time GPS navigation.
The Memory-Map for All app can be used as a standalone GPS navigator, but it can also be used in conjunction with the Windows PC or Mac app (free download) for planning, printing and loading up maps, waypoints and routes to the phone/tablet.
Memory-Map for All includes free access to 1:250,000 scale topographic maps and many other free maps around the world. More detailed maps are available for download and purchase with a free try-before-you-buy, time-limited demo option. Available maps include Ordnance Survey, Hema, USGS quads, NOAA, UKHO, and DeLorme. Maps can be used on your PC as well as your phone and tablet. The Cloud Sync feature allows you to keep the overlay data consistent on all your devices.
Features include:
Access a vast range of Worldwide maps and charts.
Automatically downloads a free map of your current location
Create and edit marks and routes.
Import and export marks, routes and tracks in the open GPX format
Interactive graphs of terrain elevation, GPS Altitude and Speed profile
Display; Position, Course, Speed, Heading, Altitude and averages
Position coordinates include Lat/Long, UTM, GB Grid, Irish Grid, Military Grid.
Units displayed in Statute, Nautical or Metric, with separate unit setting for Height
Support for GPS and Compass sensors, where available.
Placename search index can be used offline.
Moving map, lock GPS position and automatically scroll the map
Records breadcrumb trail / tracklogs.
Share position marks, routes and tracklogs as GPX files
Full marine instrumentation features, with AIS, DSC and Anchor alarm
NMEA data interface via WiFi for marine instruments
Barometer & relative altitude
Import custom icons for POI
Alarms for mark proximity, Anchor, Geofence or Exclusion zone, Crostrack error

bluejetty:00022135:ios.description:
Record Videos with Any Background Effortlessly with Green Screen Live Recording
Join over 12 million users who trust Green Screen Live Recording to create stunning videos with seamless background changes. Whether you're using the front or back camera, this app lets you record with any background you choose.
Key Features:
Thousands of Backgrounds: Choose from professional scenes like work offices, sky, outdoor settings, and more. Animated scenes with busy employees provide a polished look for your videos.
Instant Saving: Videos save instantly to your Photo Library, making sharing via email, text, YouTube, Dropbox, and other apps quick and easy.
Customizable Backgrounds: No green screen? No problem! Select any color range to remove from your environment. Import custom backgrounds from the web, your photo library, or directly from the camera. Use our advanced editing tools to crop and rotate your backgrounds.
Flexible Recording Modes: Record in portrait or landscape mode to suit your needs.
Free to Use: Enjoy all background images and features without any cost. Download now and start creating!
New Features:
Special Effects: Add exciting effects like explosions, snow, rain, fire, and more to your live videos.
Custom Background Movies: Use your own movies as backgrounds from your photo library.
Green Screen for Photos & Videos: Apply the green screen effect on any movies and photos from your gallery.
Custom Audio Tracks: Add audio tracks from your music library or use our templates.
Trend Updates: Access thousands of new emojis, stickers, backgrounds, and movies. Check out trending backgrounds and stickers regularly.
Text & Stickers: Add text to your videos and customize stickers by moving, scaling, and rotating them.
Remote Control: Use your watch to start and stop recording remotely.
Enhanced Performance: Improved performance on tablets and better overall functionality.
Special Thanks:
A big thank you to the teachers and students at Title 1 school in Norfolk, VA, for using our app in your daily news show. Your creative contest ideas inspire us!

Seterra Map Quiz - What's Your World Geography IQ? 
Whether you're studying for final exams or Final Jeopardy, Seterra has the geography category covered. The popular online and desktop based map quiz classic that has been entertaining and educating geography buffs ages 8-88 for more than 20 years has gone mobile.
Take on the world or conquer it one region at a time. The app includes 300+ different games to test your map skills. Learn to distinguish Tasmania from Tanzania and France's bleu, blanc, rouge flag from Russia's white, blue and red stripes. Cities, countries, capitals, continents and bodies of water are all in the mix. Pinpoint Kilimanjaro and Mount McKinley in the mountains test or discover exotic islands in the far flung reaches of the globe when trying the world islands quiz.
Those who are little rusty on their U.S. state capitals or vague on the current status and existence of those pesky "istans" can browse categories and shore up their knowledge base using the Learn Mode. When ready to test their memory, an interactive map identification task is just a click away.

• Identify continents and the locations of countries within each
• Find states, territories, provinces, and their capitals
• Discover oceans, seas and rivers across the globe
• Explore mountain ranges and volcanos
• Match flags to the right country
• Locate the world's 25 largest cities
• Zero in on tiny islands dotting the map
• Choose from 40+ different tests on U.S. Geography
App Features
• Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Swedish and many more languages.
• Zoomable maps with clear outlines around countries
• Sessions are timed and graded for accuracy
• Track progress across multiple categories 
• Leaderboards showing top scorers for each challenge
• Create a My Favorites list of preferred games for easy access
• Create custom quizzes by selecting a subset of the questions in an existing quiz.
• Unlimited chances to retake a segment and improve the score
• No ads or in-app purchases
• Offline play supported
• Create your own custom quizzes! Start with any quiz, select a subset of the questions, and then save it as a custom quiz.
It's easy to challenge friends, classmates and family members in a head to head competition using Seterra. This app gives trivia contests a new spin and makes family game night rock. Teachers can put the social back in social studies with lively Geo Bee matches. There's a wide variety of content with enough depth to challenge the most diehard map hounds or just enough difficulty to prove you're smarter than a fifth grader.

bluejetty:00066140:ios.description:
Sweep mines like you used to on PC - the retro classic, reimagined for your phone.
No luck required. Deduce where the mines are hiding using logic, not guesswork - and clear the board before it clears you.
Play fully offline, anytime, anywhere. Prefer a completely ad-free experience? Unlock it with a one-time purchase.
New to Minesweeper? It's a classic game where you must deduce where the secret mines are hidden and try to uncover as much of the board as you can. Be mindful as there is danger lurking below. Some squares will be empty while some will have a number underneath; the number will tell you how many bombs are surrounding that square. The higher the number, the greater the danger you are in.
To win you'll need more than luck. Mark the squares you think have something hiding beneath them and save them for later. The more tiles you sweep, the closer you will get to finding all the bombs and clearing the field.
But if you land on a mine? Game over!
Try to see how long you can last before stepping on a mine. Play the Daily Challenge mode and try to win all of the Trophies for your collection. This simple game is so easy but also quite addicting. Minesweeper is an all-time classic game that confused many of us as children. Do you accept the challenge to try to clear the land mines and sweep all the bombs away? It will take concentration but you can do it.
Earn XP with every round you play — the tougher the board, the bigger the reward. Level up over time and watch your experience badge grow as you master the game.
It's the perfect logic puzzle game to train your brain. You'll need more than luck; success requires strategy! Immerse yourself in the world; you are now a mine sweeper and it's your duty to defuse land mines and clear each and every level. Minesweeper logic puzzle is a fun and challenging game that increases your thinking speed and logical reasoning skills.
If you are a fan of solitaire, mahjong, puzzles or other games you play by yourself and have some free time, we dare you to download Minesweeper and try to beat the game -- you'll be glad you did!

** Featured by Apple as an app of the day **
Organizing and calculating taxes shouldn't be the focus of your self-employed business. 1tap receipts takes away the difficulty of organizing, tracking and filing business expenses, so you can focus on your business. Scan receipts to automatically extract the data and categorize transactions for your Schedule C!
Start tracking your expenses for next year’s tax season. Scan receipts with 1tap and know what you can deduct! Start saving your receipts and get a head start on your records so you don’t miss a single deduction or expense.
1tap receipts’ receipt scanner EXTRACTS the supplier, date, amount and expense category from your receipts, bills and invoices with UNBELIEVABLE accuracy. 
Email your digital invoices to 1tap receipts and we will turn those into tax deductions! 1tap receipts is the ultimate app to help self-employed individuals track their finances and expenses. 
With the speed & ease of 1tap’s self-employment tax calculator, late stressful nights in front of the computer gathering receipts, expenses and documents will become a long-lost memory!
Manage your finances in a few taps! Scan your receipts and have full access to all of your documents for at least 7 years in case of an audit. Stop your accountant from chasing you down for missing receipts and invoices and keep all your finances and expenses. 
Try 1tap receipts right now using the worst receipt you can find and see how it goes!
Use the receipt scanner to boost your income and never miss out on IRS tax deductions next tax season or any. Leave the accounting to us!
How it Works
================
1. TAKE A PHOTO: 
Open 1tap receipts and use the scanner to snap your receipt or invoice.
2. AUTO EXTRACT: 
Never struggle with inputting your data from receipts, expenses and finances again. Data from the receipt or invoice is automatically extracted and placed in the correct Schedule C category.
3. SAVE AND SHARE RECEIPTS: 
Instantly save all of your receipts, invoices and expenses. Send your receipts and Schedule C categorization to your accountant or whoever else may need to see them this tax season.
Self-employed and annoyed with your business bookkeeping? Make accounting, invoicing and finance management easy for self-employed individuals with 1tap receipts. Snap, scan and let us take care of the rest.
Download 1tap receipts today and join the Self Employed individuals who are saving time and finding more IRS tax deductions than ever before.

A grey animal arrives, and your child's task is to feed it apples of the correct color. Clear instructions ensure your child knows what to do. Dragging for kids the right apple to the animal causes it to chew and gradually change color, while choosing the wrong apple prompts friendly guidance.
- Coloring Fun: Unleash your child's creativity as they fill in blank animal outlines with vibrant colors. As your kid traces their finger along the outline, the animal magically comes to life in full color.
- Balloon: A lively game where your kids pops colorful balloons as they rise from the bottom of the screen. Popping the wrong colored balloon leads to gentle guidance for kids, while popping the right ones brings excitement and kids fun.
- More Mini-Games: Fluffy's Color Adventures is packed with even more exciting educational mini-games for kids, each focusing on different aspects of color learning. Whether it's matching colors, painting scenes, or sorting objects, there's always something new to learn.

Fluffy's Colorful Adventures strikes the perfect balance between entertainment and education. Your child will be having so much fun that they won't even realize they're learning important color concepts.

Rest easy knowing that Fluffy's Colorful Adventures provides a safe and ad-free environment for your kids to explore and learn independently.
- Suitable for Ages 2-5:
This kids game is specifically tailored for preschoolers and kindergarteners, ensuring that the content is age-appropriate and easy to grasp.
- Intuitive Gameplay:
The game's intuitive controls and child-friendly interface make it easy for young learners to navigate and enjoy the activities.
Are you looking for kids engaging way to introduce your child to the educational world of colors? Download Fluffy's Color Adventures and watch as your kids blossoms into a confident color expert! Track your baby's weekly development, get personalized health tips, and stay organized with helpful tools — all in one place. Whether you're a first-time mom or experienced parent, this app makes the journey more reassuring and joyful.
KEY FEATURES:
- Weekly Baby Development: Follow your baby’s growth with beautiful visualizations. 
- Due Date Calculator: Easily track how far along you are and when to expect your baby. 
- Health Tips & Reminders: Receive expert-based guidance for every stage. 
- Symptom & Mood Tracker: Log how you feel day by day. 
- Appointments & To-Do Lists: Stay organized throughout your pregnancy. 
- Safe & Private: Your data is stored securely and only accessible to you.
Download Pregnancy Tracking today and enjoy a thoughtful, supportive companion throughout your pregnancy journey.

bluejetty:00115403:ios.description:
Ever wanted to try the viral TikTok Reverse Challenge?
Now you can with Play Reverse.
With Play Reverse, you can easily record your voice or any sound, flip it backwards, and then try to repeat it. Reverse it once more and discover the surprising and often hilarious results. What sounds impossible at first quickly becomes one of the most entertaining challenges you can share with friends.
How it works is simple:
• Record your voice or a short phrase
• Flip the recording backwards with one tap
• Try to say it again while listening to the reversed version
• Reverse it once more and hear how close you got
Play Reverse is perfect for creating funny clips, competing in challenges with friends, or joining the latest trends on TikTok and Instagram. Whether you are looking for a quick laugh, a new party game, or content that can go viral, Play Reverse makes it fun, easy, and unforgettable.
We’ve designed the app to be simple and intuitive so you can start playing right away. No complicated setup, no extra steps—just record, reverse, and enjoy the results. Each try is different, and that’s what makes it so addictive.
Download Play Reverse today and see if you can master the reverse challenge.

Dual Messenger – Web & Multi Accounts is the ultimate tool to run two WA Messenger accounts on one iPhone. 
Whether you need a second number for work, parallel space for private chats, or a simple way to clone WA Messenger, this app makes it fast, secure, and easy. 
Dual WA Messenger & Second Number 
Use two accounts on the same phone without switching devices. Manage work and personal chats separately, log in instantly with QR code, and enjoy smooth switching between accounts. Perfect for professionals, students, and anyone who needs a second WA Messenger number. 
WA Messenger Web & QR Scanner 
Connect to WA Web in seconds. Scan the QR code, sync messages across devices, and keep your chats updated everywhere. Our fast and secure web scanner ensures you never lose connection. 
Parallel Space & Multi Accounts 
Clone apps and run multiple social accounts on the same device. From business chats to personal messaging, you can create a separate space and keep your worlds apart while staying connected at all times. 
Business & Productivity Focus 
Grow your business with a second WA Messenger account. Keep work messages separate, manage customer chats easily, and run your company communications from the same phone. Ideal for entrepreneurs, teams, and users who need efficiency on the go. 
Privacy & Security 
Your privacy comes first. Dual Messenger uses encrypted connections and secure login to protect your accounts. All your chats remain safe, and your data is never shared with third parties. 
Why Choose Dual Messenger – Web & Multi Accounts? 
- Run two WA Messenger accounts on one iPhone 
- Quick login with QR scanner and WA Messenger Web 
- Manage parallel space and multiple accounts 
- Keep personal and work messages separate 
- Designed for business and productivity 
- Fast, reliable, and secure 
Upgrade the way you use WA Messenger. Download now and enjoy dual accounts, WA Web, and multiple account management in one app.

Whether you’re booking a flight, checking your tail assignment, or tracking your aircraft en route, the Sentient Jet Mobile App keeps your travel experience seamless—before, during, and after every journey.
