bluejetty:00166098:ios.summary: ONE MAP - Never Ending Battle Royale is a revolutionary BATTLE ROYALE style online MULTIPLAYER third-person shooter game where the entire world joins a single, never-ending BATTLE ROYALE. With no match-making wait times, you instantly dive
bluejetty:00166098:ios.description:
ONE MAP - Never Ending Battle Royale is a revolutionary BATTLE ROYALE style online MULTIPLAYER third-person shooter game where the entire world joins a single, never-ending BATTLE ROYALE. With no match-making wait times, you instantly dive into continuous PVP action, surrounded by players from across the globe. Gamers are tired of complicated menus and long waits, in ONE MAP, the focus is on what matters most: the ACTION. The map dynamically adjusts its size based on how many players are online, so it's never too big to feel empty or too small to feel crowded, ensuring the perfect balance for engaging gameplay and STRATEGY. When you die, jump straight back into the deathmatch and keep trying to survive longer than before.
The goal is simple: SURVIVAL. Play solo and rely on your own skills, or team up with friends to get an edge in this intense BATTLE ROYALE third person shooter. Every second counts, and the clock is always ticking. It’s simple to play but hard to master. Perfect for those looking for a real SHOOTER challenge.
ONE MAP’s goal is to break the world record for the most players online in a single game. With its continuous game design, One Map brings players together in one massive, real-time battle royale. The current record is 6,557 players, and we need your help to beat it. Join the fight, stay alive, and make gaming history in this ultimate survival showdown.
Features:
One Global Game: No more waiting for match-making! Everyone around the world is playing the same game, so there's always a strategy-packed match to join in this intense PVP Battle Royale arena.
Dynamic Map Size: The map expands or contracts based on the number of players online, ensuring it's never too big or too small, creating the perfect environment for intense action and strategic play.
Survive Together or Alone: Play solo to test your skills, or team up with friends to gain an advantage in this intense THIRD PERSON SHOOTER.
Real-Time Leaderboards: Track your progress with in-game leaderboards that rank every current player based on survival time in the DEATHMATCH. The player who has survived the longest will be ranked first, followed by the rest. Additionally, view daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards that highlight the top players in this thrilling battle royale experience.
Combat Variety: Take down opponents your way, shoot them in thrilling PVP combat, sneak up for an assassination, or celebrate a win with dance moves.
Choose Your Character: Pick from a variety of characters with unique appearances. They all perform the same but let you customize your look on the battlefield in this ultimate MMO SHOOTER.
How long can you survive? The longer you stay in the game, the greater the battle royale challenge. Dive into ONE MAP - Never Ending Battle Royale now, and see how long you can last in this intense multiplayer ACTION and STRATEGY game!

bluejetty:00027100:ios.description:
This app shows over 7,100 RV dump stations, most throughout the US. and Canada. Includes rest areas, truck stops, KOAs, campgrounds, RV parks and more.
Dump station locations are displayed even when offline!
NO SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED. A one time fee and that’s it.
Dump station information is obtained from crowd-sourcing and are therefore subjective in nature. What one person describes as working another may describe as broken.
Features:
- Location database is included with the app, so all locations are visible when offline.
- Filter what type of location to display. For example, list only free dump stations from the filter.
- Show a route between your location and the selected RV dump station.
- View the dump stations in list view; easily search the list.
- Get the local weather for the location.
- Internet searches and more for each location.
- Database is updated monthly, subject to user submissions.
- Import routes from GPX files. This makes it much easier to find RV dump stations along a route you've created in another app such as Road Trip Planner.
- Send a dump station location to our app Road Trip Planner. This helps in routing your travels (requires separate purchase of the Road Trip Planner app).
We want to expand our RV dump station database as much as possible, so we have made it easy for you to easily submit a new RV dump station - simply tap the + button below the map. 
To correct or update dump station information, tap “Location Comment” in the detail view. We will be updating the database often.
Due to the nature of dump stations constantly changing their status it's recommended you contact the dump station prior to using it to verify its status.

bluejetty:00131960:ios.name: PTSD Test
bluejetty:00131960:ios.summary: It's natural to feel afraid during and after a shocking, scary, or life-threatening event. Most people who experience traumatic events may have difficulty adjusting at first but eventually get back to their normal routines. If you continue
bluejetty:00131960:ios.description:
It's natural to feel afraid during and after a shocking, scary, or life-threatening event. Most people who experience traumatic events may have difficulty adjusting at first but eventually get back to their normal routines. If you continue to feel distressed long after the traumatic event has occurred, you may have PTSD.
This app is designed to evaluate your symptoms of PTSD with a scientifically-supported 20-question screening test. It uses the PTSD Checklist for DSM-5 (PCL-5), a screening questionnaire for PTSD that is often used in healthcare and research settings. The PCL-5 is also helpful for monitoring your PTSD-related symptoms during and after treatment.
PTSD Test contains four tools:
- Start Test: take the PCL-5 to assess your PTSD symptoms
- History: see a history of your test scores to monitor your symptoms over time
- Information: learn about PTSD and discover additional resources that can help you on your path to recovery
- Reminder: set up notifications to re-take the test at your convenience
Disclaimer: The PCL-5 is NOT a diagnostic test. A diagnosis can only be provided by a qualified healthcare professional. Please consult a physician or mental health professional if you are concerned about PTSD. 
Reference: Weathers, F.W., Litz, B.T., Keane, T.M., Palmieri, P.A., Marx, B.P., & Schnurr, P.P. (2013). The PTSD Checklist for DSM-5 (PCL-5). Scale available from the National Center for PTSD at www.ptsd.va.gov.

bluejetty:00140335:ios.description:

Make your way up the tower, equip weapons and armor, cast spells and scrolls, activate auras, collect loot and defeat monsters in tactical turn-based combat.

* Turn Based Strategy Game

bluejetty:00132169:ios.name: ApowerREC: Record Screen
bluejetty:00132169:ios.summary: ApowerREC is a screen recorder and video editor for gameplay, tutorials, app demos, and presentations. Record with microphone commentary, edit with AI subtitles and voiceovers, turn scrolling recordings into long images, and transfer photos
bluejetty:00132169:ios.description:
ApowerREC is a screen recorder and video editor for gameplay, tutorials, app demos, and presentations. Record with microphone commentary, edit with AI subtitles and voiceovers, turn scrolling recordings into long images, and transfer photos and videos over Wi-Fi.
From capturing your screen to editing and sharing, keep your everyday media tasks together in one app.
SCREEN RECORDING
Capture the moments and ideas you want to share.
• Record gameplay, tutorials, app demonstrations, and more.
• Add microphone commentary to explain what’s happening on screen.
• Adjust resolution, recording quality, and frame rate where supported.
• Available recording settings vary by device and iOS version.
• Choose automatic, landscape, or portrait recording orientation.
• Save recordings for editing, playback, and sharing.
WI-FI FILE TRANSFER
Move photos and videos between devices without a cable.
• Connect your devices to the same Wi-Fi network.
• Open the address shown in ApowerREC in a browser on your computer or another phone.
• Send and receive supported photos and videos in both directions.
• Use your browser on the other device without installing a companion app.
SCROLLING RECORDINGS TO LONG IMAGES
Keep scrolling content in one easy-to-view image.
• Turn a continuous scrolling screen recording into a long image.
• Adjust the video range to focus on the content you need.
• Crop the result to remove unwanted areas.
• Save the long image to Photos or share it with others.
VIDEO EDITING & AI SUBTITLES
Turn recordings into clear, focused videos.
• Trim unwanted footage and keep the moments that matter.
• Automatically generate subtitles with AI speech recognition.
• Add voiceovers to explain steps or personalize your videos.
• Crop videos to popular aspect ratios, including 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, and 9:16.
• Create picture-in-picture layouts in your video edits.
VIDEO COMPRESSION
Make large videos easier to store and share.
• Reduce video file sizes with adjustable compression settings.
• Balance quality, resolution, and file size.
• Import videos from Photos or the Files app.
• Save compressed copies while keeping your originals.
FORMAT CONVERSION & AUDIO EXTRACTION
Prepare your media for different uses.
• Convert videos to supported formats, including MP4, MOV, and M4V.
• Extract audio from videos as MP3, M4A, or WAV.
• Turn video clips into GIFs.
• Track processing progress and access your results.
FREE VIDEO PLAYER
Watch recordings and local videos without a VIP subscription.
• Play MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, AVI, WebM, FLV, WMV, and more.
• Open videos from Photos, the Files app, or the system share menu.
• Adjust playback speed and watch in landscape.
• Access your playback history and continue from your saved position.
IMAGE TOOLS
Handle everyday image editing tasks.
• Compress images to reduce file sizes.
• Crop, adjust, and annotate pictures.
• Save edited copies while keeping your originals.
MADE FOR YOUR EVERYDAY RECORDINGS
Explain an app, capture a gameplay highlight, or create a tutorial with subtitles and voiceover. Turn scrolling content into a long image, compress a video for sharing, or move photos and videos to another device over Wi-Fi.
FREE & VIP FEATURES
The video player is free to use. Saving and sharing long images require VIP. Some other features require a VIP subscription or purchase. Available options and pricing are displayed in the app.
Format support depends on the file’s video and audio codecs. Playback, editing, compression, conversion, and transfer support may differ.
CONTACT US
Have a question or suggestion? Contact support@apowersoft.com.
If you enjoy using ApowerREC, we’d appreciate your review!

bluejetty:00076979:ios.name: Take Care of Animals: Pets
bluejetty:00076979:ios.summary: Playing games can be meaningful! At SKIDOS, we know that learning comes naturally to kids through play. That is why we gathered a collection of 40+ unique apps to ensure joyful playtime and engaging learning for 2-11-year-old kids. With SKI
bluejetty:00076979:ios.description:
Playing games can be meaningful! At SKIDOS, we know that learning comes naturally to kids through play. That is why we gathered a collection of 40+ unique apps to ensure joyful playtime and engaging learning for 2-11-year-old kids. With SKIDOS apps, kids improve math skills and logical thinking, learn to trace letters and numbers, prompt their curiosity through videos and strengthen 21st-century skills!
40+ APPS WITH SKIDOS PASS
With a single Pass, you access all SKIDOS apps where children of different ages will find games to every taste. You can create up to 6 player profiles within one account and log in from multiple devices. Go ahead and customize the app experience for your kids according to their interests and learning level. Stay on top of how your kids learn - check the progress report in the app or via email.
Come on pet lovers! Learn abc and math with cute pet animals. Explore Skidos Animal Pet Care games. It is a role-playing game bath, feed, clean, care and play with cute adorable cats, dogs, monkeys, bunnies, and more. Take good care of cute pet animals.
The app has 10 different scenes:
- Play with soapy bubbles in the bath
- Clean up with a dry towel and brush hair
- Feed snacks and clean up
- Take pets to the vet for daily check-ups
- Give medicines & take care of cute animals
- Clean and brush teeth
- Fun Mini Games & Toys
- Clean and clip nails
- Tap fleas and put lotion
- Heal wounds
SKIDOS LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our unique approach is to engage kids in learning while they play games they love. We gathered a collection of 40+ fun games and incorporated interactive learning content into them. 4 million kids around the globe play & learn with SKIDOS!
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, etc. Tasks evolve as a child progresses. Interactive design and animation support learning - three cute little SKIDOS mascots help and encourage kids when they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybug will show a little learner how to trace with their finger while visuals and a voice-over will teach new words and counting.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Video content prompts children's curiosity in a fun and easy way. We created the right mix of entertainment & learning with our video catalog.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS apps do not show ads to kids, are COPPA & GDPR compliant, and ensure a safe online learning environment for kids.
Get your SKIDOS Pass today!
- SKIDOS offers monthly, quarterly, annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- 3 Day Free Trial! Payment will be charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The SKIDOS Pass may be managed by the user & auto-renewal for subscriptions may be turned off in the user’s device Account Settings
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a Pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

The rule
bluejetty:00011179:ios.description:
Welcome to Lucky Squirrel Bubble Adv — a bright and relaxing bubble-shooting adventure inspired by classic gameplay and playful charm. Join the lucky squirrel on a colorful journey filled with satisfying pops and cheerful effects.
The rules are simple and timeless: aim, shoot, and match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear the board. Carefully plan your shots, bounce bubbles off the walls, and create smooth chain reactions to clear tricky formations.
As you progress, levels introduce new layouts and challenges that test your timing and accuracy while staying easy to pick up and enjoyable for all ages. Each stage is designed to feel rewarding, whether you play for a few minutes or dive into longer sessions.
With clean visuals, smooth animations, and intuitive controls, Lucky Squirrel Bubble Adv delivers a fun and polished bubble-shooter experience. If you enjoy classic puzzle games with a lighthearted animal theme, this adventure is perfect for relaxing and popping bubbles anytime.

bluejetty:00073418:ios.description:
Thousands of healthcare teams across more than 40 specialties connect with and care for their patients using Klara’s secure messaging and telemedicine solution because it’s convenient and accessible to patients with no login, password, or download required—ever. With Klara, practices grow by providing patients with the convenient experience they demand while making their operations more efficient.
Customer support is available in-app or by email at support@klara.com.
FOR PROVIDERS
(Patients, see below)
With Klara, you can:
1. Provide your patients with excellent care no matter where they are through secure messaging and video visits
2. Communicate directly with patients, team members, and external providers
3. Whatever you’re sending — messages, documents, photos, or eForms — it’s all secure and HIPAA-compliant
4. Respond to texts, voicemails, website messages in one central place
5. Assign messages to your colleagues for quick responses
6. Send eForms for patients to fill out digitally
7. Automate routine patient outreach to patients before and after their appointments, including reminders, pre-visit instructions, post-visit follow-up, etc.
8. And more!
You need a Klara account to use this app. Sign up for a free demo on our website.
FOR PATIENTS
Download the Klara app to connect with your doctor and other healthcare providers over secure messaging and video visits. You can also access Klara by going to patient.klara.com and entering your mobile phone number.
Your healthcare provider must use Klara for you to use this app. If they’re not already using Klara, ask them to sign up today!

listings.description:
Create your own idol life in Slimaid Princess: Idol Life — a dress-up, character creation, and role-play world where every day can become a new story.

CREATE YOUR IDOL
Customize characters with hairstyles, makeup, outfits, and expressions. Build your own idol team and give every member a different look and personality.

DRESS UP & CREATE NEW LOOKS
Visit the clothing store, hair salon, and makeover studio. Mix and match fashion, organize clothes in your wardrobe, and switch styles for practice, everyday moments, backstage, spa time, and concerts.

LIVE THE IDOL DREAM
Practice with your team, sing and record in the studio, get ready backstage, attend a press conference, and step onto the concert stage for your big performance.

CREATE STORIES YOUR WAY
Move characters, interact with scenes, use expressions, and complete in-game phone missions to create your own stories. Hang out in the dorm, plan a makeover day, prepare for a show, or simply relax with friends.

RELAX AT THE HOT SPRING SPA
Take a break from the busy idol schedule and enjoy a cozy spa moment with your idol friends. Change your look, interact with the room, and create a relaxing story beyond the stage.

EXPLORE THE IDOL WORLD
• Practice Room
• Recording Studio
• Clothing Store
• Hair Salon
• Makeover Studio
• Concert Stage
• Backstage
• Press Conference
• Dorm
• Hot Spring Spa

There is no single way to play. Create your idol, style your look, explore the world, make your own stories, and shine your way.

bluejetty:00020703:ios.description:
Welcome to the unique world of Draw Puzzle! For those who love to draw, a new draw puzzle game is waiting for you! 
Draw Puzzle is specially designed for those who love to draw and play with puzzles. This new Draw Puzzle game is a combination of drawing and puzzle. Combining these two features, Draw Puzzle guarantees that you will have a wonderful time while you are playing the game!
From quick sketches to fully finished artwork, this sketch game goes where your creativity takes you. Draw Puzzle is a sketching, scribble, painting, doodling and drawing game for anyone who loves to draw.
In this game, new shapes will appear in each level that you have to complete by drawing them. With each new level you pass, the difficulty will increase and the game will challenge you! You have to pass all the levels and prove your own doodling skills!
Draw Puzzle is a game that appeals to people of all ages. When you come back from school, after a tiring work day, when you want to take time for yourself after taking care of the children, it will be waiting for you to give you a pleasant time in your boring moments.
If you are someone who likes to paint and doodle, this game is for you. You will get addicted to this immersive drawing game and you will never get tired of playing this game! If you're ready to challenge yourself and your skills, start to draw it!
Features of the Game:
-Improves drawing ability!
-Smart moves in drawing puzzles!
-Helps improve hand-eye coordination!
-Show your sketching skills!
-Hundreds of doodling puzzles to solve!
-Contributes to the development of attention!
-Quick draw for all ages of puzzle games lovers!
When you are bored with the tiring thoughts of daily life, Draw Puzzle will help you to relax and save you from your boring world. Those who trust their paint and scribble skills and those who want to combine drawing with puzzle when bored should join the colorful world of Draw Puzzle!
Draw Puzzle challenges those who are confident in their drawing abilities. If you are one of them, start testing your skills, intelligence and attention. Start drawing something, write your own draw story and make your own challenge!
Draw Puzzle invites you to its own fun world! If you like to doodle, start drawing your own story and get ready to become a draw master!
Enjoy Draw Puzzle, the scribble game from TEOS dedicated to fun!
This game has a subscription-based premium feature package, it enables users to use the app without advertisements and with extra features. It's an auto-renewable subscription. The subscription period is weekly. Payment is charged to the App Store account at confirmation. Subscription is renewed unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the period, and the account will be automatically charged for renewal as well. You may turn it off in your Account Settings anytime.
Terms of Use: https://teosgamestudio.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://teosgamestudio.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00035860:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00035860:ios.description:
Know what bit you — and whether it's dangerous.
BugAlert turns your camera into a fast bug, spider and bite identifier built for one moment: when you find something and need to know if it's a threat. Snap a photo and get three ranked matches with honest confidence, a clear danger flag, and what to do next.
Built around the danger question
• Colour-coded danger verdict on every result: venomous, bites, stings, disease-carrier or harmless.
• "What bit me?" mode narrows welts and stings to a likely culprit — mosquito, tick, flea, bedbug, spider, ant or wasp — with first-aid steps and clear red-flag guidance on when to seek care.
• Pest mode helps you tell a cockroach from a carpenter ant from a termite, read the signs of an infestation, and decide DIY vs. call a pro.
Accurate, honest identification
• Three candidates with confidence — never a single overconfident guess.
• Species info: common and scientific name, reference photos, range and season.
• Voice input for the bug that got away: describe it and get likely matches.
• Every scan saved to your history.
Important
BugAlert provides informational identification and general safety guidance only. It is not medical, veterinary or pest-control advice. For a bite or sting that worries you, or a suspected infestation, consult a qualified professional.
———
This app requires a subscription to use. Subscriptions are managed by users and you can cancel at any time. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel your subscription at any time using the account settings on your phone. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase if you would not like to get an auto renewing subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://famoconnect.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Everything we do is rooted in nostalgia from our childhood: long acrylic nails, big ass gold hoops, and winged eyeliner. We love our Homegirls, the City of Angels, candy painted Low-Riders, bumping Mary Wells on repeat, micheladas, long, hot summer days and looking fly.

Bella Doña is a part of a culture rich in tradition and beauty. We are here to continue a legacy of pride, and show the world how we get down.

bluejetty:00121732:ios.description:
NASCAR MOBILE: The Official App of NASCAR
Experience NASCAR like never before with the official app built for race-day intensity, deeper insights, and nonstop fan engagement. Follow every lap across the NASCAR Cup Series, NASCAR O’Reilly Auto Parts Series, and NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series with real-time data, live audio, exclusive video, fantasy tools, and interactive features designed for every level of NASCAR fan.
Live Race Experience
- Race Tracker & Enhanced Leaderboard (All Series Races)
 - Real-time race tracking with enhanced visuals and insights.
 - Customize your view with filters for such as Top 10, Favorites and Full Field
 - Landscape View
 - Free access for NASCAR Fan Rewards members.
Alternate Leaderboards (All Series Races)
- Free stats: Stage Points, Lap Leaders, Fastest Laps, and more.
- Premium stats: Win Probability, Movers & Fallers, Fastest Laps Run, 10-Lap & 20-Lap Averages, Laps in Top 10.
Live Race Driver Stories (Cup Series Races)
- Follow individual drivers during the race with enhanced storytelling.
- Watch a mix of in-car clips and broadcast highlights tied to live race moments.
Timeline (All Series Races)
- Lap-by-lap race updates with fun facts, milestones, and key insights in real time.
Pit Crew Rosters (Cup Series Races)
- View full pit crew lineups, including crew chief, spotters, tire changers, jackman, and gasman.
NASCAR Fantasy Live
- Play season-long fantasy games and compete against friends.
- Fantasy Live Leaderboard
- Track your selected drivers and garage picks in real time.
- Swap drivers before Stage 3 and follow live scoring throughout the race
NASCAR Fan Rewards
- Earn points for engaging with NASCAR content and redeem rewards for prizes.
- Video, Audio & Immersive Features
Live Scanner Audio (All Series)
- Listen to live driver, crew chief, and spotter communications during practice and qualifying.
Driver Cards with Scanner Access
- Jump directly into live scanner audio from Driver Cards.
- View enhanced driver stats and performance dashboards.
NASCAR Channel
- 24/7 live NASCAR racing content and shows, streaming now in the Watch section.
AR Masterclass
- Free Augmented Reality experiences that explain NASCAR strategies and race moments.
- High-fidelity 3D animations covering pit stops, drafting, race rules, and more.
NASCAR Classics
- Watch historical race replays and iconic NASCAR moments on demand.
Weekend Planning & Insights
- Weekend Schedule & Broadcast Tune-In
- View full race weekend schedules for all NASCAR series.
- Clickable broadcast logos make it easy to find race coverage.
Additional features:
- Driver, manufacturer, and owner standings.
- Betting odds (where available).
- Weather forecasts with hourly track conditions.
Premium Features (Subscription Required)
- Upgrade to NASCAR Premium with monthly or annual plans for the ultimate race-day experience:
 - No ads for uninterrupted viewing.
 - Enhanced Leaderboard stats across all NASCAR series.
 - Live Telemetry with real-time race data.
 - Premium Scanner access with unfiltered team communications.
 - NASCAR Officials Radio for race control updates.
For your convenience, here are links to our terms of use and privacy policy:
https://www.nascar.com/terms-of-use
https://www.nascar.com/privacy-statement

bluejetty:00099482:ios.description:
Transform your look instantly with Visio, the ultimate AI photo editor, hairstyle tester, and virtual fitting room! Whether you want to test a new hair color, discover your perfect haircut, or try on clothes before buying, Visio uses state-of-the-art AI to deliver photorealistic results in seconds. 
NEW: AI VIRTUAL CLOTHING TRY-ON
Stop guessing how an outfit will look. Step into our smart virtual fitting room and try on clothes instantly:
- Custom Outfit Try-On: Upload a screenshot or photo of any outfit you like, and see it on yourself in a moment.
- Massive AI Closet: Browse and try on hundreds of trending dresses, tops, bottoms, and jackets directly in the app.
- Hyper-Realistic Fit: Enjoy digital outfit try-ons that mold to your pose and look like a real fashion photoshoot.
HAIR STYLE & HAIR COLOR CHANGER
Thinking of a big change? Use our virtual hair studio to experiment without the commitment:
- Test New Hairstyles: Instantly try on curtain bangs, wispy cuts, chic bobs, pixies, buns, and long wavy extensions.
- Hair Color Changer: Find your perfect shade! Easily test blonde, brunette, red, and black dyes, or add light, dark, and subtle highlights.
- Salon Quality: Enhance your current look with one-tap volume and shine adjustments.
AI HEADSHOT GENERATOR & BACKGROUND ERASER
Ditch the expensive studio and create pro-level photos right from your phone:
- LinkedIn Headshots: Generate professional profile pictures (Business, Casual, Relaxed) in seconds.
- One-Tap Object Remover: Instantly erase photobombers and distractions to keep the subject sharp.
- Magic Background Swap: Teleport yourself to a plain white background, sleek office, cozy cafe, city rooftop, or beach sunset.
NATURAL MAKEUP & FACE RETOUCH
Look your absolute best while still looking like you:
- Flawless Skin: Smooth gently, brighten, add freckles, or get a soft glowing tan. Say goodbye to undereye bags.
- Custom Makeup Studio: Apply winged eyeliner, long lashes, blush, contour, and festival looks with matte or glossy finishes.
- Facial Tuning: Refine smiles (classic, wide, closed), accentuate your jawline, add dimples, and try on glare-free glasses.
PHOTOSHOOTS & STYLIZED FILTERS
Create your unique vibe with 60+ photorealistic presets so every edit is share-ready:
- Aesthetic Modes: Try Old Money, Cinematic, Beach Sunset, Spotlight, and Model B&W.
- Creative AI Art: Transform your selfies into 90s anime characters, Pixar-style 3D cartoons, clay art, sketches, or fun caricatures.
VISIO PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Unlock the full power of Visio! Subscribe for unlimited access to premium hairstyles, clothing items, exclusive style filters, and continuous feature updates. 
- Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually based on your selected plan.
- Auto-renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00132204:ios.summary:
Turn your device into a GPS speedometer and intelligent trip companion. Whether driving, cycling, boating, or exploring on foot, track every detail of your journey with style.
SPEED & NAVIGATION:
- GPS speed tracking in MPH, KM/H, or knots
bluejetty:00132204:ios.description:
Turn your device into a GPS speedometer and intelligent trip companion. Whether driving, cycling, boating, or exploring on foot, track every detail of your journey with style.
SPEED & NAVIGATION:
- GPS speed tracking in MPH, KM/H, or knots
- Real-time trip computer: speed, distance, altitude, heading, duration
- Live position tracking with interactive map view
- Trip recording with detailed route mapping
- Save unlimited journeys and review them anytime
SMART DISPLAY MODES:
Heads-Up Display (HUD):
- Mirror your speed onto the windshield
- Display vital stats while driving
- Suitable for nighttime use with auto-brightness adjustment
Picture in Picture Mode (PRO):
- Floating speedometer overlay works with any app
- Monitor your speed while using navigation or music apps
- Fully resizable and repositionable window
INTELLIGENT ALERTS:
Speed Limit Detection (PRO):
- Automatic speed limit recognition for your current road
- Smart alerts when approaching or exceeding limits
- Global coverage with intelligent road inference
- Customizable warning thresholds and notification sounds
Speed Camera Alerts (PRO):
- Alerts for fixed, red light, combined, and section control cameras
- Cameras shown on the map as you drive
- On-screen banner when approaching a camera
- Live average speed and progress inside section control zones
- Choose voice announcements, alert sounds, or both
- Powered by the SCDB.info database
- Coverage across Europe, UK, USA, Australia, and Brazil
Performance Tracking:
- G-Force acceleration and braking analysis
- Enhanced altitude tracking with pressure sensors
- Moving vs. stationary time breakdowns
- Maximum and average speed calculations
HANDS-FREE & LIVE ACTIVITY:
- Start, stop, and control recording with Siri, Shortcuts, and Control Center (iOS 18)
- Live speed on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
ENTERTAINMENT INTEGRATION:
- Built-in Apple Music controls and display
- Current song information without app switching
- Seamless music playback during your drives
PERSONALIZATION OPTIONS:
- Multiple color themes to match your style
- Flexible unit system: KM/H, MPH, or nautical knots
- Various display layouts and orientations
- Dark mode and auto-brightness support
- Adjustable speedometer scales and ranges
- Left or right-handed speedometer positioning
- Portrait and landscape with rotation lock
PRO SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES:
- Full trip details with route maps and statistics
- Trip statistics with personal records and streaks
- GPX route export for sharing and backup
- Road-based speed limit detection with alerts
- Speed camera alerts with voice and sound
- Picture in Picture floating speedometer
- Weather forecasts and current conditions
- Premium color themes and custom app icons
FREE FEATURES:
- Core speedometer and basic trip computer
- Standard HUD mode
- Map view with position tracking
- Unlimited trip saving and recording
- Essential customization options
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
- Free download with core features always available
- Optional PRO subscription for premium capabilities
- Cancel anytime through App Store account settings
- Payment charged to Apple ID upon purchase confirmation
- Auto-renewal unless cancelled 24 hours before period ends
- Manage subscriptions via your App Store account
IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS:
- GPS/Location Services required for speed tracking
- Not compatible with WiFi-only iPad models
- GPS accuracy depends on signal strength and environment
- Best performance in open areas with clear sky visibility
- Continuous GPS usage affects battery life
- Never operate device while driving - safety first!
Rate and Review:
Your feedback helps us improve and develop new features.
Share your experience on the App Store!
Terms of Use: https://speedtracker.app/terms

Features include:
• Stay connected to the best local news, sports, entertainment, commentary and beyond.
• Browse the Toronto Sun, Ottawa Sun, Edmonton Sun, Calgary Sun, The Province and Canoe brands seamlessly.
• You will be prompted to choose your preferred publications when you first open the new app, ensuring a curated news feed that aligns with your interests.
• Use the Discover tab to explore trending stories from Postmedia newsrooms across Canada

Cut’em loose. Explore more. Track your dogs real time with Dogtra PATHFINDER2. The new PATHFINDER2 is NOT compatible with PATHFINDER series.
A feature packed new Dogtra PATHFINDER2 is a complete GPS tracking system with a FREE real time tracking and training app with FREE map, trailing up to 21 dogs concurrently within a 9-mile range. (Range may vary depending on terrain and your surroundings)

The Dogtra PATHFINDER2 app requires the Dogtra PATHFINDER2 system to operate.
The Dogtra PATHFINDER2 app works with iOS 14.0 and up with Bluetooth 5.0.
The Dogtra PATHFINDER2 app works with Apple Watch series 5 and up.

bluejetty:00137997:ios.description:
Welcome to Marble Crush - Zumba Master, an addictive marble bubble shooter game that provides endless entertainment and relaxation for players of all ages. With over 3000 captivating levels and a variety of challenging puzzles, you'll be immersed in a vibrant jungle world bursting with traps and trickery waiting to be uncoverd. What's even better? You can play the marble bubble shooter game offline!
Embark on an exhilarating adventure with the all-new marble shoot game! We’ve taken the classic mable shooting experience and infused it with a fresh twist, introducing innovative goal types and a plethora of ball varieties to elevate your marble matching journey. Get ready to be captivated by a game that’s both familiar and refreshingly novel.
Exciting Goal Types:
- Clear Mode: Experience the ultimate challenge in this mode, where your goal is to eliminate every single marble ball on the screen. This mode requires precision, strategy, and quick reflexes to clear the board and win.
- Survival Mode: Keep the marble balls at bay and maintain your cool as you navigate through relentless waves, aiming to survive for set periods of time. How long can you last?
- Collect Mode: Dive into levels where your objective transcends mere survival. Target specific marble balls and achieve set goals to progress. Every level brings a new challenge and a unique goal to strive for.
Rich and Diverse Marble Ball Types:
We’ve significantly expanded the Zumba universe with an array of new marble ball types, each with its own unique properties and challenges. From explosive balls that clear surrounding spheres to bird ball, butterfly ball and magic ball etc., your shooting strategy and reflexes will be put to the test. Discover and master the quirks of each marble ball type to become a marble master.
Key Features of Marble Crush - Zumba Master:
- Innovative Gameplay: Experience the beloved marble shoot gameplay with added layers of strategy and excitement.
- Diverse Challenges: With clear, survival and collect mode, each level offers a new challenge to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.
- Variety of Marble Ball Types: Adapt your strategy as you encounter different marble balls with unique behaviors.
- Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in beautifully designed levels and captivating visual effects.

Mahjong Titan is the classic mahjong matching game. This premium quality game is your perfect match for playing some relaxing mahjong. Enjoyed by millions of players for over 10 years!
Mahjong Solitaire is one of the most popular board games in the world. The simple rules and relaxing game play means that anyone can enjoy a round of Mahjong Titan. Your goal is to remove every tile by matching pairs of identical Mahjong tiles. Perfect for kids, adults and seniors.

• A new Mahjong board a day!
• 8 large, high quality tile sets.
• 8 backgrounds.
• Play offline without wifi!
• Optimized for portrait mode.
• Fun goals to master.
• 1080p HD Graphics.
This free board game is also known as Mah Jong, Majong and Mahjongg. In Mahjong Solitaire Titan you match pairs of identical Mahjong tiles.

bluejetty:00175032:ios.description:
Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to convenience with Barcodes - the ultimate digital wallet! Barcodes is the privacy-friendly solution to store and manage all your QR codes, barcodes, loyalty cards, reward cards, and gym membership tags in one place.
With Barcodes, you can easily scan and store your cards using your device's camera or import them directly from your photo library - even screenshots will work seamlessly! Plus, with iCloud storage and sync, you can access your cards across all your devices without needing a separate account.
Key Features:
- Digital wallet to safely store your cards
- Automatic card scanning using your device's camera
- Effortless import from your photo library and screenshots
- iCloud storage and sync for easy access across devices
- Customizable card colors and symbols, with supported store logos
- Home screen and lock screen widgets for quick card access
- Add cards to Apple Wallet with optional location support
- Apple Watch companion app for on-the-go convenience
- Store 3 cards forever for free (including Apple Wallet and Apple Watch integration)
- Dark mode support for a sleek look
Barcodes Unlimited Features:
- Store an unlimited number of cards in your wallet
- Organize cards into folders and share with family or friends via iCloud
- Choose once-off lifetime purchase or subscription to suit you
- Choose from a variety of app icons to suit your style
Terms of Use can be found at https://smallcolossus.com/terms and Privacy Policy can be found at https://smallcolossus.com/privacy.
Happy scanning!

bluejetty:00065231:ios.name: Precious Coin Tester
bluejetty:00065231:ios.summary:
Is that gold or silver coin real? Tap it, let it ring, and Precious Coin Tester tells you.
A fake can be made to the right weight and size. Getting the sound right is much harder: how a coin rings depends on its metal, right through to its
bluejetty:00065231:ios.description:
Is that gold or silver coin real? Tap it, let it ring, and Precious Coin Tester tells you.
A fake can be made to the right weight and size. Getting the sound right is much harder: how a coin rings depends on its metal, right through to its core. Precious Coin Tester knows how each genuine coin should sound at its exact weight and size, and compares your coin's ring with it. That's how the ping test catches what a surface check misses, such as plated fakes and tungsten cores. Judging a ping by ear takes years of practice. The app listens for you.
WHY COLLECTORS AND STACKERS USE IT
• 43,000+ gold and silver coins: search by name, nickname or face value
• 650+ coins free to test, no subscription needed
• Minimum purity estimate for most coins
• Each coin's metal value at current gold and silver prices
• Custom coins: enter weight, diameter and fineness for anything not in the database
• Favourites saved to your account and synced across your devices
• No acid, no chemicals, no scratch plate, no extra kit
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick the exact coin you're holding. The app can't see your coin: it compares the sound with the coin you pick.
2. Balance it on a fingertip near your phone's microphone and tap it with a hard object.
3. Hold still while it rings. Wait for the sound to fade before tapping again.
Video tutorial: https://youtu.be/iWIJ7Ke50-M
More tips: https://www.preciouscointester.com/en/academy/best-practices
WE STAND BEHIND OUR RESULTS
Report a wrong result and you can win a reward. The top reward, $200, is for a wrong 3-star result. Details: https://www.preciouscointester.com/en/challenges/report-and-win
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe to unlock the full database and custom coins. Invite friends to earn Precious Points, which also unlock coins. The subscription renews automatically; cancel any time in your App Store account settings.
QUESTIONS OR IDEAS?
We read every message: preciouscointester@gmail.com
Website: https://www.preciouscointester.com/en/
Results are for information only. Any decision based on them is at your own risk.

bluejetty:00021347:ios.name: AarogyaSetu 2.0
bluejetty:00021347:ios.summary:
Aarogya Setu 2.0 – Bharat ka Health App fulfilling All Your Health & Wellness Needs
Aarogya Setu, India’s most widely used digital health app during the COVID-19 pandemic, has now evolved into Aarogya Setu 2.0 — a comprehensive One Health
bluejetty:00021347:ios.description:
Aarogya Setu 2.0 – Bharat ka Health App fulfilling All Your Health & Wellness Needs
Aarogya Setu, India’s most widely used digital health app during the COVID-19 pandemic, has now evolved into Aarogya Setu 2.0 — a comprehensive One Health App designed to smartly manage health, wellness, medical records, insurance, and family care all in one place.
Repurposed by the National Health Authority (NHA), the app now connects every citizen seamlessly to the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), giving you secure access to health records, healthcare providers, government schemes, and digital services on your phone.
Aarogya Setu 2.0 is built to be your everyday AI based smart health companion — whether you want to track wellness, find nearby health services, make faster OPD registration, access medical history, or manage insurance claims.
Key Features:
• ABHA Creation: Create and Login your ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) seamlessly through Aadhaar face authentication.
• Access health records from any ABDM-enabled facility
• Generate Smart Report and AI driven health insights to view trends and track health status by uploading health records to secure, government-approved health storage - DigiLocker for personal and family health management.
• Seamless sharing of health records with healthcare providers
• Smart devices integration (smart watches, smart scales, CGM, etc.)
• Reminders and Alerts for medicines, and upcoming appointments
• View CGHS and CAPF empanelled hospitals, treatment details, and wallet balances for family members, through NHCX (similar to PMJAY)
• Quick “Scan and Share” for OPD registration at ABDM enabled hospitals, clinics, and labs.
• Digital payments for health services at registered facilities through “Scan and Pay”
• View Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) empanelled hospitals, treatment details, and wallet balances for family members through National Health Claim Exchange (NHCX)
• Manage your Family’s health at one place by adding your family member to your account.
• Consent-based sharing of health records at ABDM-enabled facilities
• Discover doctors, laboratories, hospitals, and blood banks and blood availability anywhere in India.

bluejetty:00062813:ios.description:
Over 295,000 translations • Conjugates thousands of German and English verbs • Hundreds of usage notes and examples • No internet connection required
"For serious language students and translators who are looking for more precision." - The New York Times
Featured by Apple as "What's Hot"
Ultralingua makes apps for people who love languages. You can count on our German-English dictionary to provide all the content you need, along with extra features that help you get the most out of the dictionary. Use our verb conjugation tool to find complete conjugations of thousands of verbs in all standard forms, and the number translator to convert numerals into German or English text instantly.
DICTIONARY:
• Over 95,000 entries with 295,000 translations
• Tap-and-hold any word or phrase and choose "Speak" from the popup menu to hear that word spoken using Apple's built-in text-to-speech feature.
• Noun genders
• Slang, technical language, and regional differences in spelling and usage
• Hundreds of usage notes about troublesome constructions
• Smart search results in case you misspell or mistype
• Search-as-you-go displays words and narrows your selection as you type
VERBS:
• Conjugations for thousands of German and English verbs
• Includes all standard tenses and forms
• Smart search finds infinitives and catches misspellings
• Must-have reference tool for any student or language professional
• Conjugate a verb from the dictionary results by tapping it
MORE:
• Translate numerals into German and English text with the number tool
• Language swapper button to switch from German-English to English-German
• Tap the history button to view the 50 most recent dictionary definitions, verb conjugations, and more in one place. Sort the list alphabetically or by date, and choose to clear the list completely or delete one entry at a time.
• No internet connection required
• Change your device settings to view the app display in English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, or German
REVIEWS:
"Offers both a comprehensive German-English dictionary as well as verb conjugations. This app is worth every penny." -User review
View our reviews below to see why users love this app, and remember to let us know what you think!
This universal app will run on iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch, so you can purchase it once and load it onto all your devices. The iPad and iPhone/iPod touch versions look and behave differently to give you a great experience on every device you own. The interface will change, but you’ll always have the same outstanding language data and tools inside.
Dictionaries are available from Ultralingua for many languages, including combinations of English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, and more. See what else we have to offer by searching for Ultralingua in the App Store.

bluejetty:00184159:ios.name: CSB MOBILENET
bluejetty:00184159:ios.summary: CSB MOBILENET is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by
bluejetty:00184159:ios.description:
CSB MOBILENET is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CSB MOBILENET:
 -Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 -Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 -Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts
 -Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the CSB MOBILENET app, you must be enrolled as a Citizens State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00013710:ios.description:
Somali Quran recitation, known as Qur'an Xafidah, incorporates unique intonations, rhythms, and pauses. This style reflects the cultural and linguistic influences of the Somali language on the recitation of the Quran.
Explore our iOS Quran app, designed for easy access to the Holy Quran on Apple devices. Our Somali Quran application is designed in an English format, making it accessible and user-friendly for individuals who are not familiar with the Arabic language. The Holy Quran consists of 30 Juz (parts) and 114 Suras (chapters).
The Quran in Somali Language has been predominantly oral, passed down through generations of Quran teachers (known as "Ustaads") to their students. This oral tradition has preserved not only the words of the Quran but also the specific intonations and melodies associated with Somali Quran recitation.
The Somali language's phonetic and tonal characteristics influence the way verses of Quran are recited. While Somali translation recitation has its own unique style, it adheres to the principles of Tajweed.
Reciting the sacred books of the Muslims is a duty that all Muslims should attempt to fulfill. It allows devout followers within the religion to gain inner peace, rewards, and approval from Allah.
Studying Tafsir enables you to grasp the Quran’s messages and deeper meanings. Understanding the words of our creator brings us nearer to Him, as expressed in the Quranic verse.
DAILY VERSES
● After setting the reminder, you’ll get daily notifications to read your daily Quran verses.
QURAN VIDEOS
● Here you can find many Quran videos available.
WALLPAPERS
● A wide variety of beautiful wallpapers are available.
QUOTES
● We have Quran quotes in the form of images and text.
MY LIBRARY
● My library has all the highlighted verses, notes, and bookmarks that you make.
CALENDAR
● Contains all the festival dates.
VERSE GRAPHICS
● Quranic verses with images are available; select and share them with friends and family on social media.

bluejetty:00128511:ios.description:
Advantages of the Pro version:
**Ad-Free Experience**
**7 additional board layouts**
**Randomize the board. Mix up the DL, DW, TL TW tiles and give the game a new twist**
**Option to enable the hints feature (Valid words appear above the rack as you form them by moving the tiles)**
Word Master is an innovative version of the traditional “Crosswords" board puzzle.
Not needing internet connection, using unique fast artificial intelligence resources and with highly customizable options, Word Master is used by crossword games enthusiasts for quick offline training and induce the players to improve their skills and reasoning in the game.
Create words with the 7 letters on your rack and place them on the 15 by 15 tile board. Boost your score by placing letters on the special Double Letter, Double Word, Triple Letter and Triple Word tiles.
Languages supported:
• English
• French (Français)
• Portuguese (Português)
• German (Deutsch)
• Spanish (Español)
• Italian (Italiano)
• Dutch (Nederlands)
• Norwegian (Norsk)
• Swedish (Svenska)
• Romanian(Romana)
• Greek(Ελληνικά)
• Polish (Polski)
• Catalan(Català)
PLAY AGAINST THE COMPUTER
Choose the level and the duration of the game. No more waiting long hours for your opponent to play! Both computer and player tiles are randomly selected, simulating in the best way possible a game against a real opponent.
PASS N' PLAY
Play offline against friends! In the bus, airport, train or whatever place you are.
CHALLENGE MODE
Find out if you are a true hampion. In this mode, you score more points in each turn as you come closer to the best possible word. Try to beat your high scores!
IMPROVE YOUR PERFORMANCE WITH THE MASTER
After each turn, you will be able to see which words you could have played. Learn how to use the bonus squares on the board and the standards for the formation of words. 
ENRICH YOUR VOCABULARY WITH WORD DEFINITIONS
Swipe your finger across any word on the board and get its dictionary definition. (Internet required)
DESIGN YOUR OWN BOARD
Use your creativity to place the bonus squares just where you want them to be.
MORE FEATURES: 
• Do not waste your time searching whether the word you chose exists! As you place the word on the board, the game will display whether the word is or not valid and its score.
• Get tips for valid words being created in your rack as you are arranging your letters (You can enable or disable this feature at any time). 
• Save your game and resume later.
• Keep track of your records and stats (e.g. best final score, best word ever played, total bingos and more).
• Choose from various board layouts, including random. 
• Block the droid from using very rare words.
• Bad draw helper (avoid receiving a rack with no consonants or no vowels).
• Two dictionaries in English available

Word Master is an innovative version of the traditional “Crosswords" board puzzle.
Not needing internet connection, using unique fast artificial intelligence resources and with highly customizable options, Word Master is used by crossword games enthusiasts for quick offline training and induce the players to improve their skills and reasoning in the game.
Create words with the 7 letters on your rack and place them on the 15 by 15 tile board. Boost your score by placing letters on the special Double Letter, Double Word, Triple Letter and Triple Word tiles.
Languages supported:
• English
• French (Français)
• Portuguese (Português)
• German (Deutsch)
• Spanish (Español)
• Italian (Italiano)
• Dutch (Nederlands)
• Norwegian (Norsk)
• Swedish (Svenska)
• Romanian(Romana)
• Greek(Ελληνικά)
• Polish (Polski)
• Catalan(Català)

PLAY AGAINST THE COMPUTER
Choose the level and the duration of the game. No more waiting long hours for your opponent to play! Both computer and player tiles are randomly selected, simulating in the best way possible a game against a real opponent.

PASS N' PLAY
Play offline against friends! In the bus, airport, train or whatever place you are.

CHALLENGE MODE
Find out if you are a true hampion. In this mode, you score more points in each turn as you come closer to the best possible word. Try to beat your high scores!

IMPROVE YOUR PERFORMANCE WITH THE MASTER
After each turn, you will be able to see which words you could have played. Learn how to use the bonus squares on the board and the standards for the formation of words. 

ENRICH YOUR VOCABULARY WITH WORD DEFINITIONS
Swipe your finger across any word on the board and get its dictionary definition. (Internet required)

DESIGN YOUR OWN BOARD
Use your creativity to place the bonus squares just where you want them to be.

MORE FEATURES: 
• Do not waste your time searching whether the word you chose exists! As you place the word on the board, the game will display whether the word is or not valid and its score.
• Get tips for valid words being created in your rack as you are arranging your letters (You can enable or disable this feature at any time). 
• Save your game and resume later.
• Keep track of your records and stats (e.g. best final score, best word ever played, total bingos and more).
• Choose from various board layouts, including random. 
• Block the droid from using very rare words.
• Bad draw helper (avoid receiving a rack with no consonants or no vowels).
•  Two dictionaries in English available

bluejetty:00127021:ios.description:
94FEETOFGAME Basketball Training App offers an inside look into the exact training drills and workouts Phil Handy has done with the likes of Steve Nash, Harrison Barnes, Jewell Loyd and a variety of other stars.
Phil Handy is known as the “OG” in basketball for a reason when it comes to basketball training. His training techniques are imprinted on the game of basketball that we all know, watch, and love today. The app was designed for basketball coaches, trainers, parents, and players of all ages to train just like a pro athlete anytime, anywhere, at home.
Phil Handy has always promoted the fundamentals for the game of basketball and strives to pave the way for the next generation of players, trainers, and coaches.
BALL HANDLING
The app offers over 60 unique ball handling drills and workouts used by the pros that can be practiced at home to elevate your game to the next level.
SHOOTING
Learn the expert advice Phil Handy has shared with his players to make them the most unguardable athletes on the planet. Shooting drills, shooting workouts, and shooting tips shared directly from Phil Handy.
DRILL OF THE DAY
Receive 1 unique new basketball drill to practice each day on the app. The drills will focus on ball handling, shooting, footwork, finishing, post moves, breakdown handles, and more.
STRENGTH & CONDITIONING
Access a library of over 50 unique strength and conditioning drills and workouts to help take your game to the next level. To become a complete athlete, one must also focus on at-home workouts. These drills focus on agility, balance, core strength, durability, flexibility, and explosiveness. Learn the proper way to train to increase your vertical leap and speed on the basketball court.
DEFENSE
Basketball is a two-way sport. Defense is crucial in the game. Phil Handy teaches you a variety of defensive basketball drills that will help you become the best defender possible.
AT HOME WORKOUT LADDER SERIES
At home basketball cardio workouts. Phil Handy challenges you to complete the first basketball fitness ball handling workout. Follow along and complete the entire 17 drill basketball circuit. This is a great way to improve your ball handling, but also your cardio at home.
COACHING TIPS
Phil Handy gives basketball coaches and trainers personal tips and advice on how to become a better coach on and off the court. Learn how to develop the proper pregame mindset going into a game, in game preparation, and more directly from Phil Handy. As a coach, take a look at the drills inside the app to create basketball workouts for your players.
94FEETOFGAME basketball skills training is for use by any basketball player who wants to improve and become complete. The focus is on instructing basketball players on how to be skilled, crafty and FUNDAMENTALLY SOUND. It is the mission of Phil Handy to provide the best basketball training workout program to fully meet the instructional needs of all coaches, trainers and players. In addition to providing an excellent value, the basketball training program has an unmatched basketball atmosphere that will add enjoyment for you in using the app.
Here’s your chance to train and practice with Phil Handy who has trained/coached some of the greatest players to ever play basketball. The 94FEETOFGAME app is for any player, trainer, coach, or parent who wants to gain detailed knowledge on the game of basketball.
7 DAYS COMPLETELY FREE
The app offers a 7-day free trial. The monthly subscription is $9.99/mo after the 7-day free trial ends.
Read our full Terms of Service at https://www.94feetofgameapp.com/tos and our Privacy Policy at https://www.94feetofgame.com/privacy

Earn points when you perform endos and complete Wheelie King 4: Moto Challenge without crashing up. Use these points to upgrade and customize paint, decals, and other parts of your vehicle. Get chased by the police and make a high-speed score when playing these thrilling motorbike games. Try your hard to win in these biker games and discover valuable strategies to succeed in these dirt bike wheelie games. Play as much as you want in these free motorbike challenge games
Dive into the world of freestyle stunts and challenge of nitro bike drift game
Download this motorcycle stunt racing game, hold on to the clutch and do freestyle stunts
Upgrade your helmet, bikes and customize your uncontrollable bike in this bike simulator game
Sit on your uncontrollable bike and try to win each speed king level with ease
Make a new high score each time you do freestyle stunts and complete the challenge of nitro bike drift game

Download this uncontrollable bike game and perform wheelie bike missions for free. Put on your helmet and go on a wheelie drive such as city free ride, stunt area wheelie ride, stunt area moto challenge, 1-mile speed king challenge, and much more. Complete moto online challenge to unlock more drives, functionalities, and everyday tasks. Check your top speed and global ranking to improve your wheelie racing and become the best bike simulator. Some unique features of this game are:
Earn points when you pick up passengers and deliver packages
Upgrade and customize paint, decals, and parts 
Set the low high ultra-graphics setting
Use the help of clutch, brake, throttle, speed, map
Player bike gallery feature to stay along with trend
Get points to unlock bike, challenges, and tracks
Why this app?
This motorcycle stunt racing game is specially designed for motorbike games lovers and bike simulator experts. Earn extra rewards to improve your ranking when you play these biker games daily. Use that rewards and points to upgrade parts and customize your vehicle, such as helmets, bike parts, wheelie bike skin, etc. With this unique and free challenge of nitro bike drift game, get your hands on moto challenge and wheelie racing now!

bluejetty:00178719:ios.description:
KyPass is designed for users who demand the highest level of security for their personal data.
It is fully compatible with the open-source KeePass Password Safe database format, allowing you to manage your credentials securely and efficiently across all your devices.
Secure Sync and Backup
Your encrypted database can be stored and synchronized using:
• iCloud Drive
• Dropbox
• Google Drive
• OneDrive (personal and business)
• SFTP
• Any WebDAV-compatible cloud service
Powerful and Complete
KyPass stores all your sensitive information — usernames, passwords, URLs, notes, and more — in a single, encrypted database.
Entries are organized into groups, and the built-in search lets you find what you need instantly.
Exclusive Features
• Tree view navigation (ideal on iPad)
• Full field reference support
• Complete history management (view and maintain previous versions)
• Recycle Bin support
• Folder selection for Dropbox and WebDAV
• Attachment support (read and write)
And Also
• Multi-cloud synchronization across all your devices
• Safari and third-party browser integration
• Advanced password generator with smart character rules
• KDBX4 support
• External keyboard compatibility
• Local WebDAV browser for direct imports
• Download database directly from a URL
• Touch ID or PIN protection (securely stores the master key in iOS Keychain)
• One-Time Password (OTP) support
• Barcode sharing for entries
• Detailed entry information including creation, modification, and expiry dates
KyPass is powerful enough to replace your desktop password manager, yet simple enough to use anywhere.
Discover the most complete and secure KeePass-compatible app for iPhone and iPad.

bluejetty:00024925:ios.description:

Kido Ice Cream is a fun and interactive ice cream making game created especially for kids.
Children can mix ingredients, choose flavors, decorate cones, and create delicious ice cream treats — all in a safe, ad-free environment designed for young players.
Make Ice Cream From Scratch
In this cooking game, kids can:
• Mix ingredients and prepare ice cream

• Decorate with fun and colorful toppings
• Enjoy imaginative play without any real-world mess
All the joy of making ice cream, made easy for kids.
Creative Dessert Play
With many combinations to choose from, kids can:
• Experiment with different flavors
• Decorate ice cream their own way
• Express creativity through simple, playful steps
Every ice cream creation is unique.

At Kido Games, we create safe, creative, and high-quality digital experiences for children.
Our games encourage imagination and independent play while always keeping children’s safety as the top priority.

bluejetty:00062761:ios.description:
**Strengthen your internal sense of rhythm.**
Time Guru is the only metronome that periodically goes silent—randomly, in patterns, or both—so you discover whether you rush, drag, or lose your place.
**Random & Pattern Muting**
Set any percentage of random muting to test your timekeeping. Or create sequenced muting patterns. Or combine both. You'll quickly learn where your time falls apart—and strengthen it.
**Complex Meter Sequences**
Build unlimited chains of shifting meters: 4/4 -> 7/8 -> 3/4 -> 11/16 -> 4/4 -> 3/8. Meters go up to 16/x, patterns have no length limit, and you can rearrange them with drag-and-drop.
**Gradual Tempo Changes**
Automatically speed up or slow down over time—perfect for building technique.
**Practice Timer**
Set the metronome to stop after a specified duration.
**Also includes:**
• 35 loud, clear sound sets
• Drum machine-style rhythmic patterns
• Voice counting in English, Chinese, French, German & Russian
• Tap tempo (5–300 BPM)
• iCloud backup and sync
• Light and dark themes
• Full VoiceOver accessibility
• Rock-solid timing via custom audio engine
Developed by Avi Bortnick and Adam Bellard

- Train your mind by so
bluejetty:00114824:ios.description:
Many games charge for not forcing You to watch ads. This one doesn't. This game is dedicated to not interrupt Your gameplay with ads.
Enjoy this experience by going with the flow and solving even the hardest levels!
- Train your mind by sorting colors, simply tap one vial to select it and then another vial to pour.
- Start from very easy levels and progress into more challenging ones.
- Many game modes: tall vials, short vials, mystery vials, blocked color.
- Play offline.
- Discover many different modes: mystery mode, tall vials mode, standard mode with 0 to 2 empty vials at the beginning. 
- There is an algorithm that ensures each level is solvable without using any additional segments, so obtaining a segment - and therefore waiting 60 seconds is never forced on the player.
- There is an infinite number of levels, as they are procedurally generated.
- Big icons, suitable for seniors.
- Undo move and reset level as many times as You want.
- ASMR water pouring sounds.
- Similiar to ball sort game variation.
- Hard mode, challenging even for adults.
- There are nice fruit icons, so people with color blindness can also play this game. This is very important to me, as I have a color blind close family member.
- High contrast mode for those who prefer someting even more visible than fruit icons.
- There is a possibility to see a solution for every level, this proves solvability.
No forced ads play is the best play!

bluejetty:00092333:ios.description:
SportSocial is a pickup soccer app designed to change the way players connect and play the game. 
Our main goal is to connect players on and off the field by providing them with highly competitive and well-organized pickup games where they can share their love for the game and become part of a community. 
We take care of everything (Rent the field, organize the game, confirm all the players, setup the teams, provide the equipment, etc). All you have to do is SIGN UP, SHOW UP and PLAY! 
Here are some value-added services we offer to make sure we host the BEST PICKUPS IN TOWN!
• Team Captains: All our games are run by one of our team captains. They ensure that the games are run properly and that everyone has a good time.
• Game Coordinators: We have a team behind the scenes coordinating all the logistics (teams, players, equipment, field rental, rewards, etc.) to ensure our players have an outstanding experience.
• Reward System: Earn points for every game you play and exchange them for rewards directly on the app. Get free games, shirts, bags and much more!
• Equipment: We provide ALL the equipment. Our games are run with top-of-the-line equipment such as small goals, professional grade balls, branded bibs and much more.
• Community: Become part of our community. We host several gatherings to promote our community values and connect our players.
Come join the best pickups in town and become part of something bigger!

bluejetty:00064008:ios.name: Robbery Madness 2: Stealth FPS
bluejetty:00064008:ios.summary: Become a thief, a robber sneaking his way to the shiny loot. Overcome security systems, hack them and exploit them. Use tools like a snake cam and see what is hidden behind the closed doors. Avoid guards, outsmart them, use stealth, or take
bluejetty:00064008:ios.description:
Become a thief, a robber sneaking his way to the shiny loot. Overcome security systems, hack them and exploit them. Use tools like a snake cam and see what is hidden behind the closed doors. Avoid guards, outsmart them, use stealth, or take them down with sneak attack. Find secret rooms, find and steal loot in treasure chests. Visit Black Market and exchange your hard stolen money for the equipment for your burglar.
Robbery Madness is a FPS (First Person Shooter) heist and thief simulator game focused on action and stealth with RPG elements, With tons of funny elements and an amazing cartoon low poly graphics. 
In the role of the thief master, you will be robbing various places and stealing a lot of unique items. 
PLACES
HOUSE
This is the best heist to start your thief career. This little house offers a lot of loot for inexperienced robbers and much more for the seasoned thieves. But first, you have to avoid the security system. You don’t want to trigger an alarm and attract cops, right? Also try to avoid that nasty robo dog. And one more thing, try to avoid the cellar, some burglars say that there is something evil hiding inside and not the rats this time.
MALL
This is the beloved place of each robber. A lot of shops, nice big corridors, clean toilets and a lot of loot to steal, an ideal heist. But also a lot of security cameras and guards. Fortunately each Mall has an extensive ventilation system, robbers love those. This place is unique in some way, there are rumors that there is hidden secret military technology and much more.
MUSEUM
This would be a lovely heist. There are so many things to see, to learn and to steal. All those statues, stones, crystals and glass showcases. Each museum has a very good security system and a lot of guards, this one is no exception. The ideal for the stealth master. Anyway be careful with breaking showcases, it can attract guards. Try to use a ventilation system and be careful with sneaking around the guards, some of them have guns.
MALL-Z
This heist is unlocked only for the best thieves in the city.
Do you remember the Mall mentioned above? This is the same place, but in the reality of a zombie apocalypse. The Mall you knew before doesn’t exist, it is ruined, destroyed during the war and now zombies are roaming everywhere. There is not much to steal, burglars already took everything. In this reality, water, food and toilet papers are the most valuable assets. Fortunately there are weapons, ammo, frag grenades and mines hidden as well. Forget about sneaking, find those weapons and use them!
NIGHT CITY
This place serves to you as a city map and hideout or sanctuary for your burglar. Here you can plan and to start your next heist. Also this is the place where you can access Black Market and Inventory.
CHALLENGING STEALTH ACTION
Be the stealth master, a sneaky burglar, hidden in the shadow, sneak your way to the shiny loot and treasures and steal them. Avoid the guards, take them down with a sneak attack.
Avoid security cameras, hack them and use them to spy the area and to distract the guards. Use various hiding places like bushes, trash cans, barrels or toilets if you like. Use the spy cam to see what is hidden behind the closed doors. Setup traps like mines to get rid of guards.
Unlock the closed doors and treasure chests in a lockpicking mini game. This thief simulator has it all.
CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTY - CHOOSE YOU CHALLENGE
This game offers: Easy, Normal, Hard and Madness difficulty.
The harder the game is, the better reward you get. Including extra content, loo, enemies, treasure chests, secret places and fun.
BLACK MARKET
The best place to get the best thief tools and equipment in the city. Offering tools like Hacking Kit, Spy Cam, Lockpicks, Sensors, Master keys and more. Buy Gadgets like Stun grenades and Stun mines. And of course the clothing and boosters to increase your burglar attributes like stealth, speed and health attributes.

Straight from the depths of Dungeon, MuAwaY mobile has arrived! Become a medieval warrior, make new friends, demonstrate all your skills, conquer the Arenas and leave your mark in our history!
Choose one of our four available classes: Dark Wizard, Dark Knight, Fairy Elf or Magic Gladiator and fight against thousands of players online in this unique fantasy world! Collect items, evolve your character and conquer continents. Join this exciting adventure through the world of MuAwaY today!
MuAwaY is a medieval fantasy 3D MMORPG, available since 2007 for computers and now receives its mobile version with fully remade and optimized controls for any screen size of your smartphones.
▶ EVERYTHING ON THE PC, IS ALSO AVAILABLE ON MOBILE ◀
All systems have been remade and adapted for mobile, so you don't miss anything, such as: TRADE SYSTEM, GUILD, PARTY, PVP, EVENTS, and many others.
▶ REWARDING SYSTEM - BOX OF REWARD ◀
Evolve and earn the best items in the game for free by playing, through our master reset system, which will reward you with the Boxs of Reward, available in 4 editions.
▶ MODERN INTERFACE ◀
The interface has been completely redesigned, totally thought for you to enjoy the best gaming experience possible.
▶ BALANCED GAMEPLAY ◀
It's not because you're on the phone and your friend is on the computer that any of you will have a disadvantage. The mobile version is meant to be cross-platform balanced. In both PC and Mobile the only difference between victory and defeat will always be your HABILITY.
▶ SECURITY ◀
The exclusive security that MuAwaY already offers to our PC players will also be present in our mobile version.

Choose which kind of event you like the most or are lucky with, we have daily mata-matas, pega-pegas, maratonas de guilds, maratonas de players, caça ao tesouro, esconde-esconde and many others.

bluejetty:00157424:ios.summary:

Every tool you need to manage shift work is in one app, ensuring the smoothness
bluejetty:00157424:ios.description:
Camelo Employee Scheduling App: Shift Work Made Easier. 
Camelo is a better way to schedule, connect, and manage your team. Anywhere. Anytime. On any device.
Every tool you need to manage shift work is in one app, ensuring the smoothness of your business operations and workplace communication.
HOW MANAGERS CAN USE CAMELO:
- Create, edit, and publish staff schedules
- Schedule staff and find replacements based on availability, skills, and roles
- See who’s working, where they're working, and what they’re working on
- Let employees select open shifts and swap shifts for more flexibility
- Manage all leave and time off requests
- Communicate with the team in real-time: send and receive announcements, messages, work information
- Save labor records and stay compliant
- Record, approve, and export timesheets for accurate payroll
HOW STAFF CAN USE CAMELO:
- Receive instant notifications on new work schedules, updates, tasks, and information
- Receive reminders on all upcoming shifts and tasks
- Access and view work schedules from anywhere
- Clock in and clock out from any device
- Add and update availability
- Select open shifts and swap shifts with coworkers
- Submit leave and time-off requests via the app
- Chat with coworkers in real-time in 1-on-1 or group chats
WHAT CUSTOMERS SAY ABOUT CAMELO
"Finally, we don't have to be drowned in endless piles of paper schedules anymore. My team members are notified whenever there are changes in the schedule. No one misses their shifts anymore."
"All of my staff's shifts, tasks, and time-off requests are in one place—my phone. Managing my staff has become easier with just a few swipes and touches on the screen."
"My staff can now update their availability, claim shifts, and swap shifts quickly. Rostering is no longer a burden to me."
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
