bluejetty:00151988:ios.name: Word Bond - Association Game
bluejetty:00151988:ios.summary: Word Bond - Association Game is the ultimate word connect and word association game that delivers endless fun! Perfect for fans of word puzzles, word sorting games, word search, and word matching games. Play anytime, anywhere — even offline
bluejetty:00151988:ios.description:
Word Bond - Association Game is the ultimate word connect and word association game that delivers endless fun! Perfect for fans of word puzzles, word sorting games, word search, and word matching games. Play anytime, anywhere — even offline!
Dive into addictive word connections that challenge your logic and vocabulary. Sort, connect, and discover hidden word associations across countless categories!
► How to Play This Word Association & Word Sorting Game:
-- Drag words to sort and group them by meaning, category, and logic.
-- Some word sets transform into image tiles — each tile represents a hidden word. 
-- Use smart word sorting strategies to complete all categories. 
► Game Feature Of This Word Association & Word Sorting Game:
-- Easy to play, hard to master — enjoy clear, logical word sort challenges that sharpen your brain.
-- Progressive difficulty — tricky categories and clever word connections to keep you thinking.
-- Tons of word association levels — addictive, satisfying word sorting puzzles with brilliant riddles.
-- Multiple associations — continue sorting and matching until all word groups are solved.
-- Relaxing experience — unwind with zen backgrounds and soothing music.
► How This Word Association & Word Sorting Game Can Help You: 
-- Improve logical thinking and memory. 
-- Expand your vocabulary with every word connection level.
-- Enhance word grouping skills with strategic word sorting.
-- A stress-free way to relax and focus.
-- Fun for all ages — play and socialize with friends and family!
Train your brain, sort words with strategy, and enjoy the most satisfying word association gameplay!
With clean graphics, relaxing design, and constantly evolving word connection puzzles, Word Bond is perfect for both casual players and true word masters.
Try Word Bond - Association Game now and become the king of word sorting & word connections!

By First Eagle Bank

First Eagle Mobile Banking is a free* service offered to all First Eagle Bank
bluejetty:00122737:ios.description:
First Eagle Bank – Mobile Banking
By First Eagle Bank
Manage your First Eagle Bank accounts anytime, anywhere from your iPhone® with First Eagle Mobile Banking. 
First Eagle Mobile Banking is a free* service offered to all First Eagle Bank Online Banking customers and provides a convenient and secure way to manage your money from your mobile device. The First Eagle Mobile Banking app provides access to your accounts using your existing online banking username and password.
FEATURES
• Check balances – See current account balances for all of your First Eagle Bank accounts
• View transactions – View both current day transactions and previous transaction history
• Transfer Funds – Transfer funds between eligible First Eagle Bank accounts
• Pay Bills – Schedule and cancel Bill Payments 
• Locate a First Eagle Branch – Locate the nearest First Eagle Bank Branch and/or ATM using built-in GPS location services or search by zip code and address
SECURITY 
First Eagle Mobile Banking safeguards your data transmissions using the same level of security as our Online Banking. Refer to our Customer Agreement for more information on the security measures provided by First Eagle Bank. 
GETTING STARTED
You must be a current First Eagle Bank Online Banking customer to use the mobile app. Sign-up or log into your account at www.febank.com and complete the Mobile Banking enrollment section under the Options tab. You will then receive instructions via text message to download and activate the mobile app.
ABOUT FIRST EAGLE BANK
First Eagle Bank is an entrepreneurial, independent bank, laser focused on developing long-lasting relationships with our customers, our community, and our staff. To learn more about First Eagle Bank, please visit www.febank.com .
*Your mobile carrier’s text messaging and web access charges may apply.
iPhone is a registered trademark of Apple, Inc.
First Eagle Bank, Member FDIC.

bluejetty:00019089:ios.name: Eternium
bluejetty:00019089:ios.summary:
Indie RPG made with passion by a handful of old-school RPG fans.
Eternium is an amazingly fun and beautifully crafted Action RPG, reminiscent of the great classics.
Eternium stands out from other mobile Action RPGs by its effortless “tap
bluejetty:00019089:ios.description:
Indie RPG made with passion by a handful of old-school RPG fans.
Eternium is an amazingly fun and beautifully crafted Action RPG, reminiscent of the great classics.
Eternium stands out from other mobile Action RPGs by its effortless “tap to move” and innovative “swipe to cast” controls, and its player-friendly “no paywalls, never pay to win” philosophy.
Drawing signs to cast spells is easy and rewarding. The tap-to-move control is more natural and relaxing than thumbsticks, and it’s also truer to the vintage point-and-click Action RPG experience.
The game can be really played for free, as more than 90% of our players do. Purchases are completely optional. Gems, the game’s main currency, can be collected from enemies and quests. There is no limiting stamina or energy. The best things in the game are obtained by playing, not paying.
With the exception of a couple of online-only features, the game can also be played offline after the content download completes.
Eternium initially launched in 2014, and is actively being improved by the original development team. Through years of polishing, and feedback from millions of players, the quality of the game has steadily increased, making it now one of the highest rated games on the App Store.
Enjoy the visceral satisfaction of responsive, fast-paced combat, with spectacular special effects, pleasing sounds, rewarding damage numbers, all set against immersive backdrops and atmospheric, inspiring music scores.
Play as a Mage, Warrior or Bounty Hunter, wielding a sword, axe, staff or gun. Level up to learn new abilities and increase your attributes.
Battle skeletons, zombies, automatons, aliens, demons, dragons and many other creatures, across four beautifully hand-crafted worlds, or in endless generated levels.
Venture into dark caves and dungeons, explore forests, villages and graveyards, lay siege to demon controlled castles, brave snowy mountain peaks, travel to the moon to slay strange creatures among craters and canyons, and beyond, to the deserts, pyramids and jungles of the red planet.
Open treasure chests to loot gold, gemstones and battle gear. Equip shiny breastplates, menacing helmets and hoods, spiked shoulder pads, mysterious cloaks or capes. Protect yourself with a shield, or choose to wield two weapons as a warrior.
Rescue your tank, healer and ranger companions who will join you in battle. Use their abilities together with yours to create rewarding and powerful tactical combos.
Experience a refreshing storyline, filled with interplanetary intrigue and seasoned with funny characters. Hunt your arch-enemy, Ragadam, across the worlds, while trying to uncover and undo his twisted plans.
Progress from common to rare, epic and legendary gear. Find gemstones that fit in your armor’s sockets. Craft socketed rings and amulets, and fuse three of them into a higher quality one.
Unleash awesome offensive abilities, such as Whirlwind, Shockwave, Arc Lightning or Immolate, control the enemy crowd with Frost Nova, Vortex, Silence, or sneak and assassinate with Smokescreen, Traps and Snipe.
Each hero class has access to about 20 abilities (skills or spells), and each of your three companions has four more. The game starts simple, but culminates in a flurry of tactical possibilities at high levels.
Once your hero reaches level 70, your experience points go into Champion Levels, which are unlimited and yield steady stat upgrades. Champion Levels are also inherited by your new heroes, so they will have an easier time growing up.
Aside from the four story acts, an endless progression of beautiful, randomly generated levels awaits in the Trials of Valor game mode.
Please see here for our Privacy Policy. We take privacy very seriously. http://www.makingfun.com/footer/privacy-policy/

REKT is a single player arcade experience that will have you on the edge of your seat. But if you want to test your skill take on other players on the global leaderboards!
Keep an eye out for future updates with more cars, arenas and challenges!

bluejetty:00025828:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on an exhilarating bubble-popping journey with Bubble Pop Go - the thrilling and addictive bubble shooter game that will keep you hooked for hours! Immerse yourself in its sleek controls, stunning graphics, and thousands of exciting levels, making Bubble Pop Go the ultimate bubble shooter experience.
How to play:
- Take aim and strategically match 3 or more bubbles to burst them and earn points.
- Clear all bubbles from the screen to advance to the next level, testing your skills and precision.
- Utilize a variety of unique props and special abilities to overcome challenging levels and obstacles.
- Strive for perfection by earning 3 stars on each level, unlocking bonus points and achievements.
Key Features:
- Dive into multiple vibrant and enchanting themes, each with its own visual flair and charm.
- Conquer over 2000 exhilarating levels, with fresh new additions introduced every week to keep the excitement going.
- Strategically utilize unique props and special abilities to overcome even the most demanding levels.
- Enjoy the convenience of playing anytime, anywhere.
- Experience easy-to-learn gameplay mechanics, while simultaneously facing challenging levels that will put your skills to the test.
Embark on an epic adventure through thousands of captivating levels and immerse yourself in the ultimate bubble-popping sensation. Whether you're a casual gamer, a family looking for shared entertainment, or a die-hard bubble shooter enthusiast, Bubble Pop Go guarantees an addictive gameplay experience. With its stunning visuals, engaging gameplay, and challenging levels, it's the perfect game to keep you entertained for hours.
Download Bubble Pop Go now and let the bubble-popping extravaganza begin! We value your feedback and suggestions, so please don't hesitate to reach out to us at bubblegofeed@outlook.com. Our dedicated support team is always here to assist you!

bluejetty:00145529:ios.description:
WELCOME TO COREPLUS CONNECTED
Acting as an extension of our CorePlus studios, CorePlus Connected is our on-demand digital platform. Whether you’re interested in Pilates, Yoga, Reformer, Strength Training, Cardio, Pre and Postnatal Movement, or Mindfulness and Recovery, our highly trained instructors are there every step of the way. With classes running from 10 minutes to 55 minutes, from beginner to advanced, and with new content dropping every week, you can move with us at a pace and in a place that works for you.
FEATURES
We know that when it comes to movement, everyone is different. That’s why you’ll find a range of classes to suit you wherever you are on your wellness journey, and whatever movement you feel up for each day. Every class is led by one of our world-class instructors who are moving with you and guiding you every step of the way, while providing modifications to support or challenge you whenever you need it. With fresh new signature CorePlus workouts added every week, there’s a class and an instructor for everybody and every body. 
Get unlimited access to every video on every device, on-demand, and be part of the incredible CorePlus Connected community. Join the movement today!
GET CONNECTED
CorePlus Connected is available for every body, and our price point makes it available for every budget. You can subscribe to CorePlus Connected on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription inside the app. You will receive access to all CorePlus Connected content immediately after your purchase. Your subscription automatically renews, unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. All payments* will be paid through your Apple Account, and can be managed under Account Settings following your initial payment. Pricing can vary by country, and will be confirmed prior to purchase.
* All payments will be paid through your Apple Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://ondemand.coreplusconnected.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://ondemand.coreplusconnected.com/privacy

Join the global community of yarn lovers and puzzle solvers. Whether you’re looking to relax or sharpen your mind, Color Yarn 3D is the game that will keep you hooked on unraveling, sorting, and mastering every thread.
Download Color Yarn 3D now and start your untangling journey today!

- Balance time management, cooking speed, and food quality
- Automate tasks for true idle tycoon efficiency

Each city offers new simulation-style food game experiences and fresh challenges. Customize each restaurant to match the local flavor and customer style.

- Face new dash challenges and customer demands
- Grow your empire while keeping service top-notch

Enjoy smooth gameplay, vibrant visuals, and a truly satisfying cooking restaurant tycoon experience.
- Play offline anytime, anywhere
- Perfect for fans of idle games, food games, simulation, and dash fun
Can You Handle the Cooking Rush?

bluejetty:00036103:ios.summary:
Protein Pal is the simple way to track your protein, hit your daily goal and build a habit that lasts. Snap a photo of your meal to log it in seconds, and watch your progress ring fill up through the day.
A GOAL THAT FITS YOU
Answer a few
bluejetty:00036103:ios.description:
Protein Pal is the simple way to track your protein, hit your daily goal and build a habit that lasts. Snap a photo of your meal to log it in seconds, and watch your progress ring fill up through the day.
A GOAL THAT FITS YOU
Answer a few quick questions and Protein Pal calculates a daily protein goal whether you want to lose fat or maintain or build muscle. You can adjust it any time, or set a different goal for a specific day.
BUILT FOR GLP-1 USERS
Taking a GLP-1 medication? Protein Pal can set a GLP-1 friendly goal. Eating enough protein while your appetite is lower helps preserve lean muscle as you lose weight, and Protein Pal makes it easy to see whether you're getting enough each day.
LOG FOOD YOUR WAY
- AI photo scan: snap a photo of your meal and get an estimate for each ingredient, then edit anything before you log it
- Barcode scanning for packaged foods (where available)
- Search a large food database (where available)
- Quick add when you just know the numbers
- Save favorites and meals you eat often, and organize entries by meal type
TRACK MORE THAN PROTEIN
Protein always comes first, but you can also track calories, fiber, carbs and fat. Set each goal as a daily minimum or a limit.
STAY ON TRACK
- Daily reminders plus an evening summary of how close you are to your goal
- Streaks for every day you hit your goal, with a streak goal to aim for
- Home and lock screen widgets
- Apple Health sync
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Stats show your average daily intake, your intake against your target by day or month, and your most eaten foods. Meal insights show your protein density (protein per 100 calories) and how each meal compares with your recent history. Export your entries to CSV any time.
PROTEIN PAL PRO
- AI photo scan, plus barcode scanning and food database search where available
- Unlimited favorites, meals and custom reminders
- Complete tracking history and stats
- Widgets
Privacy Policy: tenlabs.io/#protein-pal-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: tenlabs.io/#protein-pal-terms

Here, you will find peaceful scenes of newborns, warm embraces, quiet rooms, and tender everyday details — all carefully designed to bring comfort, calm, and emotional warmth.
This is not a fast game.

If you enjoy relaxing games, gentle art, and meaningful creative moments, Cradle Color invites you to rediscover calm — one color at a time.

-Newborn & Baby Moments
 - Mother & Child Connections
 - Warm Home Scenes
 - Soft Everyday Life
Each artwork feels like a page from a gentle coloring book, waiting to be brought to life with Color and emotion.
Whether you enjoy coloring, drawing, creative art games, or apps like PicsArt, Cradle Color gives you a calm, comforting space to create.

Cradle Color is designed for adults who want peace, not pressure.
- A unique cradle-inspired coloring world
 - Gentle, emotional art — never childish
 - One of the most relaxing coloring games for adults

 - Perfect for calming breaks, quiet evenings, and emotional comfort
 - Loved by fans of coloring, art games, and paint by number
You can save and share your finished artworks on Pinterest, Facebook, X, and other creative platforms — each piece becomes your own tender expression.
If you’re looking for relaxing coloring games, soft emotional art, and a peaceful creative space, this is your place.

 Slow down · Relax · Paint with love

bluejetty:00178627:ios.name: SİMA - Rəqəmsal İmza
bluejetty:00178627:ios.developer: Data Processing Center of the Ministry of Communications and High Technologies
bluejetty:00178627:ios.summary: SİMA bulud və üztanıma texnologiyalarına əsaslanan yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imzadır. SİMA mobil tətbiqi heç yerə getmədən, sənədlər toplamadan, növbədə gözləmədən və cəmi bir neçə dəqiqə ərzində yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imza əldə etməyə imkan verir.
bluejetty:00178627:ios.description:
SİMA bulud və üztanıma texnologiyalarına əsaslanan yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imzadır. SİMA mobil tətbiqi heç yerə getmədən, sənədlər toplamadan, növbədə gözləmədən və cəmi bir neçə dəqiqə ərzində yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imza əldə etməyə imkan verir. Ən əsası isə vətəndaşdan HEÇ BİR ÖDƏNİŞ TƏLƏB OLUNMUR.
SİMA İmza ilə bu xidmətlərdən istifadə edə bilərsiniz:
- Maliyyə xidmətləri – BOKT xidmətləri, Bank xidmətləri; kredit və kart sifarişi, hesab açma, hesabdan çıxarış almaq, pul köçürmə, şəxsi kabinetə giriş.
- Sığorta xidmətləri – KASKO sığorta məhsulları, həyatın yaşam sığortası, sığorta müqavilələrinin imzalanması, sığorta müraciət anketinin imzalanması.
- Dövlət elektron xidmətləri – Güzəştli mənzil sistemi, Elektron məhkəmə sistemi, E-Polis, Elm və Təhsil Nazirliyi və Dövlət vergi Xidmətində əməliyyatların həyata keçirilməsi.
- Digital login ilə daxil ola biləcəyiniz bütün portallara giriş və e-xidmətlərdən istifadə. 
SİMA rəqəmsal imza vasitəsilə "PAŞA Bank"dan əməkhaqqı kartı olanlar mobil tətbiqi vasitəsilə nağd kredit üçün müraciət edə, "Turan Bank"da əmanət yerləşdirə, Yelo Bank”dan banka getmədən sahibkar krediti götürə və “Bank of Baku” müştəriləri “Dostbank” tətbiqində identifikasiya prosesini tamamlaya bilərlər. Bundan əlavə SİMA imza ilə "Digital Login" sisteminə daxil olaraq 80 portal və xidmətə giriş edə bilərsiniz.
Artıq yeni inteqrasiya nəticəsində fərdi sahibkarlar Dövlət Vergi Xidmətinin İnternet Vergi İdarəsində (new.e-taxes.gov.az) təqdim edilən 80-dən çox elektron xidmət üzrə əməliyyatlarını SİMA yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imza ilə həyata keçirə bilərlər.
- Sadələşdirilmiş, gəlir, əmlak kimi bir çox vergi bəyannamələrini SİMA rəqəmsal imza ilə rahatlıqla təqdim edilməsi;
- POS-terminalların qeydiyyatı və qeydiyyatdan çıxarılması; 
- Elektron qaimə göndərilməsi və s.
SİMA rəqəmsal imza hazırda bir çox özəl və dövlət qurumları ilə inteqrasiyanı davam etdirir və rəqəmsal xidmətlərin əhatə dairəsini genişləndirir. Son dövrdə xidmətlərini rəqəmsallaşdıran növbəti qurumlara “Caspian Drilling Company”, “ESAM İnnovations”, “ASEL Kredit” BOKT, Manato.az kredit platforması və “Foriella Mebel” MMC daxildir.
SİMA İmza-nın üstünlükləri:
- Rahatlıq və təhlükəsizlik
- Tamamilə ödənişsiz əldə edilməsi
- Mobil tətbiqdə sürətli qeydiyyat
- Elektron sənədlərin dərhal imzalanması
SİMA İmza ilə artıq internet vergi portalı üzərindən e-vergi sənədlərini imzalamaq çox sürətli və rahatdır. İnternet vergi dairəsi ilə inteqrasiya edilmiş bu sistem sayəsində vergi sənədlərinizi etibarlı şəkildə təqdim edin. Vergi ilə bağlı bütün sənədlərinizi, vergi hesabatlarınızı, rüblük hesabatları və vergi bəyannamələrinizi E-taxes portalına SİMA imza ilə daxil olaraq apara bilərsiniz. Bütün rəqəmsal imzalama ehtiyaclarınız üçün SİMA daim yanınızdadır.
Nəzərə alsaq ki, elektron imza həllərinin əldə edilməsi və istifadəsi müxtəlif prosedurlar və müəyyən vaxt tələb edə bilər. Bu baxımdan, sürəti prioritet hesab edən vətəndaşlar və sahibkarlıq fəaliyyəti ilə məşğul olan şəxslər SİMA İmza tətbiqini mobil telefonlarına yükləyərək sadə qeydiyyat prosesini tamamlamaqla rəqəmsal imza imkanlarından yararlana bilərlər.
Uztanıma imza texnologiyası sənədlərin sürətli və təhlükəsiz imzalama prosesini sizin üçün reallaşdırır. Əlavə qurğuya ehtiyac duymayan bu müasir imza texnologiyası mobil telefonunuzdakı bir tətbiqdən ibarətdir. İmza elektron şəkildə hüquqi qüvvəyə malik formada aparılır. Rəsmi və şəxsi sənədlər üçün online imzalayıcı həllini axtarırsansa, SİMA tam sizin üçündür. Ənənəvi imza və kağız sənəd prosesinin artıq vaxt itkisinə səbəb olduğu bir dövrdə imza üztanıma texnologiyası işlərinizi sürətləndirir, biznesinizi gücləndirir və ən əsası boşa itirilmiş zamanı sizə geri qaytarır.
SİMA İmza mobil tətbiqini yükləyib, şəxsiyyət vəsiqənizi oxudub və üztanıma əsasında kimliyinizi təsdiqlədib yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imza əldə edin.

SİMA bulud və üztanıma texnologiyalarına əsaslanan yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imzadır. SİMA mobil tətbiqi heç yerə getmədən, sənədlər toplamadan, növbədə gözləmədən və cəmi bir neçə dəqiqə ərzində yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imza əldə etməyə imkan verir. Ən əsası isə vətəndaşdan HEÇ BİR ÖDƏNİŞ TƏLƏB OLUNMUR.

SİMA İmza ilə bu xidmətlərdən istifadə edə bilərsiniz:
- Maliyyə xidmətləri – BOKT xidmətləri, Bank xidmətləri; kredit və kart sifarişi, hesab açma, hesabdan çıxarış almaq, pul köçürmə, şəxsi kabinetə giriş.
- Sığorta xidmətləri – KASKO sığorta məhsulları, həyatın yaşam sığortası, sığorta müqavilələrinin imzalanması, sığorta müraciət anketinin imzalanması.
- Dövlət elektron xidmətləri – Güzəştli mənzil sistemi, Elektron məhkəmə sistemi, E-Polis, Elm və Təhsil Nazirliyi və Dövlət vergi  Xidmətində əməliyyatların həyata keçirilməsi.
- Digital login ilə daxil ola biləcəyiniz bütün portallara giriş və e-xidmətlərdən istifadə. 

SİMA rəqəmsal imza vasitəsilə "PAŞA Bank"dan əməkhaqqı kartı olanlar mobil tətbiqi vasitəsilə nağd kredit üçün müraciət edə, "Turan Bank"da əmanət yerləşdirə, Yelo Bank”dan banka getmədən sahibkar krediti götürə və “Bank of Baku” müştəriləri “Dostbank” tətbiqində identifikasiya prosesini tamamlaya bilərlər. Bundan əlavə SİMA imza ilə "Digital Login" sisteminə daxil olaraq 80 portal və xidmətə giriş edə bilərsiniz.
Artıq yeni inteqrasiya nəticəsində fərdi sahibkarlar Dövlət Vergi Xidmətinin İnternet Vergi İdarəsində (new.e-taxes.gov.az) təqdim edilən 80-dən çox elektron xidmət üzrə əməliyyatlarını SİMA yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imza ilə həyata keçirə bilərlər.
- Sadələşdirilmiş, gəlir, əmlak kimi bir çox vergi bəyannamələrini SİMA rəqəmsal imza ilə rahatlıqla təqdim edilməsi;
- POS-terminalların qeydiyyatı və qeydiyyatdan çıxarılması; 
- Elektron qaimə göndərilməsi və s.

SİMA rəqəmsal imza hazırda bir çox özəl və dövlət qurumları ilə inteqrasiyanı davam etdirir və rəqəmsal xidmətlərin əhatə dairəsini genişləndirir. Son dövrdə xidmətlərini rəqəmsallaşdıran növbəti qurumlara “Caspian Drilling Company”, “ESAM İnnovations”, “ASEL Kredit” BOKT, Manato.az kredit platforması və “Foriella Mebel” MMC daxildir.

SİMA İmza-nın üstünlükləri:
- Rahatlıq və təhlükəsizlik
- Tamamilə ödənişsiz əldə edilməsi
- Mobil tətbiqdə sürətli qeydiyyat
- Elektron sənədlərin dərhal imzalanması

SİMA İmza ilə artıq internet vergi portalı üzərindən e-vergi sənədlərini imzalamaq çox sürətli və rahatdır. İnternet vergi dairəsi ilə inteqrasiya edilmiş bu sistem sayəsində vergi sənədlərinizi etibarlı şəkildə təqdim edin. Vergi ilə bağlı bütün sənədlərinizi, vergi hesabatlarınızı, rüblük hesabatları və vergi bəyannamələrinizi E-taxes portalına SİMA imza ilə daxil olaraq apara bilərsiniz. Bütün rəqəmsal imzalama ehtiyaclarınız üçün SİMA daim yanınızdadır.

Nəzərə alsaq ki, elektron imza həllərinin əldə edilməsi və istifadəsi müxtəlif prosedurlar və müəyyən vaxt tələb edə bilər. Bu baxımdan, sürəti prioritet hesab edən vətəndaşlar və sahibkarlıq fəaliyyəti ilə məşğul olan şəxslər SİMA İmza tətbiqini mobil telefonlarına yükləyərək sadə qeydiyyat prosesini tamamlamaqla rəqəmsal imza imkanlarından yararlana bilərlər.

Uztanıma imza texnologiyası sənədlərin sürətli və təhlükəsiz imzalama prosesini sizin üçün reallaşdırır. Əlavə qurğuya ehtiyac duymayan bu müasir imza texnologiyası mobil telefonunuzdakı bir tətbiqdən ibarətdir. İmza elektron şəkildə hüquqi qüvvəyə malik formada aparılır. Rəsmi və şəxsi sənədlər üçün online imzalayıcı həllini axtarırsansa, SİMA tam sizin üçündür. Ənənəvi imza və kağız sənəd prosesinin artıq vaxt itkisinə səbəb olduğu bir dövrdə imza üztanıma texnologiyası işlərinizi sürətləndirir, biznesinizi gücləndirir və ən əsası boşa itirilmiş zamanı sizə geri qaytarır.
SİMA İmza mobil tətbiqini yükləyib, şəxsiyyət vəsiqənizi oxudub və üztanıma əsasında kimliyinizi təsdiqlədib yeni nəsil rəqəmsal imza əldə edin.

bluejetty:00024444:ios.description:
*** Educational game for preschoolers RMB Knowledge Park 2 with more than 200 objects to learn for children from 1 year and older.
*** The game includes more than 40 funny levels containing over 200 items and animals with increasing difficulty in the levels.
*** Each level is voiced by a native speaker to help the child hear the correct pronunciation and learn new words.
We are happy to present to you the 2nd part of the children's game “Knowledge Park - 2”.
This educational game will help your little boys and girls to:
• learn numbers and learn to count
• learn letters and new words
• recognize colors and various objects, clothing, and shapes
• develop thinking skills and imagination
• develop patience, focus, and attention
• reveal new talents
• develop motor skills
This is a great game that little boys and girls love!
Millions of Children and Mothers around the world have praised our games!
This game is very useful for children from 1 year and older, as well as for kindergartens and preschools.
This interactive educational game includes 4 thematic games and 44 fun levels:
1) World of numbers 2, where your child will learn to count without boring and monotonous tasks!
2) World of alphabet 2, In this game, your child will visit the most popular cities in Europe and learn new words!
3) World of sorting, where your child will classify and compare light and heavy, sort animals according to their respective habitats, and develop logic and focus.
4) Adventure world, This game includes learning letters, numbers, clothing, sports equipment, and much more!
Simple and intuitive controls will make it simple and fun to get to know:
• numbers and math
• letters and the alphabet
• shapes and colors
• light and heavy objects
• clothing and sports
Fun characters will entertain your child with different sound effects, funny animations, and help easily navigate the game.
Pay attention to how children learn! Babies and toddlers can have fun for a long time without stress and time limits.
We are constantly adding new educational games to our application stores around the world, which you can find on our website: https://rmbgames.com/

bluejetty:00095714:ios.description:
Classic Mahjong: Match Master - Ultimate Tile-Matching Adventure!
Dive into the enchanting world of 《Classic Mahjong: Match Master》, where timeless mahjong meets modern puzzle games! Perfect for fans of tile game challenges, this brain-teasing masterpiece blends traditional majhong aesthetics with addictive matching game mechanics. Whether you're a casual player or a mind games expert, our game offers endless hours of strategic fun! 
Gameplay Highlights
Match 3 & Conquer: Clear the board by pairing identical 3 tiles in classic majong style! Feeling stuck? Use the Lightbulb to match 3 mahjong tiles or the Shuffle tool to refresh layouts. Victory awaits when every mojong piece vanishes!
Key Features
1. Authentic Design: Immerse yourself in stunning Oriental artistry with intricately crafted mahjong tiles. Each level transports you to serene landscapes, perfect for lovers of matching games for adults!
2. Inclusive Difficulty: From breezy starters to devilish mahjong match puzzle games, conquer 500+ levels tailored for all skill levels. Newcomers and senior games enthusiasts alike will adore our intuitive classic mahjong match interface!
3. Senior-Friendly: Extra-large 3 tiles and bold symbols ensure effortless gameplay for aging eyes. A steaming mahjong matching game designed with accessibility in mind!
4. Rewarding Bonuses: Spin the Lucky Wheel daily for power-ups and gold coins! Unlock rare boosts to dominate tricky tile game stages!
Why Players Choose Us?
Relaxing Yet Stimulating: Sharpen your mind with mind games that balance calmness and challenge. Perfect for unwinding after work or boosting cognitive skills!
Endless Replayability: Randomized layouts keep every majhong session fresh. No two games are the same!
Download Now & Unlock
Perfect for fans of mahjong, majong, and majhong, this tile game delivers addictive matching game action. With features catering to senior games players and matching games for adults, it’s a must-try for puzzle games lovers. Utilize 3 tiles strategies, explore mojong challenges, and dominate mind games like never before! Join the ultimate puzzle games revolution! Collect daily rewards, master mind games tactics, and reign supreme in the world of tile game legends!

bluejetty:00113648:ios.description:
8,000,000+ downloads! Mokken is super popular.
*this is a very easy and simple fighting game thought.
*PvP (Player versus Player) mode is very exciting!
*By strengthening and RPG element, this is highly addictive!
This is the best free game for killing time.
In this app, you can play in three modes: Mokken 1, Mokken 2, and Sekken.
The first screen you can play with is Mokken 2.
*How to play
It is a game to compete how many enemies you can knock down with punches and kicks. Easy to use:
Button A: Punch
Button B: Kick
*counter attack
It is very advantageous to decide the counter. It can do a lot of damage and even cancel enemy attacks. The way of countering is to make the same attack as the enemy first. Your feet will turn red when your opponent is about to kick, so try to kick at the same time.
*special weapon
If you press buttons A and B at the same time, you can perform a special move. But I'm weak. The enemy will also give you a special move, so you should avoid it by crouching down or taking time.
*make a fighter
If you make a fighter, it will be stronger than now. Let's make a new fighter by collecting materials and coins. Materials are collected on the title screen. You can get coins as fighting money if you fight. When you create a new fighter, the next fighter is unlocked.
*knack
Since the enemy moves in a pattern of making a pause and then attacking, if you take it by the reverse hand and let it take a pause at all times, you will not attack much. So, if you go too close and make sure to counter attack, you can win with no damage.
*Match mode "Sekken"
It's a mode that makes fighting games simpler. A stick man fights furiously using a physical engine. Enter from the button on the left of the title screen.
*How to play
Button A: Punch + Forward
Button B: Kick + Back
*Mode
You can play the following in the matchup mode:
*play alone
I play against a computer. The winner is the one who leads the second round.
*Let's play together.
Two people can play on one screen. Enjoy with friends and family.
*play with someone
You can have an online battle. It's a completely serious face-to-face match. The bot is not here. So you can't play when there is no other person.
*Let's change the name.
Let's change the play name displayed during the online battle to show the existence! Also, the number of wins will be displayed next to each other, so you will be a veteran player after many games! It might be a good idea to use the same name for the ranking.
BGM: SHRK

If you press buttons A and B at the same time, you can perform a special move. But I'm weak. The enemy will also give you a special move, so you should avoid it by crouching down or taking time.

*make a fighter
If you make a fighter, it will be stronger than now. Let's make a new fighter by collecting materials and coins. Materials are collected on the title screen. You can get coins as fighting money if you fight. When you create a new fighter, the next fighter is unlocked.

*knack
Since the enemy moves in a pattern of making a pause and then attacking, if you take it by the reverse hand and let it take a pause at all times, you will not attack much. So, if you go too close and make sure to counter attack, you can win with no damage.

*Match mode "Sekken"
It's a mode that makes fighting games simpler. A stick man fights furiously using a physical engine. Enter from the button on the left of the title screen.

*How to play
Button A: Punch + Forward
Button B: Kick + Back

*Mode
You can play the following in the matchup mode:

*play alone
I play against a computer. The winner is the one who leads the second round.

*Let's play together.
Two people can play on one screen. Enjoy with friends and family.

*play with someone
You can have an online battle. It's a completely serious face-to-face match. The bot is not here. So you can't play when there is no other person.

*Let's change the name.
Let's change the play name displayed during the online battle to show the existence! Also, the number of wins will be displayed next to each other, so you will be a veteran player after many games! It might be a good idea to use the same name for the ranking.

bluejetty:00070257:ios.description:
Become a resourceful general, feel the breathtaking battlefields, conquer the turbulent European continent and build your own empire.
Enjoy countless maneuvers and strategies in this war-game, experience the history of the Medieval Age and compose your own epic.
Game Introduction
The barbarians invade, the Roman Empire falls, the European continent suffers from continuous wars and enters the long period known as the Medieval Age. 
Various forces emerge as the times require, the Vikings, the Britons, the Franks, the Holy Roman Empire… A new series of wars are coming.
Witness the heroic deeds and historical incidents among European countries across various battlefields! 
Game Features
Appreciate the changes of the times through hundreds of battles.
14 chapters, over 120 famous campaigns, 150 countries and forces. Fascinating stories based on historical incidents, including Rise of Byzantium, Viking Invasion, Burning Crusade and Hundred Years' War bring you back to the war-ridden Medieval Age.
Experience the fights and struggles between countries in the Medieval Age.
In Barbarian Invasion, Rise of Byzantium, and Legend of the Vikings, multiple parties vie for the throne. European War, for the first time in its serious, adopts the diplomatic system in the conquest model featuring undetermined camps. Players can convince other parties to join the force via diplomacy method. Build cities to increase material output, research policies to change the direction of the country, change the consuls to get more tax revenue. The occurrence of historical events will affect the battlefield situation, and complete the mission to obtain battlefield rewards.
Hundreds of generals and distinctive armed forces are at your disposal.
There are over 150 generals, including Frederick I, Saladin and Beowulf. Become legendary commanders like Genghis Khan, Joan of Arc, Richard I, William Wallace and fight in the wars. More than 10 countries boast over 300 basic military forces, including more than 30 legendary units like Knights Templar, Knights Hospitaller and Teutonic Knights.
There are hundreds of war gears and military equipment to help you gain the final victory.
Over 30 war gears and more than 60 kinds of military equipment such as Viking Longship, Dromon, Orban's Cannon help you expand your sphere of influence.
Priceless Treasures
Treasures of Pharaoh, John Lackland, Solomon and Knights Templar are waiting for you to explore.
Cloud archive function allows users to change the device without losing their data.
Enhanced audio-visual effects with the brand new game engine.

bluejetty:00030446:ios.description:
Are You Looking for a fast, secure, and reliable way to back up contacts on your iPhone or iPad? MCBackup Pro is the ultimate contacts backup & transfer pro app designed to protect your phonebook and make sharing simple. Whether you need to recover contacts, remove duplicates, or perform a full contact transfer to a new device, MCBackup is the trusted solution millions of users rely on.
With support for VCF (vCard) and CSV formats, this smart contact exporter lets you back up your contact list in seconds. No complicated setups, no computer needed—just one tap to secure your address book and another to restore. Perfect for anyone switching devices, organizing their phonebook, or simply wanting peace of mind.
Key Features
• One-Tap Contact Backup - Back up your contacts instantly and store them safely on your device. Export files as vCard (VCF) or CSV for universal compatibility.
• Transfer Contacts Easily - Send your contact backup to yourself by email or save it to cloud storage. 
• Recover Contacts Anytime - Lost or deleted phone numbers? The contact recovery & backup function allows you to restore from your saved file in seconds. MCBackup makes contact restore easy and stress-free.
• Duplicate Contacts Remover - Clean your phonebook automatically. Use the built-in duplicate contacts remover to merge entries, delete unnecessary numbers, and maintain a tidy contact organizer.
• Smart Sync & Management - With built-in smart sync, you can keep your contact list updated across devices. Organize by job titles, birthdays, or recently added contacts using the powerful contact manager and contact saver tools.
• Selective Contact Transfer - Don’t want to restore your entire phonebook? Choose specific entries to import, delete, or share. Great for contact share and contact delete needs.
• Privacy-First Operation - Unlike other apps, MCBackup does not require servers, accounts, or external tools like CopyTrans. Your trusted contacts are backed up and stored locally—only you decide where to save or send them.
Why Choose MCBackup Pro?
• Complete Contact Management – From contact sync to cleanup, this all-in-one contact management solution keeps your phonebook in perfect shape.
• No Internet Required – All backups and restores happen directly on your device—fast and secure.
• Cross-Platform Friendly – Share your card or full address book across devices with universal file formats like VCF.
• Merge & connect to iPhone – Effortlessly merge and connect to iPhone contacts while avoiding duplicates.
• User-Friendly Design – Simple, intuitive, and optimized for everyone—no tech skills needed.
Beyond its core backup and de-duplication features, MCBackup Pro offers a suite of enhanced tools. The app’s smart sync capability ensures your most recent changes are always accounted for. You can easily perform a contact share or even a bulk contact delete for unwanted entries.
Whether you’re upgrading your device, cleaning duplicates, or preparing for emergencies, MCBackup Pro is your go-to solution. This lightweight yet powerful app combines the best of contact backup, contact restore, and contact management into one seamless package.
Download MCBackup Pro today—the contacts backup & transfer pro app that ensures your phonebook is always safe, synced, and under your control.

bluejetty:00129616:ios.description:
Grabbing objects with a claw machine has never been this satisfying! Carefully fly and balance the builder drone into the perfect position and use the crane machine to grab various objects. Once secured inside the claw machine grabber, maneuver the drone and drop the objects in the proper places to complete each challenge in this unique entry among drone games. Experience the thrill of real arcade action with every move!
Explore different locations worldwide, grab all sorts of objects with your drone claw machine to build, repair, sort, and rescue, completing challenging goals around the world. Train your skill, develop agility, and skillfully control your drone and crane machine grabber to secure all objects. With interesting and unique levels, monuments to explore, rare objectives, and skill-based gameplay, Claw Builder stands out in the world of drone games and offers the excitement of real arcade fun with a claw machine twist!
How To Play:
Skill-based gameplay controlling a flying simulator drone complete with a rope and crane machine, making it a standout in drone games and a true real arcade experience.
Tap and drag to take flight and move your drone into the correct position.
Be cautious as the bouncy rope relies on physics and gravity to balance.
Release the catcher to open the claw machine and prepare to secure the object.
Close the catcher and grab the live object!
Move it into the new position and release the catcher to drop the object.
Features:
A new kind of construction vehicle: Drone Builder.
Builds, digs, rescues, and repairs by flying effortlessly and grabbing objects with its claw machine, offering a fresh take on drone games and real arcade excitement.
Many goals and challenging objectives to complete: Fixing and repairing highways, sorting and organizing fruits and vegetables, building and fixing national monuments, rescuing stranded plane crash passengers from sharks, and more.
Thousands of levels of drone-flying, skill-based fun!

bluejetty:00121695:ios.description:
Enjoy taking care of babies like a real babysitter!
This game offers a great chance to play and learn about childcare. See what babysitting is all about as you run your own kindergarten at home.
Adorable babies are not newborns anymore, their moms and dads put them into day care to you. Babies are playing in the interactive playroom and waiting for your attention. Delight those cute babies with diverse care activities in 7 lovely scenes, like a funny bathing, foamy teeth-brushing, changing the nappy, trendy dressing, tasty food, beauty sleep and joyful play. Babies want you at the same time, so satisfy their wishes step by step.
It's time for a bath!
Pamper your baby with indulgent bathing. Before bath time, choose a few toys to make the baby jump for joy. Then wash the baby with some soap and shampoo and wipe him softly with a towel. Let's have fun popping soap bubbles.
Ohh, baby pooped.
Change a diaper immediately and wipe the snot with a handkerchief. Apply some cream on the rashes and brush the unwashed teeth before bedtime.
Dress up little babies.
You can choose from a variety of cute outfits for boys and girls. Combine colorful panties, soft coveralls, warm socks and comfortable shoes.
Yummy!
Babies need a delicious meal several times a day. Prepare 3 different types of food, powdered milk, cereals with yoghurt and berries, or slice some fresh fruit that is full of vitamins. Don't forget to use a napkin.
Zzzzz, it's bedtime!
Baby is tired and sleepy after so much playing. Give him his favorite toy and dummy to get a good night's sleep. Cover the baby with a funky bedspread. Now, everything is fine to rock the baby and lull him to sleep.
Find toys in a nursery!
Toys are everywhere. Help the baby with searching hidden toys. Keep your eyes peeled and find what the baby needs.
Playground fun
Outdoor activities offer endless fun! Learn how to grow flowers or sort apples and enjoy while saving the birds. You can spent some great time with babies at the playground slide.
Features:
• 7 different activities
• 5 lovely babies with different face expressions
• funky sound effects
• hidden objects mini game with 3 different scenes 
• more than 50 different baby clothes
• vivid colors and beautiful HD illustrations
• interactive scenes
This game is free to play but certain in-game items and features, also some of those mentioned in game description, may require payment via in-app purchases which cost real money. Please check your device settings for more detailed options regarding in-app purchases.
The game contains advertising for Bubadu’s products or some third parties which will redirect users to our or third-party site or app.
This game is certified compliant with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) by FTC approved COPPA safe harbor PRIVO. If you would like to know more about the measures we have in place for protecting child privacy please see our policies here: https://bubadu.com/privacy-policy.shtml .

bluejetty:00149728:ios.name: YRT On-Request
bluejetty:00149728:ios.summary: YRT On-Request is a reimagined way to get around York Region — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green. You can book a ride between your home and the closest YRT bus stop or preselected location in your service area.
bluejetty:00149728:ios.description:
YRT On-Request is a reimagined way to get around York Region — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green. You can book a ride between your home and the closest YRT bus stop or preselected location in your service area.
With a few taps, book an On-Request ride in the app and our technology will pair you with the closest vehicle to bring you to your location.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone
- Get picked up at your curb
- Save money by paying with PRESTO, YRT Pay App or Transit App
- Get dropped off at your chosen location within the service area or the closest bus stop where you can use your two-hour transfer on other YRT routes
What we’re about:
CONVENIENCE
Don’t live close to a transit stop? No problem. We
can pick you up and get you connected to local
transit in your area, all in one fare.
AFFORDABLE.
Discounted YRT fares are offered through the
PRESTO card, YRT Pay App or Transit App. You
can use your transfer on any YRT route for two
hours.
SUSTAINABLE.
Public transit reduces the number of vehicles on the
roads, bringing down congestion and CO2
emissions. With a few taps, you get to do your part
to make your community a little bit greener and
cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at mobilityonrequest@york.ca

bluejetty:00186692:ios.description:
The Endolit app has undergone major upgrade and changed from just an app providing endodontic knowledge to an endodontic network that connects Endodontists and dentists interested in the field of Endodontics. Each user can now develop his own profile, connect with other users and communicate with them through text messaging. With our new home page, users can share their day-to-day work, discuss cases and get instant notification when other users comment or like their posts. Through this interactive feature, users can stay connected and educate each other. Users can also share their work on different social media.
The new app address different needs for users interested in the field of endodontics. Beside the literature and case report section that was initially present, we added a Video section. All videos are for educational purpose and will be available free of charge on the app. If users are interested to post videos, they can check the guideline for video submission present on the app and submit their video through the endolit website. 
Another added features are a Calendar for future events and Job opportunity section. Through these sections, users can stay updated with future events and apply for jobs in private practice or faculty positions. Users are allowed to update the content themselves by submitting jobs and events that will be reviewed on the same day and posted on the app. Users can also delete any submitted jobs or events in case jobs have been filled or canceled events.
The new app functions in Portrait and Horizontal mode.

bluejetty:00124287:ios.description:
Join the unlimited and intense real-time combat in Desperation Survival Update! As you hack, slash, and blast your way with Lion Heart Roar, the brand new huge and powerful, Mid-short range fighter! He is so good at AOE controlling and will indulge you in distinctive and dominative experience! Chinese Zodiac Battlefield is on the trigger, it’s your time to hit legendary. Clash against rivals in a vast fantasy world, team up with friends to explore the wild continent and raid Dungeons, and the brand new 12-players PvP Battleground. Are you able to transform yourself to an unstoppable fighter? Start playing Taichi Panda: Heroes today to write your own fate!
Return to the Stunning Taichi World
Travel back to the days before Taichi Panda, and discover the thriving fantasy kingdom. Explore a vast and exciting world of bandits and brawlers, mystics and maniacs, all rendered in PC quality graphics. Become the true celestial champion as fight, hack, bash, and cut your way to riches and glory in a fast-paced and 3D action adventure!
Command your Army of Heroes
Take control of a wide array of unique and powerful heroes with Taichi Panda: Heroes' innovative multi-character system. Gather your forces and choose your squad to take the field, fighting through endless hordes and abominable beasts to seize the day. Mix and match your heroes and switch your main character to suit your strategy.
Explore the Far Corners of the Land
Many wonders lay hidden across the continent, waiting for heroes to discover them! Venture into the unknown and face the terrors that dwell within to uncover riches, treasures, and glory in a large-scale open game world. Battle alongside fellow players, take on special missions, and fight for survival with open player on player action! 
Join Allies for Legendary Action
Stake your allegiance and fight for honor, power, or riches alongside friends in an online action adventure! Take on powerful beasts of unbelievable power alongside allies, and fight to become the ultimate champion with online Arenas. Join with friends in teams and Guilds to discover your own legendary Taichi adventure! 
==Connect==
Visit our official site to learn more about Taichi Panda: Heroes: http://panda2.snail.com/en
Join the Taichi Panda: Heroes community and learn more on Facebook and our official Forum: 
Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/TaichiPanda2/
Community Forum: http://panda2bbs.snail.com

bluejetty:00133620:ios.name: Nerdish: Learn Something New
bluejetty:00133620:ios.summary:

You can read t
bluejetty:00133620:ios.description:
Nerdish is a learning app that helps you grow your general knowledge. The articles inside are our own — written to show you things you'd never thought to look up, feed your curiosity, and help you learn more about the world.
You can read them or listen to them, and most take about ten minutes: why people like spicy food, what Nefertiti actually looked like, how the internet crosses oceans.
What's inside:
- Articles we write ourselves. Each one starts with a question our editors find interesting, and gets researched properly before it's written.
- Topics from the life around you. Sleep, coffee, déjà vu, the internet, Nefertiti — things you pass by every day without wondering about them.
- Our own writing framework. It keeps every article interesting and concise, but still genuinely educational — a lot of thought went into getting all three at once.
- Built as microlearning for adults. Short chapters of a couple of minutes each, designed to fit a phone screen and a busy day.
- Audio for everything. Read it, listen to it, or follow the text while it plays.
- Historical photographs, archive material and artwork alongside the text, with facts and details in the margins.
- A wide range of subjects, from the human body to ancient history — and the connections between them.
We built Nerdish for people who:
- would rather spend phone time on something better than socials. Same ten minutes, different outcome.
- enjoy learning random things for no particular reason. Curiosity doesn't need a goal attached to it.
- want to stay mentally sharp. Reading something unfamiliar is a small habit that keeps the mind working.
- want to find their way back to reading. Short pieces are easier to start with than a book you've been meaning to open for months.
- want to have more to say — about art, history, or why the sky is blue.
Why it works:
There's no way to measure general knowledge and no point where you have enough. But it's what you're using when you read the news, or decide whether something sounds true, or find a solution that came from somewhere unrelated.
Hardly any of us sets out to work on our knowledge. Nobody ever taught us how — there's no course in general knowledge, nowhere obvious to begin. So it stays on the list of things you'd like to do.
Nerdish works because the mechanism is already there. Curiosity is what built your general knowledge in the first place, and it doesn't need much — an interesting question and ten minutes. And knowledge doesn't stay in separate piles. We write science with its history in it, history with its culture, and culture with the people behind it — nothing is only about one thing.
Pick a topic, read or listen, learn something you'd never thought to look up. That's how general knowledge grows.
Learn with us about:
- Health and the human body: sleep, memory, ageing, and how the body actually works.
- History: ancient empires, revolutions, great discoveries, and the people who changed things.
- Science and technology: space, evolution, physics, AI, inventions, and everyday phenomena explained properly.
- Daily things: why déjà vu happens, how coffee was discovered, where common ideas come from.
- Art and culture: painting, music, architecture, design, literature, and the movements behind them.
- Food: where dishes come from and why we like what we like.
- Famous people: the lives behind the names.
Welcome to being Nerdish with us!

نتوج مسيرة التقويم بإطلاق الإصدار التاسع بخدمات حصرية ومميزة لن تجدها في أي تطبيق آخر:
1. القرآن الكريم: خدمة جديدة تساعدك في ختم قراءة القرآن الكريم باسلوب سهل ومحفز بحيث يتم حساب الوقت المتبقي لختم القرآن بناء على الوقت الذي تستغرقه لقراءة الصفحة الواحدة ومدة القراءة اليومية التي ترغب الالتزام بها لقراءة كتاب الله عز وجل
2. آمين: خدمة تشاركية جديدة تساعدك في نشر دعائك لمجتمع تقويم هلال ليؤمنوا على دعائك, يمكنكم ايضا التأمين على اي دعاء وحفظه في المفضلة كما يحتوى هذا القسم أيضا على الأدعية المأثورة 
3. خطوات: خدمة مميزة جديدة تساعدك على متابعة نشاطك وصحتك عبر معرفة عدد خطوات المشي اليومية حيث يظهر لكم الرقم على مربعات التاريخ! يمكنك ايضا معرفة متوسط الخطوات على مدى الاسابيع والأشهر السابقة
4. مواعيد كاميرا: لتسجيل المواعيد عبر قراءة محتواها من أي صورة ليقوم التطبيق باستخراج نص الموعد وتاريخه وتسجيله بسرعة وسهولة.
مميزات يشتهر بها تطبيق هلال
1. عرض التاريخ الهجري والميلادي الموافق لأي يوم وعند تسجيل أي موعد
2. عرض كافة المواعيد الشهرية دون الحاجة للضغط على تاريخ كل يوم
3. ميزة التذكير اليومي التلقائي بالمواعيد والمناسبات
4. تسجيل المواعيد وإضافة الصور والملاحظات بطريقة بسيطة وسريعة
5. التقويم المدرسي والمناسبات المحلية والدينية للمملكة العربية السعودية والولايات المتحدة الأمريكية
6. دعم ساعة آبل والواجهات المصغرة لعرض المواعيد ومواقيت الصلاة
7. دعم الودجت بأحجام مختلفة وبيانات متنوعة لمعرفة التاريخ الهجري والميلادي وأوقات الصلاة والمواعيد القادمة دون الحاجة لتشغيل التطبيق
8. عرض التاريخ الهجري على الايقونة

bluejetty:00031555:ios.name: Edmonton On Demand Transit
bluejetty:00031555:ios.summary: Edmonton On Demand Transit service is available 7 days a week to connect select areas of the city that don’t have a regular bus route to Edmonton’s transit network. This service is operated on behalf of the City of Edmonton by PWTransit Can
bluejetty:00031555:ios.description:
Edmonton On Demand Transit service is available 7 days a week to connect select areas of the city that don’t have a regular bus route to Edmonton’s transit network. This service is operated on behalf of the City of Edmonton by PWTransit Canada in partnership with Via Transportation.
What does on-demand mean?
It means you can get a ride when you need it. No more bus schedules and shorter wait times.
How does Edmonton On Demand Transit work?
You can book a ride on an accessible shuttle bus by using this app on a smartphone, visiting the website edmonton.ca/OnDemandTransit or calling 780-496-2400.
How do I get started?
Start by downloading the Edmonton On Demand Transit app, then create an easy account using only your name, phone number and email address. Confirm your location and input your destination to see the ride options. Then, book your ride and track it in real time. If you are calling in, provide the same information to the representative who will give you step by step instructions. 
Who is driving the buses?
Professionally-trained drivers from PWTransit will operate the On Demand Transit shuttle buses.
How long will I wait?
It depends on your trip and the time of day – but wait times will be less than 30 minutes in peak times and 60 minutes in off peak times. An accurate estimate of your wait time will be provided before you book your trip. You will be able to track the vehicle location in real-time using the Edmonton On Demand Transit app.
What else is helpful to know?
If you use a wheelchair or other mobility device, have a child stroller or need access to a built-in child safety seat, it’s important to put that in your Edmonton On Demand Transit booking or mention that to the phone representative. That way, we can ensure a spot is available for you.
Why are you offering this new service?
To provide connection to the regular Edmonton transit network from areas where flexible On Demand Transit is a better fit than big bus service.

Step into the dynamic world of Chess Shooter 3D where the classic elegance of chess merges with the heart-pounding intensity of online first-person shooters (FPS). This game redefines the boundaries of classic chess, offering a supper funny experience that challenges your outshooting skills on a large map.

Bored from wimp strategies or heavy and long online shooters? Engage yourself in battles with the adrenaline-fueled excitement of FPS combat. The game is set in a virtual arena, where chess pieces come to life as skilled warriors, each with their unique abilities and roles.

Blast the chessboard-inspired battleground with one of each piece: King, Queen, Rook, Bishop, Knight and Pawn. Each piece represents a different character class, equipped with weapons and skills. Plot your moves carefully, considering positioning, cover, and tactics that align with classic chess strategy. Remember that your first goal is to kill your opponent's King!

Are you ready to try unforgettable rapid-fire combat with your friends or random players all around the world? Chess Shooter 3D invites you to explore an unprecedented gaming experience where victory depends on your ability to outshoot your opponents!

bluejetty:00013952:ios.description:
Banking made easy with the refreshed City National Bank App. An entirely upgraded experience helps you see your financial big picture with tools to manage accounts, deposit checks, pay bills, pay people, set up wire transfers and more—all from your secured device.
PERSONAL MONEY MANAGEMENT
• Move money to and from your external bank accounts 
• Make one-time or scheduled bill payments
• Pay friends, family, and others seamlessly and directly from your Zelle® account 
• Set up domestic wire transfers (USD only) and international wire transfers
• Deposit checks from your device
• Transfer funds between your City National banking and brokerage accounts
• Tap to see account details and activity
ACCOUNT VIEWS AT-A-GLANCE
• Create a personalized view of account balances without signing in
• Customize your home screen with a snapshot of checking, saving, investment and loan account balances
• Customize account order
SECURED ACCESS
• Securely sign in using facial or fingerprint recognition
• Control access to your account—view, add, or remove devices
BUSINESS SUITE INCLUDED
• Link your City National Business Suite profile
• Access many of the business account features you have online
• Sign into personal accounts and Business Suite from one app
ALWAYS IN THE LOOP
• Stay informed about planned app improvements and other notifications
• Learn about new features and benefits 
City National strives to deliver a premier mobile banking experience—one that mirrors our unmatched level of personal service and commitment. The City National Bank App provides a completely new experience from our previous app, City National Mobile. We have updated core capabilities and added smart new features for a convenient mobile banking tool. Now you can make mobile check deposits, view account balances and account history, search transaction history, make bill payments, set up wire transfers, and manage everyday banking. Find the way up—get the City National Bank App today.
Compatible with iOS 14 and up on iPhone® and iPad®. 
Non-deposit investment products: 
• Are not FDIC ensured 
• Are not bank guaranteed 
• May lose value 
Deposit products and services are provided by City National Bank Member FDIC. City National Bank is a subsidiary of Royal Bank of Canada. 
Deposits are subject to verification and may not be available for immediate withdrawal. 
Deposit limits and account eligibility apply. 
Equal Housing Lender. NMLSR ID # 536994 
Brokerage Services are provided through City National Securities, Inc. (member FINRA, SIPC), a subsidiary of City National Bank. 
Apple, the Apple logo, Face ID, and iPhone are trademarks of Apple, Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. 
Zelle should only be used to send money to friends, family or others you know and trust. Must have a bank account in the U.S. to use Zelle. Zelle is available for use with your City National personal checking accounts. 
Zelle and the Zelle related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC and are used herein under license. Early Warning Services, LLC and City National Bank are separate unrelated companies. 
City National Bank App requires that you download the City National Bank App and is only available for select mobile devices. Requires setup in City National Online®. Data connection required. Message and data rates may apply. 
The City National Bank App is intended only for US-based bank account holders to use in the US or whilst travelling abroad.

bluejetty:00070519:ios.name: Land Rover Route Planner
bluejetty:00070519:ios.summary: To be used in conjunction with Land Rover vehicles which are fitted with the next-generation infotainment system, InControl Touch Pro, the Land Rover Route Planner App allows you to navigate from door to door. Before setting out from your h
bluejetty:00070519:ios.description:
To be used in conjunction with Land Rover vehicles which are fitted with the next-generation infotainment system, InControl Touch Pro, the Land Rover Route Planner App allows you to navigate from door to door. Before setting out from your home, set your destination from your smartphone and you’ll be directed to your Land Rover as the app detects your vehicle's location. The smartphone app will then automatically sync with your Land Rover's navigation system using the Cloud so your car will be ready to take over navigating soon after you get in. Once you've finished your in-car journey, navigation is then handed back to your smartphone, which provides any final public transport and pedestrian directions to your final destination.
In addition the Route Planner app also allows you to pre-plan trips and holidays by searching for places of interest or restaurants and saving them as favourites from your smartphone. You will then be able to access these saved locations from the in-car navigation system at a later date. 
Note:
• Requires InControl Navigation Account to sign-in. Account can be registered from either your Land Rover’s navigation settings or landrover.here.com.
• As we systematically introduce InControl, specific features, options and its availability remain market dependent. This app requires that your vehicle be fitted with its relevant connectivity package as well as a Micro SIM card with a suitable data contract. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00082912:ios.description:
AdGuard Mail is a service that allows you to receive emails without revealing your personal email address to the sender.
Our service provides you with everything you need to protect your mail:
- Aliases for email forwarding
- Temporary email addresses for short-term communications
From the industry leader with over 15 years of experience in user privacy tools and services.
With AdGuard Mail you can:
* Create aliases
* Manage your email subscriptions
* Use temporary email addresses
Why use AdGuard Mail?
1. Receive email anonymously
2. Control email forwarding
3. Avoid spam in your main inbox
4. Protect your privacy
5. Prevent tracking
1. Receive email anonymously: Use aliases to receive email anonymously instead of exposing your primary email address. This method allows you to subscribe to services or share your contact information with people or organizations you don’t fully trust without revealing your real email address. Email sent to these aliases is seamlessly forwarded to your primary inbox, keeping your personal address private and reducing the risk of spam and unwanted communication. By using aliases, you can maintain your privacy while securely and efficiently managing multiple interactions.
2. Control email forwarding: If you start receiving spam or unwanted email at a specific alias, you can simply disable it to prevent further messages from being forwarded to your main inbox. This feature helps maintain a clean, organized email setup. By disabling problematic aliases, you can prevent spam from cluttering your inbox and ensure that only relevant and trusted email reaches you. It helps protect your primary email address from any kind of unwanted messages.
3. Avoid spam in your main inbox: Use temporary email addresses for quick online interactions. When you sign up for free trials, receive promotional codes, or participate in online forums, choose a disposable email address instead of your primary email address. This approach keeps your primary inbox uncluttered and protected from potential spam. Temporary email addresses provide a secure way to handle short-term interactions without compromising the integrity of your primary email. In addition, all messages to these temporary addresses are sent directly to your inbox in AdGuard Mail. Unlike aliases, Temp Mail allows you to quickly manage your email subscriptions without having to switch between your primary email service and AdGuard Mail.
4. Protect your privacy: If a website requires email verification, but you’re not sure your information will remain confidential, you can use a random address from a temporary email address generator or an alias. That way, even if the untrustworthy site shares it with third parties, your primary email address remains hidden. This method helps protect your personal information, such as your name and address, and prevents spam newsletters from reaching your primary inbox.
5. Prevent tracking: A disposable email address helps protect your online privacy by preventing websites from collecting data that could be used to target ads or track user activity, so your browsing habits remain private.
Privacy policy: https://adguard-mail.com/privacy.html 
Terms of use: https://adguard-mail.com/eula.html

bluejetty:00171073:ios.description:
On Paper Sports Football ‘24 is the ultimate football management experience. Become the GM and build your team from the bottom.
Career mode offers an infinite number of years to play, tracking statistics & history the whole way. Start from the bottom and build your team through various ways, hire the coach you need, manage your roster through free agency and contract negotiations, make that blockbuster trade, or draft that star player that will alter the course of your organization forever. On Paper Sports Football is the ultimate football strategy game. 
Create your team the way you want it in our custom logo editor, select from a variety of logos to customize and change the color scheme to your liking. Train your players each week in order to not only improve them but also gauge their potential, research new plays to be used and called in crucial situations. Each play matters and every player has an impact. Each decision you make can change the course of history in On Paper Sports Football ‘24.
Sim-Engine: On Paper Sports Football ‘24 features a fully fleshed out simulation engine that simulates every play on the field for every game in your league. Tracking stats along the way gives you the ability to build your roster with the stats to back it.
Play-calling: Full play calling experience choose from a variety of play calling experiences, Call just the critical plays or call every play for a few drives. Research playbooks to unlock new plays to be called in the right situations.
Pro Mode: On paper sports offers a fully fledged professional football experience with 24 teams and 17 games, including contract negotiations in free agency, trades, draft & more.
College Mode: Getting bored of pro mode? Checkout our in app purchase for college mode! College mode offers a totally different experience including: 64 new teams, top 25 rankings, in season recruiting, transfer portal, walk ons, redshirts & more!
Customization: Want to customize your experience? Create your own teams, create your own players & create your own leagues! Want to change the length of the season or how many teams make it into the playoff each year? Want to customize your coach or your star quarterback? Purchase the creation suite in app purchase and customize your game the way you want
Get ready to dominate the gridiron with On Paper Sports Football ‘24, where your football management dreams come to life. Download now and experience the ultimate American football GM game!

Join our 500,000+ members who've doubled their savings rate and won $4.5 million*! 
SaverLife is a nonprofit with unique savings challenges that pay out cash rewards to help you accelerate your savings and hit all your goals.
What’s in it for me?
Join exclusive savings challenges to win cash prizes for hitting your savings goals. Earn points for saving and making progress toward your goal. Spend your points on scratchers for more chances to win cash and boost your savings. The best part is these challenges and money saving tips help you build a habit. That habit is the key to saving up for a house, a car, an emergency fund, and achieving long-term financial freedom.
Features
-Unique savings challenges with cash rewards
-Points for each time you make progress toward your goal - redeem them for scratchers to win more money
-SaverPerks to take advantage of curated offers that help you save or earn even more money
-A community forum to learn money-saving tips and tricks from fellow savers
-Money 101 articles and quizzes written by certified financial coaches who know firsthand how hard it is to save
Our investors include JP Morgan Chase & Co, the MetLife Foundation, Prudential, and the Intuit Financial Freedom Foundation.
How do I join?
To get started, simply download the best way to save app and connect your bank to create your SaverLife account - that’s it! Signing up takes less than five minutes.
We’re not a bank. We are a nonprofit. We never touch your money - we only monitor your saving progress to help you maximize your rewards.
“I thought, ‘How will I save? I don’t have money!’ But SaverLife inspired me to see the importance of saving - even a little bit. That transformation in my mind of why it was important was really helpful.” - Shari, a mom from California
Unlike Yotta and Digit, we have a variety of unique savings challenges so you don’t get bored while you stay on track.
Why We’re Here
4 out of 10 Americans have less than $400 in savings. We’re on a mission to create the best help-me-save app to ensure everyone - 10 out of 10 people - has $400 or more saved on their way to achieving financial freedom.

Join our 500,000+ members who've doubled their savings rate and won $4.5 million*! 

SaverLife is a nonprofit with unique savings challenges that pay out cash rewards to help you accelerate your savings and hit all your goals.
 

What’s in it for me?
Join exclusive savings challenges to win cash prizes for hitting your savings goals. Earn points for saving and making progress toward your goal. Spend your points on scratchers for more chances to win cash and boost your savings. The best part is these challenges and money saving tips help you build a habit. That habit is the key to saving up for a house, a car, an emergency fund, and achieving long-term financial freedom.

Features
-Unique savings challenges with cash rewards
-Points for each time you make progress toward your goal - redeem them for scratchers to win more money
-SaverPerks to take advantage of curated offers that help you save or earn even more money
-A community forum to learn money-saving tips and tricks from fellow savers
-Money 101 articles and quizzes written by certified financial coaches who know firsthand how hard it is to save

Our investors include JP Morgan Chase & Co, the MetLife Foundation, Prudential, and the Intuit Financial Freedom Foundation.

How do I join?

To get started, simply download the best way to save app and connect your bank to create your SaverLife account - that’s it! Signing up takes less than five minutes.

We’re not a bank. We are a nonprofit. We never touch your money - we only monitor your saving progress to help you maximize your rewards.

“I thought, ‘How will I save? I don’t have money!’ But SaverLife inspired me to see the importance of saving - even a little bit. That transformation in my mind of why it was important was really helpful.” - Shari, a mom from California

Unlike Yotta and Digit, we have a variety of unique savings challenges so you don’t get bored while you stay on track.

Why We’re Here
4 out of 10 Americans have less than $400 in savings. We’re on a mission to create the best help-me-save app to ensure everyone - 10 out of 10 people - has $400 or more saved on their way to achieving financial freedom. 

*Savings Rate is based on comparing savings balance changes in the six months before joining SaverLife versus the six months after.

bluejetty:00061179:ios.description:
Burly Men at Sea is a folktale about a trio of large, bearded fishermen who step away from the ordinary to seek adventure.
With gameplay halfway between a visual novel and a point-and-click adventure, the branching story carries its ungainly heroes into waters where lurk creatures from Scandinavian folklore and other misadventures. You play as storyteller and wayfinder, shaping a custom tale that begins again where it ends.
BRANCHING STORY: Play through multiple choice-driven adventures, each designed to be completed in a single sitting.
INNOVATIVE CONTROLS: Shape the narrative through a unique, draggable viewport and your interactions within it.
PLAYFUL AESTHETIC: Colorful art style with handcrafted animation, set to a whimsical original soundtrack inspired by folk music of the far north.
No in-app purchases or ads.
…
“The closest thing I’ve played to an interactive fairy-tale.” —The Telegraph
“Artful interplay of visual minimalism, waggish writing and hilarious but also haunting sound effects generated by gorgeous a cappella voices. 5/5” —TIME
“9/10” —Pocket Gamer
…
Burly Men at Sea is the second game from married duo Brain&Brain, developed during their own adventures as nomads and erstwhile farmhands.
