bluejetty:00176580:ios.description:
Gem AI - Your AI-Powered Assistant for Every Need!
Gem AI is your ultimate AI-powered assistant, designed to transform the way you interact with technology. Built using advanced GPT-4 technology, Gem AI empowers you to generate AI images from prompts, create personalized AI assistants, and tackle a wide range of tasks with ease. Whether you’re working on essays, generating content, or managing your day-to-day tasks, Gem AI has got you covered.
Why Choose Gem AI?
- Gem AI provides an intuitive platform that adapts to your needs, helping you:
- Create Stunning AI-Generated Images: Bring your ideas to life by generating high-quality visuals with simple text prompts.
- Design Your AI Assistants: Customize AI assistants to handle your unique personal or professional requirements.
- Streamline Content Creation: From social media posts to academic writing, let Gem AI assist you in crafting engaging content.
- Boost Productivity: Solve complex problems, debug code, translate text, and much more with a few taps.
Key Features of Gem AI
- AI Essay Writer: Start your essays with confidence using our specialized AI writing tools.
- Content Creation: Generate blog posts, video scripts, and social media content seamlessly.
- Social Media Ideas: Discover fresh post ideas for Instagram, Twitter, and beyond.
- Academic Assistance: Get quick answers, summaries, and research support for your assignments.
- Multilingual Capabilities: Perform intertextual translations and perfect grammar in multiple languages.
- Coding Assistance: Debug, fix, and write code with ease.
- Math Solutions: Solve equations and tackle challenging problems effortlessly.
How to Get Started with Gem AI?
- Download Gem AI from the app store.
- Open the app and start exploring its categories.
- Ask questions, give prompts, or assign tasks—Gem AI is ready to help.
- Enjoy fast, reliable, and intelligent responses tailored to your needs.
About Gem AI
Gem AI leverages cutting-edge GPT-4 technology to deliver a seamless AI experience. With deep learning at its core, it offers a natural language processing (NLP) engine that understands and responds to your queries in a human-like manner. Whether you need quick advice, creative inspiration, or complex solutions, Gem AI is your go-to digital assistant.
What Can Gem AI Do for You?
- Answer all your questions accurately.
- Summarize lengthy texts in seconds.
- Create captivating content for social media or academics.
- Translate and proofread texts across multiple languages.
- Provide coding support and debug errors.
- Assist with email writing and professional correspondence.
Who Is Gem AI For?
Gem AI is perfect for anyone seeking:
- A creative partner for generating AI images or original ideas.
- A personal assistant for managing tasks, planning, or brainstorming.
- A reliable helper for academic, professional, or creative writing.
- A smart problem-solver for coding, math, or technical challenges.
Download Gem AI now and elevate your productivity and creativity!
Please feel free to contact us for your support and suggestions: help.askai@gmail.com
 About Subscriptions and Terms of Use: 
- For Unlimited Features of Gem AI, some Premium subscriptions are needed.
- Payment will be made from your iTunes account after you confirm the purchase.
- Subscriptions will auto-renew at the end of each term if it is not canceled 24 hours before the end of the purchasing term.
- The user can manage subscriptions. Auto-renew can be turned off from iTunes account settings.
- You can cancel your subscriptions by entering: http://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039 - Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/askaiapp/home
- Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/askaiapp/termsofuse

bluejetty:00064139:ios.description:
Get updates and notifications for rocket launches from SpaceX, NASA, ULA, ROSCOSMOS, ISRO, and many more!
Features:
• Notifications for upcoming rocket launches.
• History of space flight back to the first manned space flight.
• Vehicle details on commonly used launch vehicles by SpaceX, NASA, ULA and others..
• Advanced search and filters for finding specific space launches.
• Optional Day/Night theme.
Launch Tracking
Track rocket launches from SpaceX, ULA, and Orbital/ATK as well as international launches from NASA, ROSCOSMOS, ISRO, JAXA and ESA.
Science Missions
Follow along with NASA resupply missions to the International Space Station, commercial satellite launches from providers like IRIDIUM and science missions like James Webb Space Telescope!
Vehicle Information
Get to know all the rockets that take us to orbit such as the Soyuz, Atlas, Delta, Ariane, Proton and Falcon 9 launch vehicle families.
Space Launch Now is in no way affiliated with SpaceX, NASA, ULA, ISRO, ESA or any other launch provider.

bluejetty:00070626:ios.name: TV Cast Pro for Chromecast
bluejetty:00070626:ios.summary:
Watch any web video and your personal photos, videos & music on your Chromecast or Google Cast powered TV. Enjoy the show on your big screen.
With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Chromecas
bluejetty:00070626:ios.description:
Watch any web video and your personal photos, videos & music on your Chromecast or Google Cast powered TV. Enjoy the show on your big screen.
With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Chromecast (movies, TV shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and wait for the video link detection. The video link will appear below the browser. Tap it and the video will be sent to your big screen instantly! Streaming personal media from your device is also supported.
* The app only works with all Chromecast devices from Google and on devices with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in.
* iTunes movies and DRM-protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO Now are not supported!
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. 
* If a specific video does not cast, please check our FAQ. If that does not help, please give us a chance to help you by dropping a mail to info@video-tv-cast.com instead of leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for your video as soon as possible.
>>> PRO FEATURES
* Remote Playbar: A remote control that allows you to fast forward or rewind videos while browsing. It syncs across all your iPads & iPhones that are connected to the same Chromecast. So your video can be controlled by different users in the same room.
* Personal Media: Cast unlimited personal photos, videos and music directly from your device or from cloud services like iCloud and Dropbox. 
* Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. 
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Subtitles: Display subtitles & closed captions on TV.
* Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of the mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings.
>>> USER FEEDBACKS
"You've brought the chromecast to life on iOS devices!! And you designed it work easily and quickly"
Ryan, England
“I looooove your app. It has taken my Chromecast to a whole new level.”
Rosalind Romero, USA
>>> A MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPERS
We want to say thank you for all your great support and kindly invite you to honestly rate our app. This helps us to keep up our app development and support for you. Please do not trust other apps that ask you for 5-star ratings in exchange for premium upgrades. This is against good developer ethics and also against Apple guidelines.
If you have any feedback, feature requests or other requests, please notify us at info@video-tv-cast.com.
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google or any other trademark mentioned here. Chromecast is a trademark of Google LLC.

bluejetty:00123450:ios.name: FTH Daily
bluejetty:00123450:ios.summary: FTH Daily is a subscription-based e-grocery app, that offers its services across Pune, Hyderabad and Bangalore. Shop anything you want- from farm fresh milk to dairy products to fresh fruits & vegetables, organic products, fresh fruit juice
bluejetty:00123450:ios.description:
FTH Daily is a subscription-based e-grocery app, that offers its services across Pune, Hyderabad and Bangalore. Shop anything you want- from farm fresh milk to dairy products to fresh fruits & vegetables, organic products, fresh fruit juice, personal care products to other essentials- all in one go. You can choose from over 10,000+ products and enjoy a hassle free shopping experience. 
With flash sales, reasonable pricing, convenient subscription plans with a 5:00 - 7:00 AM delivery slot with free delivery at MRP makes FTH Daily a budget-friendly shopping experience.
If you are someone who forgets to stock up on groceries & other daily essentials due to your busy schedule or if looking up “milk delivery near me” on Google has been keeping you busy, look no further because FTH Daily is just what you need. Just sign up, pick your favourite products and place your order. We’ll take care of the rest.
FEATURES & SERVICES
*WIDE RANGE OF MILK 
With 70+ varieties of Milk, we have a choice for every consumer. Each family member can opt for their choice of Milk according to their preferences. We have Lactose-Free Milk, Organic Milk, Whole Cow Milk, Raw Milk, Buffalo Milk, Goat Milk, Camel Milk & much more.
*CREATE YOUR OWN MILK DELIVERY SCHEDULE
Schedule to have your Milk or any product delivered to your doorstep on the app. Subscribe to any product, set the delivery time & forget about it. Your delivery will reach you on time, every time. You can even reschedule your delivery, add or remove items as per your convenience.
*PAUSE OR RESUME SUBSCRIPTION
If you are going out on a vacation or you want to have your routine subscription items changed/annulled, you can easily pause or edit the items on your subscription plan. You can resume the same whenever needed. Our subscription plans are easily customizable, i.e, you can have them changed as per your needs.
*TRACK DELIVERY
Go to the app’s Delivery tab to track delivery of your scheduled plans. Your milk delivery will always be on time, as per schedule.
*EASY PAYMENTS
You can keep a check on your daily expenses, have a consolidated view of spendings over the weeks or months. Visit the "Delivery History & Wallet" option in the "Me" tab. Moreover, you have multiple options to recharge your FTH Daily wallet.
HOW TO USE THE FTH DAILY APP?
*SIGN-IN TO YOUR FTH DAILY ACCOUNT
Sign up and update your profile information, include your correct address. You can update your personal information in the "Me" tab under "Profile Information".
*ADD MONEY TO THE WALLET
Experience the ease of payment with FTH Daily wallet. After every successful milk delivery or any other purchase, money for that particular transaction will get auto-debited from your account. You can recharge your FTH Daily wallet using:
**Credit Cards, Debit Cards
**Netbanking - SBI, HDFC, ICICI, AXIS, Kotak, Yes Bank, & most serviceable banks
**Wallets - Paytm, Vodafone mPesa, Ola Money, freecharge, Payzapp
If you have any questions or queries:
Visit our website: www.fthdaily.com
Call us on: 080 4051 1521 or drop a mail on support@fthdaily.com

GoToMyPC gives you the freedom to go anywhere you choose and connect right to your Mac or PC. To use this free app, you must first have a GoToMyPC subscription.
********
“If you want to access your computer remotely, this app is your best bet.” – LAPTOP Magazine
“GoToMyPC is definitely a hit in the business world. It's simple, clean, and gets to the point.” – HotHardware
********
GETTING STARTED IS EASY
1) Download the GoToMyPC app from the App Store.
2) Make sure you have GoToMyPC installed on the Mac or PC you want to access. 
3) Tap the GoToMyPC app from your iPad or iPhone to access your computer.
Your computer is always just a few taps away. GoToMyPC is…
Convenient
• Use your computer wherever you take your iPad or iPhone – meaning everywhere. 
Simple
• Instantly access any application or file on your Mac or PC.
Reliable
• GoToMyPC is famous for its reliability and free 24/7 Global Customer Support.
FEATURES
• Instant access to all your files, programs and network

• Precision mouse control so it’s easy to tap the details
• 300% zoom to see details and work without straining your eyes
• Full keyboard functionality, including special keys like Alt, Ctrl and Tab
• Fast, auto-corrected typing with the Preview Text feature
• Copy and paste between your computer and apps on your phone

• Keyboard Locking and Screen Blanking on the computer you access (PC only)

• 128-bit AES encryption, dual passwords and end-to-end user authentication
• Connects over 3G, 4G and Wi-Fi networks
• Bluetooth keyboard support 
NOTE: To use this free application, you must first have a GoToMyPC subscription on the computer(s) you want to access.

bluejetty:00151147:ios.name: Together: Rekindle & Rebuild
bluejetty:00151147:ios.summary: If you want a better marriage but don’t know where to start… start small with the Together app. Regain your connection with your spouse, learn tips to be proactive about your marriage, boost your communication, and re-learn how to have fun
bluejetty:00151147:ios.description:
If you want a better marriage but don’t know where to start… start small with the Together app. Regain your connection with your spouse, learn tips to be proactive about your marriage, boost your communication, and re-learn how to have fun together. Get daily reminders with small daily activities you can easily do, even on your busiest days, to go from feeling like roommates to actually feeling like a couple in love again.
Together is made for you and your spouse to grow, whether you use the app together or individually. Our solutions go beyond grand gestures or overhauling your marriage all at once. We give you the skills to learn how to show up for your spouse, one simple action at a time – because great marriages are built in the small, everyday moments.
Built by Ramsey Solutions and grounded in behavioral psychology and real-world insight from Dr. John Delony (Dave Ramsey’s trusted voice on mental health and relationships), it's designed for busy couples who want simple, realistic ways to reconnect and reprioritize their relationship.
Download today to see why over 10,000 couples have trusted us to bring back the spark in their marriage.
TOGETHER APP FEATURES:
GROW YOUR CONNECTION WITH DAILY ACTIVITIES
- 70+ Daily Activities: Access simple, daily prompts with powerful and fun activities that help you feel more connected in your relationship.
- Get help where your marriage needs it most: Opt into guided Focus Areas (like connection, communication, intimacy, mental load and more) based on what you need most right now.
GET ON THE SAME PAGE WITH YOUR SPOUSE
- Weekly rundown for your relationship: Every Sunday, you’ll get on the same page about your schedules, wants and needs for the week ahead. 
- These details help shape the relationship activities the app suggests.
CONVERSATION STARTERS & RELATIONSHIP TOOLS
- Conversation Starters: Get 30 Questions for Humans cards each month—a mix of fun and thoughtful questions that level up your conversations with your spouse.
- Marriage and Relationship Tools: Get distance mode and other tools that help you stay connected throughout the week in real life.
Pricing and availability:
Together is a paid app. No free version is offered at this time.
A $5.99 per month subscription unlocks all features and content. Both spouses can use one subscription (so you can invest in each other for less than the price of a latte).
Or save with a yearly subscription for $49.99.
Only available on iOS (for now).
Built by Ramsey Solutions.
Privacy Policy: https://www.ramseysolutions.com/company/policies/privacy-policy

Bank on the go with First National Bank & Trust, Elk City’s FirstNet Mobile App. Manage your accounts from your mobile device when it’s convenient for you.

SECURITY: 
Finastra protects your financial information from unauthorized users using: 
Secure login with user name and password. 
No transmission of complete account numbers.
Member FDIC

Connecting you to Sri Lanka and the Philippines with dedicated Shipment2SriLanka and Shipment2Pinas (Balikbayan) services.
Experience a revolutionary way to send packages to your loved ones in Sri Lanka and the Philippines with the Shipment2 mobile app! Designed to make shipping effortless, reliable, and affordable, our app puts convenience in the palm of your hand. Whether you're sending gifts, personal items, or business goods, Shipment2 ensures your cargo is delivered safely and on time—straight to the recipient's doorstep.
Key Features:
Seamless Booking
Shipping has never been easier! Book shipments in just a few taps. Choose your shipping method—sea freight, air freight, or local freight—schedule a pickup, and we’ll handle the rest.
Real-Time Tracking
Stay in the loop every step of the way. Track your shipment’s journey from pickup to delivery in real-time. Receive instant updates through notifications via SMS, push alerts, or email.
Affordable Pricing & Transparency
We offer competitive rates with no hidden fees, ensuring our services meet your budget. Get instant quotes and enjoy premium shipping at affordable prices.
Pickup Options for Your Convenience
Choose from home pickup, local office handover, or designated drop-off locations. Whatever works for you, we’ve got you covered.
Secure Warehousing
Need storage? Our warehousing services provide safe and secure storage solutions, ensuring your cargo is well-protected before shipment.
Doorstep Delivery
Let us handle customs clearance and deliver your shipment directly to your loved ones’ doorstep in Sri Lanka and the Philippines, hassle-free.
Integrated Marketplace
Shop local products from your residence country through our app and have them delivered straight to your loved ones in Sri Lanka or the Philippines.
Optional Shipping Insurance
Add peace of mind with our optional insurance service to safeguard your valuable shipments.
How It Works:
1. Download & Register
Get the app from Apple App Store and sign up using your phone number.
2. Book Your Shipment
Select your preferred shipping method, pickup option, and schedule your shipment date.
3. Track & Relax
Track your shipment in real-time while we handle everything from pickup to delivery.
4. Delivered with Care
Your cargo is safely delivered to the doorstep of your loved ones in Sri Lanka or the Philippines.
Empowering smarter shipping with cutting-edge technology, the Shipment2 mobile app makes logistics simple, efficient, and reliable. Whether you’re shipping for personal or business needs, we’ve combined affordability with world-class service to redefine cargo delivery.
Download the Shipment2 app now and start shipping smarter!

bluejetty:00022741:ios.description:
Sudoku - A number puzzle game with endless fun!
Sudoku is an interesting puzzle game, and the goal of the game is to place 1 to 9 into each grid so that each number can only appear once in each row, each column and each mini-grid. It is not only easy to get started, but also very beneficial to our brains.
There are several benefits of playing Sudoku：
Exercise your logical thinking ability to help strengthen your memory. You have to find out the unique number solution of each blank by inference and remember each number solution. Finally, the whole process is a combination of logic and memory
Keep your brain away from Alzheimers. The process of Sudoku game is the time of concentration, which can make the brain move and maintain vitality. 
Learn to quickly change the way of thinking. When you focus on breaking through the Sudoku game, you will immediately make judgments and find new solutions.
Can let people calmly forget the trouble, get a sense of accomplishment. When you focus on playing this game and fill all the blanks, You'll get a sense of accomplishment!
Playing Sudoku regularly is very beneficial to our brains, such as improving logical thinking ability, improving concentration, memory, observation and imagination, and can get a lot of sense of accomplishment from it!
Features: 
- 3 theme patterns
- 9 x9 squares
- 4 difficulty levels：Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert
Functions: 
- Daily Challenge. One challenge every day to win monthly trophies.
- Automatically checks for errors, remind players of errors with red numbers.
- Highlight the same number, to help exclude numeric options.
- Hide the number used, prompt the player that the hidden number will no longer appear.
- Pause at any time, continue at any time, you can play anytime and anywhere.
Enjoy Sudoku, complete it, you'll get a sense of accomplishment!

bluejetty:00182472:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00182472:ios.description:
► Comics Bob – Mind-bending puzzles and classic cartoon fun!
Comics Bob caveman! Comics Bob not clever man. Comic Bob love cave lady. Cave lady in danger. Comics Bob confused. Comics Bob need friend with big brain! 
► Yabadaba-doh!
Help lovable doofus Bob and his beautiful lady friend overcome the trials and tribulations of paleolithic romance in this wacky cartoon puzzle game where you make the choices for the hapless prehistoric heroes. Choose right or choose wrong, the answer’s always guaranteed to be a blast as situations unfold with the humor and ingenuity of classic cartoon capers. Sneaky saber-toothed tigers, manic monkeys, tricksy pterodactyls and even inquisitive aliens are all conspiring to rend our star-crossed stone-age lovers asunder, so you’ll need all your lateral thinking and puzzle-solving skills to save them, get them back together and ensure the future of the human race doesn’t go tumbling over a cliff into oblivion.
► Stone-age technology! 
• Endless prehistoric puzzle fun – enjoy dozens of unique levels of logic adventures with Comics Bob and his stone-age queen. Each situation has two possible outcomes: disaster or delight for poor bewildered Bob, but so much fun for you that you won’t mind trying again if you can’t get it right first time.
• A Paleo diet for your brain – attune your sophisticated 21st century brain to the wild primitive thinking of the stone age, where the tools are simple but the the uses they can be put to are ingenious. You’ll need all your guile and imagination to choose the right answers and get Bob and his missus past the obstacles that stand in the way of true love.
• Cave art, cave music, cave party! – the setting may be primitive and the gameplay couldn’t be simpler, but the graphics and music in Comics Bob are gorgeous, recalling over a century of classic cartoons and comics, and ensuring a joyful experience for players of all ages.
• You can’t stop progress! – regular updates and new episodes ensure the fun keeps on coming. What’s Bob got up his loin cloth this time? You’ll never guess in this zany puzzle-solving adventure where the surprises never end.
► Get primitive!
Tired of the complexities and stresses of hi-tech modern life? This is the game for you! Get back to a simpler and even sillier time when women were real women, men were really dumb, and romance somehow flourished nonetheless! Download Comics Bob today to explore a wild and wacky ancient world filled with colorful creatures and crazy situations, save humanity from its own stupidity, and enjoy innocent, endlessly entertaining pre-historic puzzle fun!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00135911:ios.summary:

Join Football Fans' social
bluejetty:00135911:ios.description:
Fanzword is a live fantasy football game app, besides following live match scores, transfer news, sports schedules, and goals. Experience a football game like never before! Discuss matches and share your opinion.
Join Football Fans' social network and engage with sports fans to play in a fantasy football game like no other! 
Get more points and win valuable prizes by predicting scores, answering trivia questions, and rating players and goals.
FOLLOW YOUR FAVORITE TEAM
Who scored? Who won? Where does your dream team rank? Which players are performing in the Premier League?
With Fanzword, you will stay current with all news from the Premier League, La Liga, SPL, Arsenal, Barcelona, Real Madrid, Manchester United, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, UEFA Champions League, World Cup, and more. We bring you a football community dressed in real football fans’ colors. Follow your team, make predictions, check stats, discuss games and earn rewards.
LIVE SCORES & PREDICTION
Football comes alive on your mobile phone with live scores and feeds at your fingertips. Make your vote count by rating players and earning points and rewards. Get flash scores and discuss games with fellow fans.
FEATURES INCLUDE:
• Fanzword helps you keep a watchful eye on your dream team and its opponents. News, flash scores, and all related football topics in one place.
• Be truly engaged in a football community with match result predictions. Predict scores and compare with other football fans.
• Rate players and have your voice heard by others. Sing your dream team’s praises and bring a world of football pain to opposing teams.
• Rate goals in every match.
• Demonstrate your skills and knowledge by recommending and predicting substitutions.
• Gain points by interacting with the football community, discussing football matches, rating players, rating goals, and whatever else tickles your fancy in the football arena!
• Boost your football fan’s profile ranking and win gifts.
FOOTBALL COMMUNITY
Discuss matches with millions of fans worldwide in one place. Live scores and matches buzz on your mobile phone. News and predictions from all matches in progress.
With Fanzword on your phone, the beautiful game of football is with you everywhere you go. You know what they say: 7 days without football makes one weak!
Contact us:
Email: contact@fanzword.com
Web: www.fanzword.com
Facebook: Facebook.com/fanzword
Instagram: @fanzword
Twitter: @fanzword_app

bluejetty:00096422:ios.summary:

Snap
bluejetty:00096422:ios.description:
The smartest way to scan, value, and track your toy collection.
Toyzie AI is the AI-powered scanner built for diecast hunters, Hot Wheels collectors, and toy enthusiasts who want to know exactly what they have — and what it's worth.
Snap any Hot Wheels car, action figure, Funko, minifig, or TCG card and Toyzie reveals brand, year, series, rarity, and live market value in seconds.
Key Features
* Scan & Identify
Point your camera at any collectible and instantly get its name, brand, series, casting, and release year. Built for diecast first — Toyzie recognizes Mainline, Premium, Boulevard, Car Culture, Pop Culture, and RLC releases, and flags Treasure Hunts (TH) and Super Treasure Hunts (STH) the moment you scan them.
* AI Grading
Get an estimated condition score powered by AI.
The system analyzes packaging, surface quality, edges, alignment, and overall structure to provide a grading score inspired by leading toy grading standards (AFA / CGA style).
Perfect for understanding condition before professional grading — whether your piece is carded or loose.
* Value & Market Data
See estimated market value, recent sales activity, and price trends based on verified collector and marketplace data.
Make smarter decisions on buying, selling, or holding — at the peg or after the pull.
* Rarity & Demand Analysis
Understand how rare your collectible really is.
AI evaluates production details, casting variations, series popularity, and collector demand to estimate rarity levels such as:
Common
Uncommon
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Spot chase variants, Spectraflame paint, Real Riders wheels, and ZAMAC finishes — the details serious hunters look for.
* Build Your Collection
Save, organize, and categorize your toys into personal collections like:
Diecast Cars (Hot Wheels, Matchbox, and more)
Action Figures
Minifigs
Funko Pops
TCG Cards
Vintage Toys
Designer Collectibles
Track your collection by series, year, casting, or rarity — all in one place.
* Discover New Listings
Explore newly listed and trending collectibles across multiple categories.
See what's hot in the collector market right now — from fresh mainline releases to grail-tier finds.
Whether you're peg hunting at the store, organizing a years-deep collection, or just trying to figure out what that car your kid found is actually worth, Toyzie AI gives you the answer in seconds.
Some features including full toy scans with brand, release year, and market value require a subscription.
Hot Wheels, Matchbox, Funko, and other brand names mentioned are trademarks of their respective owners. Toyzie AI is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Mattel, Inc. or any other brand owner.
Privacy Policy: https://www.nineg.co/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00200020:ios.description:
iBend Pipe — Bend It Right the First Time
iBend Pipe is a professional conduit bending calculator designed to help electricians make accurate bends faster and reduce wasted material. Whether you're bending a simple offset or laying out a complex compound bend around an obstruction, iBend Pipe gives you the information you need to bend it right—the first time.
CONDUIT BENDING CALCULATORS
Calculate the following bends using English or Metric measurements:
• Offsets — bend toward or away from an obstruction 
• Rolling Offsets — bend toward or away from an obstruction 
• Parallel Offset Adjustments 
• 3-Bend Saddles 
• 4-Bend Saddles 
• Segmented Bends 
• 90° Bends 
• Back-to-Back 90° Bends 
• Kicked 90° Bends 
• Compound 90° Bends around round obstructions 
• Compound 90° Bends around square obstructions 
• Compound 90° Bends around rectangular obstructions 
FAST, ONE-SCREEN CALCULATIONS
Enter your measurements and see results update instantly. There’s no need to work through multiple screens just to get a measurement. iBend Pipe is designed to keep the calculation and results visible so you can work quickly and efficiently.
Large, easy-to-read measurements make the app practical to use on the job.
ACCURATE, PRACTICAL RESULTS
iBend Pipe goes beyond basic bending multipliers. Centerline bending radius calculations are available for greater accuracy, and bends automatically account for shrink so you don't have to do the math yourself.
Pre-position your bends, plan your layout, and get the information you need before you start bending.
What's faster—bending it twice or bending it right the first time?
PROTRACTOR INCLUDED
Use the built-in protractor to measure your bend angle as you bend. The measured angle can be sent directly back to your calculation, helping you work faster without switching between tools.
BENDER PROFILES
iBend Pipe includes nearly 100 bender and conduit combinations. You can also customize or modify profiles to match the benders and conduit you use in the field.
FRACTIONS, NOT JUST DECIMALS
Enter measurements as fractions instead of converting everything to decimals. Get your results in practical measurements you can use on the job.
BUILT FOR ELECTRICIANS
iBend Pipe is for the electrician who takes pride in their work.
If you're the person other electricians come to when they have a difficult bend, this app is for you. If you want less wasted conduit in the bone pile, this app is for you. If you can write your name in conduit, this app is definitely for you.
From a first-year apprentice to a seasoned journeyman, iBend Pipe is designed to save time, reduce wasted material, and make difficult conduit bends easier to plan.
Bend it right. The first time.
Thanks for all the great reviews! If you have questions or suggestions, contact me at:
support@ibendpipe.com

• SECURE, RELIABLE, AND EASY TO USE
• LIVE VIDEO ANYWHERE
• SUPER SENSITIVE AUDIO

• PICTURE IN PICTURE AND BACKGROUND MONITORING

Now with Cloud Baby Monitor you can keep an eye on your little one anywhere and at all times. 
Start using Cloud Baby Monitor app today and see why it is the best in class!
SECURE, RELIABLE, AND EASY TO USE
Use your iPhone, iPad, iPod touch or a Mac as a baby unit, place it in your baby's room and enjoy live full screen video and crystal clear audio on your second device working as a parent unit. Both devices will be connected automatically, without any configuration. All communication is secure, end to end encrypted by industry standard encryption to make sure that only you have the access to your baby video stream.
LIVE VIDEO ANYWHERE
Cloud Baby Monitor works anywhere where your devices have internet connectivity. Supports any Wi-Fi network, 3G, 4G, LTE, or 5G. Uses Bluetooth in places without internet. 
SUPER SENSITIVE AUDIO
Hear your baby breathing as if he or she was sleeping next to you.
NOISE AND MOTION ALERTS
Get notified about all child’s activities with noise and motion alerts.
ACTIVITY LOG
Analyse sleep patterns by reviewing events stored in activity log.
PICTURE IN PICTURE AND BACKGROUND MONITORING
Multitask on your iPhone or iPad while monitoring your little one in the background via Picture in Picture support.
WHITE NOISES AND LULLABIES INCLUDED
Enjoy the set of the most popular lullabies and white noises for the babies included in the app. Remotely control volume, playback, and auto stop timer.
CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYLISTS
Create custom playlists with songs, white noises, or fairy tales from your iTunes library.
NIGHT LIGHT WITH REMOTE BRIGHTNESS CONTROL
Use remotely controlled night light to watch your baby sleeping through the night. Brightness control allows you to adjust light intensity to get a nice picture and not disturb the baby. 
TALK TO BABY WITH LIVE VIDEO AND AUDIO
Easily soothe the baby with live video and audio streamed from the parent unit to the baby unit.
MULTI-PARENT AND MULTI-CHILD SUPPORT
Watch multiple baby unit devices at the same time to monitor two children sleeping in different rooms.
Watch your baby from multiple parent unit devices at the same time.
AVAILABLE FOR OTHER DEVICES
Cloud Baby Monitor is available for Mac, Apple TV, and other popular mobile devices.
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Happy customers are our highest priority and your feedback is always welcome. If you have any issue or suggestion, please contact us directly at support@cloudbabymonitor.com. 
Thank you for using Cloud Baby Monitor.

bluejetty:00091763:ios.name: Seedtime: Garden Planner App
bluejetty:00091763:ios.summary: With the Seedtime companion app you finally have a place to track your garden tasks, noteA smoother Seedtime: harvest Records for everyone, search that handles any crop name, and forms that stay clear of the keyboard.s, and observations - a
bluejetty:00091763:ios.description:
With the Seedtime companion app you finally have a place to track your garden tasks, noteA smoother Seedtime: harvest Records for everyone, search that handles any crop name, and forms that stay clear of the keyboard.s, and observations - all in one simple place on your phone. Use your own personal calendar, task list, journal, and more to turbocharge your growing experience like never before!
CALENDAR
Add crops to your gardening calendar to easily visualize when to seed, transplant, harvest and more - all based on your local area. With your Seedtime Calendar you’ll be able to:
- Add and edit crops in your growing calendar with just a few taps
- Choose between spring or fall plantings and add succession plantings to plan a continual harvest all year round
- Adjust your plantings on the fly with simple drag and drop editing
- Sort, filter, and view your calendar in different ways to maximize your productivity
TASKS
Tasks will auto-compile from your Seedtime Calendar plan with a daily or weekly checklist so you never fall behind again. Just plan your garden out in the web-app and then use the mobile app to stay on track through the gardening season. With the task list you’ll be able to:
- View your daily or weekly task list
- Mark tasks as complete as you do them in the garden (syncs with the calendar)
- Edit task dates if you need to adjust them
- View “what to do” and “how to do it” information for tasks
- Quick links over to the Seedtime Classroom to watch short masterclass videos for tasks
JOURNAL
Your task list is awesome - but it doesn’t stop there. Use the Seedtime Journal to keep track of your notes or observations in the garden. With the journal you’ll be able to:
- Add pictures to your journal entries to track your garden progress over time
- Tag entries with related tasks
- Link your notes to specific plantings
- Search all of your notes for anything you’ve written about
- Filter all your entries by crop plantings, tags, or dates
CLASSROOM
You’ll also have access to our entire masterclass video lesson series walking you through each step and phase of the garden to grow an abundance of fresh food right in your backyard. With the classroom you’ll be able to:
- View short masterclass video lessons with step-by-step instructions
- Discover how to do various tasks in your garden
- Learn how to get to desired end results in your garden like how to keep your garden weed free without spending hours on your knees pulling weeds, how to deal with pests and diseases in a natural and organic way, how to extend your season into the winter without breaking your pocketbook, and more…
ASK SPROUT
With the Seedtime Sprout Bot, you can ask any of your gardening or Seedtime questions and get answers on the fly. Or push your questions to our team to connect directly with us.
- Ask about which crops to companion plant together
- Get answers about pest or disease problems
- Ask about how to trellis your plants or care for them
- And more… (really ask just about anything!)
STORE
Quick and easy access to hundreds of non-GMO seeds, natural fertilizers, and other garden supplies to quickly and easily get what you need to grow your best garden ever.
And believe it or not, this is just the beginning!
Coming soon you’ll be able to plan your garden layout directly in the mobile app as well - making it the easiest place to make changes on the fly in your garden. Until then, you can use the web-app to layout your garden, and more. Then you can use this companion app to easily stay on track with your garden plan while out in the field.
Enjoy! And let’s grow your best garden ever this year!

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Добавл
bluejetty:00177717:ios.description:
Дом с Алисой — приложение, в котором удобно настраивать умный дом и управлять им даже в дороге. Подключайте лампочки, пылесосы, датчики и тысячи других устройств — и контролируйте их здесь или через колонку.
• ВСЁ В ОДНОМ ПРИЛОЖЕНИИ
Добавляйте и удаляйте самые разные устройства, от колонок с Алисой до кондиционеров, меняйте названия и расположение — и настраивайте, как вам нравится.
• УДАЛЁННОЕ УПРАВЛЕНИЕ
Дом под контролем, даже если вы далеко: скажем, по дороге на дачу можно заранее включить обогреватель.
• ОДНА КОМАНДА ДЛЯ ВСЕГО
Запускайте нескольких устройств одной фразой — например, «Алиса, скоро буду дома». Настройте сценарий, и по этой команде включится кондиционер, пылесос начнёт уборку, а в коридоре зажжётся свет.
• ДОМ, КОТОРЫЙ САМ О ВАС ЗАБОТИТСЯ
Подключайте датчики — к примеру, температуры и влажности, — и проверяйте, как дела дома. Создайте сценарий, добавьте обогреватель и что-нибудь ещё — и дом будет сам следить, чтобы в нём хорошо дышалось.
• РУТИННЫЕ ДЕЛА ПО РАСПИСАНИЮ
Поручите часть домашних дел Алисе. Достаточно один раз настроить расписание, и она будет сама поливать цветы и включать перед сном увлажнитель.
• СЦЕНАРИЙ В ОДНО КАСАНИЕ
Добавьте сценарий в виджет — и кнопка управления будет всегда под рукой, на главном экране телефона.
• ТЫСЯЧИ РАЗНЫХ УСТРОЙСТВ
Подключайте сколько угодно домашних приборов разных производителей: в магазине вы узнаете эти устройства по отметке «Работает с Алисой».

bluejetty:00179355:ios.summary:

Health Data Importer is the easiest, fastest, and most reliable way to transfer your Health data from your old phone to your new one. Don't depend
bluejetty:00179355:ios.description:
※ As recommended by Macstories, iDownloadBlog, LifeHacker, iPhoneBlog.de, iMore, and more! ※
Health Data Importer is the easiest, fastest, and most reliable way to transfer your Health data from your old phone to your new one. Don't depend on other apps that might lose your data—Health Data Importer is battle-tested with thousands of users and supports all versions of Apple's Health XML format. Start fresh without a backup when you get your new device and easily import your existing health data. Health Data Importer imports all Health data except Activity Summaries, Stand Hours, Exercise Time, and Nike Fuel data (these are API limitations).
If you ever have wanted to bring all of your health data onto a new phone without having to do a full iCloud restore, this is the app for you.
To see how easy it is, just watch the preview video (no sound). Note: while we use iCloud Drive in the preview video, iCloud Drive does not need to be enabled in order to perform an import. Just send your import to yourself in Apple mail and open it with Health Data Importer.
Health Data Importer integrates with the HealthKit framework and Health.app to import your Health XML exports.
◆ Testimonials ◆
“Health Importer is the app I wish I had when I moved from the iPhone 6 Plus to the 6s Plus last year. [...] Health Importer worked perfectly in my tests and I'm going to use it again as soon as I switch to an iPhone 7 Plus.” - Federico Viticci, Macstories
“Health Data Importer does exactly what the name suggests. Download the app, then load it up on your fresh new iPhone. It will scan your iCloud backups for any health data, then import all of it over to your new phone.” - Thorin Klosowski, Lifehacker
“I believe Health Data Importer to be the best way to move your Health data between two iPhones. It is simple, quick, and very reliable” - Sébastian Page, iDownloadBlog
◆ Features ◆
‣ Import multiple sources (Apple Watch, iPhone, or from third-party apps).
‣ Fast, quick, efficient, and battle-tested—import all your health data in just a few seconds.
‣ Supports all Health app XML export versions.
◆ Help and Support ◆
If you run into an issue, please email our team at support@lionheartsw.com. We've helped many customers import their data successfully and will try our best to help you too.
◆ Health XML Splitter ◆
Health Data Importer has trouble handling large exports, so we've written a macOS tool, called Health XML Splitter, to help you split them up into smaller pieces. Health XML Splitter is available for free on the Mac App Store.
Health Data Importer's privacy policy: https://lionheartsw.com/software/health-importer/privacy.html
Health Data Importer's terms of use: https://lionheartsw.com/software/health-importer/terms.html

bluejetty:00169755:ios.description:
Automatically save money while you shop on your iPhone. Tin is a Safari extension that applies the best coupon codes at checkout, and tracks your package so you never miss a delivery (or a deal)!
YOUR SAVINGS SUPERHERO
Tin scours the internet to find the best discount codes across 50,000+ retailers and automatically applies the best savings ($$$). This means more money in your pocket, so you can focus on finding that new outfit and let the deals come to you!
ALL-IN-ONE PACKAGE TRACKING
From checkout to doorstep, we’ve got you covered. Tin Savings tracks shipments and organizes all of your deliveries in one place.
CLOSE YOUR TABS FOR TIN’S NEW WISHLIST
No more searching through shopping tabs and screenshots to find that cute shirt from last week. Tin automatically saves every product you browse in Safari for easy access later! Even better, favorite products and Tin will let you know when there’s a sale or discount available! 
PAY LESS. SHOP MORE. CLEAR YOUR INBOX
Your email inbox is flooded with promotional emails that you don’t open. Tin Savings finds promotion codes buried in your emails so you always pay the lowest price. We save you time & money by keeping your inbox clean & serene. While most shoppers are playing checkers, Tin helps you play chess (checkmate!). Saving money is so sweet - it's sweeter than honey!
The best part? It’s totally free! Download Tin Savings today, and never pay more than you need to again!
Tin Savings is an app and mobile Safari extension, all wrapped into one. Simply install the extension in Safari and let Tin Savings do its thing!
INSTALL TIN IN SAFARI
1. Tap "aA" button in the Safari menu
2. Tap the "Extension" icon to Manage Extensions
3. Select "Tin" and set it to "ON"
4. Select "Always Allow"
5. Select "Always Allow on Every Website"
6. That’s it! Now you can shop in Safari and let Tin do its thing.
When you are ready to checkout, Tin will pop up and automatically apply discount codes to find you the best savings!

bluejetty:00156666:ios.description:
Welcome to Voice Changer App, a feature-rich, fun, and practical voice-changing application that can make your voice more interesting!
Voice Changer supports high-quality original sound recording and voice-changing. In addition to basic voice-changing functions such as male-female conversion and karaoke voice-changing, it also has the following special features:
"Real-time Voice Changer": Easily convert your recording in real-time to male, female, or other various voices, giving your voice more variety.
"Chat Voice Changer": Change your voice while chatting, making prank calls, or adding a sense of mystery to your conversation.
"Game Voice Changer": A feature designed specifically for game streamers, supporting lossless noise reduction sound quality and real-time interaction during gameplay.
"Customized Voice": Supports custom voice settings, allowing you to create a unique voice.
Voice Changer is easy to use, without requiring professional skills. With just one click, you can complete recording and voice-changing. It also supports usage in various chat and game software, adding more fun to your voice communication.
Whether you want to make your voice more interesting or add fun to your chat or gameplay, Voice Changer is your best choice! Try it now!

bluejetty:00165349:ios.description:
Pop Pop Bunny: A Whimsical Puzzle Adventure 
No Ads, Playable Offline
Rediscover the Classic Merge Game Fun with a Charming Twist! 
Welcome to Pop Pop Bunny, where merge games get a delightful twist! Immerse yourself in a world where adorable bunnies are waiting for your strategic moves. Daily Challenges, Endless Excitement! Every day brings a new set of bunnies in a predetermined sequence, ensuring a fresh and engaging experience. Wake up to a new puzzle, plan your strategy, and see how you fare each day. 
Daily Challenges, Endless Excitement!
Every day brings a new set of bunnies in a predetermined sequence, ensuring a fresh and engaging experience. Wake up to a new puzzle, plan your strategy, and see how you score each day.
All-New Adventure Mode!
Take on an all-new Adventure Mode with 32 hand-curated levels. Each level offers unique challenges and objectives, can you collect all the stars?
Explore New Biomes
Journey through space and winter biomes, each introducing new ways to play. With 14 unique mechanics and abilities, every biome adds fresh twists to your puzzle strategy.
Competitive and Social: Play with Friends and the World!
Challenge your friends and players globally in a race to the top of the leaderboard. Who can merge their way to the highest score? Show off your puzzle-solving prowess and climb the ranks with improved leaderboards featuring more detailed information.
Stuck? Power Through!
Use 4 new powerups to help you out of tricky situations and keep your game going.
Features:
- No ads
- Playable offline
- Unique Daily Puzzles: A new challenge every day with a shared bunny sequence for all players
- Adventure Mode: 32 curated levels with 1-3 stars earnable per level
- Space and Winter Biomes with 14 unique mechanics and abilities
- Improved leaderboards with global rankings
- 4 Powerups to help when you’re stuck
- Family-Friendly Fun: Suitable for all ages with easy-to-learn gameplay
Dive into this cute, cozy puzzle adventure today. Perfect for players looking for a relaxing yet challenging game. Are you ready to merge your way to the top?

bluejetty:00129161:ios.name: Night Owl Protect
bluejetty:00129161:ios.summary: Night Owl Protect lets you view all of your devices in one easy-to-use mobile app. Monitor your home or business in real-time on your smartphone or Tablet. Easily share images and recordings via your favorite social network or through email
bluejetty:00129161:ios.description:
Night Owl Protect lets you view all of your devices in one easy-to-use mobile app. Monitor your home or business in real-time on your smartphone or Tablet. Easily share images and recordings via your favorite social network or through email and text. Staying connected to your devices allows you to protect your world from potential threats. Secure, PROTECT and connect your world!
With Night Owl Protect, You Can:
• Quickly and easily set up your product with our Secure App-Based Bluetooth Setup
• Receive real-time mobile alerts when a human, face or vehicle is detected
• Easily configure your alert settings, so you get the notifications you want
• View live footage from your connected cameras
• Use audio features (2-Way Audio, Siren, Preset Voice Messages) with applicable models
• Search for and playback recordings using filters
• Save and share recordings right from your mobile device
• Take snapshot images and save and share them right from your mobile device 
• Keep your data secure with 2-Step Verification, which safeguards your privacy by requiring two authentication steps for login
• Conveniently and securely access multiple devices with one set of login credentials (Single Sign-On)
• Securely reset your password, right from the app
• Create favorites and groups to better access select cameras when desired
• Share access to your cameras with friends and family
• Access recordings saved to the Night Owl Protect Cloud, if your product is linked to a Night Owl Protect Cloud monthly subscription plan
NOTE: Not all features apply to all models. We have multiple products, with different features, that use the Night Owl Protect mobile application. Please refer to your product’s specifications for applicable features.
Night Owl Security Products is a leading innovator in the security technology industry and is one of the only U.S.-based, U.S.-owned security companies. At Night Owl, all our products are proudly designed and engineered in the United States by skilled personnel, so we can make your privacy and security our top priority. Additionally, Night Owl is in compliance with the U.S. government’s stance on protecting our nation per Section 889 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). Unlike other brands, Night Owl products do not contain any essential components from specific banned China-based companies. We are proudly compliant with the new FCC Covered List and strongly believe in the importance of protecting Human Rights and the national security of the U.S.A. Our video surveillance equipment is used by homeowners, businesses, federal and municipal organizations, retailers, dealers, distributors, and integrators across the globe.
Visit us at www.NightOwlSP.com for more information on all our products and services.

bluejetty:00075629:ios.description:
Pass your VTNE with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
Updated for the 2026 VTNE blueprint with the latest question styles, medications, and clinical task guidance so you always study the most relevant content.
The Veterinary Technician National Examination (VTNE) is an examination designed to evaluate entry-level veterinary technicians' competency to practice and to become credentialed. Successful completion of the VTNE is required for licensure in most states and Canadian provinces. The VTNE is owned and administered by the American Association of Veterinary State Boards (AAVSB).
Follow a specially designed personal study plan and train yourself to pass the first time!
Key features:
- Choose from different topics required to pass a certification
- Practice with 700+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://mastrapi.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://mastrapi.com/policy

Wildix Collaboration Mobile is the Unified Communication system for your iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch.
Wildix Collaboration Mobile application brings UC services to your iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch allowing you to make and receive calls via your enterprise Wildix PBX, to chat in real time with all the users of the system and to know when your colleagues are available.
Highlights
* Highly secure application with exceptional voice quality
* Video and audio calls, Presence, Messaging
* Push notifications of incoming calls and chat while in background
Telephony features
* Calls via VoIP or mobility to all contacts in the phonebook
* Video calls to users of the system
* Call history of received, missed and dialed calls
* Multiple call support - hold, swap between two active calls, transfer calls (attended & blind)
* Voicemail access via feature code
* Automatic codec selection to ensure optimal call quality
Messaging and Presence
* Chat with all the users of the system
* Send reminder/memo messages to all the users of the system
* Chat history
* Presence status and location of colleagues
* Personal Presence status and location
* Push notifications of chat messages
Requirements
- WMS version 6.01 or higher
- iOS version 12.0 or higher
- minimum supported device - iPhone 5S (6,6S,6S Plus,5S)

bluejetty:00096628:ios.description:
Category Match is a quick, delightful logic game where each round shows a category (e.g., Fruits) and several words—only one doesn’t belong. Tap the odd one out to score, build streaks, and train your brain in minutes a day.
Why you’ll love it
Instant play: No tutorials needed—tap the outlier and go.
Super snappy: Rounds take seconds; perfect for short breaks.
Clean & cozy: Soft gradient background and readable typography.
100+ offline rounds: Works anywhere—no accounts, no internet.
Game Modes
Classic: One mistake ends the run—precision over speed.
Timed (90s): Answer as many as you can before time runs out.
Endless: Up to 5 mistakes—how long can you last?
Daily Challenge: One exclusive round each day.
How to play
Read the category (e.g., Fruits).
Scan the words; one does not fit.
Tap the odd word to score +10. Wrong taps increase mistakes.
Progress & History
Your results are stored locally on your device. Check History to review scores, correct/incorrect counts, and dates per mode.
Offline & Privacy
Fully offline: No login, no ads, no tracking.
Local data only: Your records stay on your device.
Reset anytime: Clear data from Settings.
Accessibility
High-contrast text, large tap targets, and haptic/audio toggles for a comfortable experience.
Perfect for
Logic lovers, word puzzle fans, students, and anyone who enjoys quick brain teasers.

On Demand

bluejetty:00039977:ios.description:
Participate in premier auctions happening around the globe from your mobile device. 
Invaluable is the leading online auction marketplace for fine art, antiques, and collectibles. We work with premier auction houses worldwide to bring you online auctions across diverse categories, including master paintings, decorative art, watches, fine jewelry, Hollywood collectibles, sports memorabilia, antique firearms, Asian art, exquisite ceramics, pottery, and more. 
LIVE BIDDING 
Feel the thrill of participating in an auction in real-time from anywhere in the world. With Invaluable's exclusive 'swipe-to-bid' technology, you can bid live or leave absentee bids in advance.  
UNIQUE ITEMS 
Discover rare and unique items when you explore artist pages or search by keyword, category, or auction house.  
CURATED RECOMMENDATIONS 
Receive personalized daily recommendations for one-of-a-kind treasures that you're passionate about. Whether you're hunting for baseball cards, Japanese netsuke, classic comics, you'll be expanding your collection in no time.  
HUNDREDS OF CATEGORIES 
Browse hundreds of online auction categories now and start transforming your home and collection with art and objects you're most passionate about: 
  - Evocative contemporary art, one of the hottest categories in the art market today, ranging from works on paper to paintings to sculpture. 
- Old Master paintings that exude timeless beauty and sophistication. 
- Exquisite Asian art of Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Southeast, and South Asian origins. Porcelain, figurines, paintings, scrolls, military artifacts like katana swords, and more ornate objects reflect their craftsmen's unparalleled skill. 
- Classic jewelry staple pieces like gold and diamond rings, bracelets, necklaces, earrings, pins, and brooches with precious stones from Tiffany's and other premier brands. 
- Military and historical artifacts spanning centuries – from the American Civil War to World War I and World War II, on through the Space Race. 
- Collectibles from Hollywood stars and the movie theater blockbusters that helped shape the cultural zeitgeist – Star Wars memorabilia, classic movie posters, movie-worn costumes and accessories, and autographs. 
- Sports memorabilia from the greatest names in sports history, including baseball, basketball, golf and football cards, autographs, and more. 
- Photography, lithographs, and prints that capture history – in both black and white and vivid color. 
- Modern and antique furniture for every room in your home: beds, cabinets, and dressers from American, English, and European classics to mid-century modern and Art Deco styles. 
- A wide array of fine art, including Impressionist art, mixed-media art, abstract art, and sculptures. 
- Women's and men's wristwatches, vintage timepieces, and pocket watches from classic and contemporary designers like Rolex, Omega, Breitling, Elgin, and more. 
- Collectibles from rock and roll royalty – including guitars, stage-worn clothing, albums, photographs, autographs, and concert posters. 
- Vintage spirits and fine wines from Bordeaux to Bourbon whiskey. 
FEEDBACK 
Your feedback is important to us. Please contact us with any questions at appfeedback@invaluable.com.

bluejetty:00064389:ios.description:
SLYDE is the real-time dating app where things actually happen. No fake swiping, no awkward bios, no ghosting for three days. Just post your selfie, go live, and match with real people nearby who are online right now.
Your photo becomes your profile and goes live for 69 minutes. During that window, other people near you can check you out and decide if they’re down to chat. If the feeling’s mutual, you’re instantly connected. If not, your profile disappears when time runs out and you start fresh. It’s all about quick connections - no pressure, no waiting around.
SLYDE skips the small talk and gets to the point. No names, no horoscopes, no resume-style bios. You stay anonymous until you match, and every chat has an expiration time. If you’re both into it, you keep talking. If not, no big deal - it all resets and you’re back in the game. There’s nothing to clean up, no awkward DMs, and no endless conversations going nowhere.
If you’re looking for flirty chat, casual dating, spontaneous meetups or just vibing with someone new tonight, SLYDE makes it easy. Everyone you see is real, nearby, and online now - not some profile from two weeks ago. We’re talking real-time matching with people who are actually available to talk, meet up, or see what happens.
SLYDE is perfect if you're bored, curious, freshly single, or just in the mood to meet someone without overthinking it. It’s low-key, fun, and fast. You’re in control. It’s your vibe, your window, your rules.
On SLYDE, your profile is anonymous and the people you see have all been active recently. Whether you’re into flirting, late night convos, real connections, or just checking out who's around, SLYDE gives you an easy way in.
Want a little more control? SLYDE FIRE lets you stay live longer, boost your visibility, and revive expired chats with people you had a spark with.
SLYDE is already popular in cities like LA, New York, Chicago, Austin, and Miami. If you’re local, chances are it’s already going off near you.
For casual dating tips and smart ways to get the most out of SLYDE, head to getslyde.app.
Terms of use: https://www.appeasel.co.uk/SLYDE/SLYDETERMS.html

bluejetty:00114470:ios.description:
SkySafari 8 Pro sets a new standard for mobile astronomy. Built on the most complete astronomical database ever put on a phone, it delivers unmatched accuracy, powerful observing and planning tools, seamless telescope and Alpaca camera control, and a beautifully refined interface. Whether you're exploring from your backyard or planning an all-night session, SkySafari 8 Pro gives you the clarity, precision, and reliability that serious observers depend on.
What’s New in Version 8
+ UI Themes - Customize your experience with five new UI color themes. Instantly change the look of the app with a fresh visual palette.
+ ASCOM ALPACA Camera Support - Connect and control ALPACA-compatible astronomy cameras directly from SkySafari. 
+ SmartEye Support - Seamless integration with SmartEye for enhanced imaging workflows.
+ Image Gallery - Import your own images from AstroBin, FITS files, local storage, URLs, or an ALPACA camera. Includes basic editing tools.
+ Plate Solving - Quickly plate-solve imported images and place them directly onto the sky chart.
+ Lunar Surface Outlines - Explore the Moon like never before with detailed outlines for maria, craters, mountains, and more.
+ Appulses in Events Finder - Find precise moments when the Moon or planets pass close to the Pleiades, other planets, or stars of a chosen magnitude. Also includes transit and occultation search capabilities.
+ Rotatable FOV Indicator - Rotate the field of view to any angle - perfect for matching your camera orientation.
+ Observing Conditions (Premium) - Get observer-focused hourly forecasts, including best viewing windows, seeing index, and sky quality metrics.
If you're new to SkySafari 8 Pro, here’s what you can do:
+ Point & Identify - Hold your device to the sky and instantly identify stars, constellations, planets, satellites, and more.
+ Travel Through Time - Simulate the sky up to 5 million years backward or forward. Animate meteor showers, conjunctions, eclipses, and other events.
+ Telescope Control - Control your telescope and manage your observing sessions with advanced planning and logging tools. Supports ASCOM ALPACA, INDI, and StarSense Explorer.

bluejetty:00139737:ios.description:
Bring the web to your personal knowledge base. Save content to your Obsidian vault so you always have access to it, even offline. Obsidian is secure, private, and designed around durable open formats that allows you to preserve your data for the long term.
Whether you're researching for a project, saving recipes, bookmarking travel destinations, or collecting inspiring articles, the Obsidian Web Clipper helps you organize your ideas.
- Clip anything: From news articles and blog posts to recipes, product pages, and research papers — if it's on the web, you can save it.
- Select page content: Clip entire pages, selected text, or let the clipper intelligently extract just the main content.
- Customizable templates: Create tailored templates to automatically extract metadata from web pages. Perfect for academics, movie buffs, book lovers, or anyone who wants structured notes.
- Smart triggers: Set up rules to automatically apply the right template based on the website you're clipping from.
- Seamless integration: all your clips flow directly into Obsidian, in the vault and folder of your choice.
As with everything Obsidian, Web Clipper is designed to protect your privacy, and give you control over your data.
- No lock-in: All your clips are saved in clean, durable, portable Markdown files — no proprietary formats.
- Offline access: your saved clips are saved locally, and always at your fingertips, with or without an internet connection.
- 100% private: all your clipped content is stored locally in your Obsidian vault. Your thoughts are yours.
Obsidian helps you create connections and links between your notes so you can organize your thoughts. You can create links between everything — ideas, articles, lists, locations, books — anything you can put in a note, you can link to other notes.

bluejetty:00127950:ios.description:
The PayPal POS app (ex Zettle) empowers you to easily and seamlessly accept in-person payments. From accepting card, contactless, e-wallet payments to tracking sales, PayPal POS has a suite of payment solution to fit your business' needs. Whether you’re running a coffee shop, clothing store or barber shop, PayPal POS is the one app you need accept payments, manage inventory, and track sales in one complete app. No monthly fees, no set-up costs and no lock-in contracts.
The PayPal POS app is free to download and comes with a range of features:
• Simplify your inventory management with an intuitive product library
• Accept contactless payments with TTP or accept payment types including card, contactless, e-wallets, and more with the Card Reader or Terminal
• Customize receipts and print, text or email them to your customers
• Collect sales data and use easy-to-understand reports to grow your business
• Create multiple staff accounts to track individuals’ sales
• Benefit from a wide range of integrations, including Accounting and E-commerce integrations as well as integrations specially tailored for restaurants, retail, and health & beauty business
How do I get started?
1. Download the PayPal POS app and sign up for an account
2. Start taking card payments immediately with TTP, or order your PayPal Reader, with rapid delivery (2-3 working days)
Tap to Pay: Quickly and easily capture contactless in-person payments on-the-go with just your phone and the Point of Sale app. Just download the app and start selling. No storefront or additional hardware required.
PayPal Reader and Dock:
The new PayPal Reader and Dock are quick to set up and easy to use, allowing you to accept all major credit cards and contactless payments - including Apple Pay. A clear pricing model without fixed costs or fixed contracts. The PayPal Reader meets all requirements from the payment industry and is EMV-approved and PCI DSS-compliant.
*A stable WiFi and Bluetooth connection may be required

Connect Flowers - An exhilarating line-connect puzzle game that draws water from a water source to a flower seedling to make it bloom into a beautiful flower!
Connect Flowers" is an exhilarating puzzle game in which you draw water from a water source to a flower seedling to make it bloom beautifully. Intuitive controls will keep your brain active while you relax!
Game Features:
Easy controls: Simple rules for drawing lines from the water source to the flower seedlings. Anyone can enjoy the game immediately.
Beautiful visuals: Vivid flowers bloom one after another, providing a visual treat.
Challenging puzzles: The difficulty level increases as the game progresses. Test your thinking skills!
Rules:
Draw lines: Create waterways by drawing lines from water sources of the same color to flower seedlings.
Watch out for crossings: Make sure the lines don't cross and deliver water to all the flower seedlings.
Complete the puzzle: Solve the puzzle in each stage to make all the flowers bloom.
Connect Flowers" is the perfect brain training puzzle for when you are commuting to work or just want to relax. Easy to start, yet profound gameplay awaits you. You will surely lose track of time and get hooked!

bluejetty:00166148:ios.description:
Keep track of your loved ones exact position, get all the important information for you to feel relaxed about your family members’ security, and make sure all your relatives are safe while taking care of them just from the screen of your phone.
• Know your loved ones’ exact position, and let them know your exact position at any moment.
• Create customizable profiles for you and all your family members.

Take care of your family, keep an eye on your children, and make sure your loved ones are always safe while continuing with your daily life.

bluejetty:00169584:ios.description:
Stay close to God through Scripture that meets you in the middle of your day. Holy gives you a passage from the Bible each day and a quiet place to read, remember, pray, and return to God’s Word.
Open Holy when you need hope, faith, gratitude, forgiveness, love, or a steady word for a difficult moment. Let one passage guide your attention without turning a brief daily practice into something complicated.
Keep Scripture in your day
• Read the day’s Scripture and find a passage for the moment you are in
• Choose reminders that bring God’s Word back to your attention
• Keep a meaningful verse visible with a Home Screen widget
• Save favorites and revisit passages through search and history
• Write a personal prayer, Scripture note, quote, or Christian affirmation
• Slow down with a focused practice built around one passage
• Choose a calm visual theme and share meaningful Scripture art
Holy is for Christians who want an accessible rhythm of reading Scripture. It helps you return to the Bible during ordinary mornings, busy afternoons, prayer, and the moments when you need to remember what is true.
Begin with one passage. Read it slowly. Carry God’s Word with you.

bluejetty:00136400:ios.description:
تهدف المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية من خلال استراتيجيتها إلى تحقيق سعادة ورضا الجمهور الكريم عن طريق تقديم أفضل الخدمات الالكترونية والارتقاء بمستوى العمل وتسهيل إنجازات المعاملات وأن تتم بسرعة فائقة وجودة عالية ومواكبة التطور التكنولوجي العالمي.
لذا قامت المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية في دولة الكويت بطرح الباقة الأولى من الخدمات الالكترونية في تطبيق الهاتف الذكي 
وصفحة الانترنت ويتوفر بلغتين العربية والانجليزية ، آخذه بعين الاعتبار المحافظة على السرية التامة والخصوصية للمستخدمين. 
سيتم تسجيل الدخول لتلك الخدمات بطريقتين : ارسال رسالة نصية برمز التحقق الى رقم الهاتف المسجل لدى المؤسسة بشكل آمن أو عن طريق ادخال اسم المستخدم وكلمة السر الصادرة من الهيئة العامة للمعلومات المدنية.
من أهم الخدمات : 1) تحديث بيانات الأفراد وهي متاحة لجميع المسجلين لدى المؤسسة (صاحب معاش – مستحق – مؤمن عليه )
 2) المقاصة لاستبدالات أصحاب المعاشات وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
 3) رد الاستبدال وتتم عملية الدفع أون لاين عن طريق الكي نت وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
 4) صرف معاش مقدم وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
 5) طلب صرف 7 صافي المعاش التقاعدي وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
 6) الدفع الالكتروني لصاحب العمل وهي متاحة لجميع أصحاب الأعمال المسجلين لدى المؤسسة.
 7) الدفع الالكتروني للمؤمن عليه باب خامس وهي متاحة لجميع المسجلين كمؤمن عليهم باب خامس لدى المؤسسة. 
من أهم المزايا : 1) خدمة الاشعارات حيث يتم ارسال رسالة نصية الى الهاتف المسجل لدى المؤسسة فور انجاز وتنفيذ الخدمة.
 2) خدمة التعريف بالخدمات يمكن الاستعانة بها لمعرفة طبيعتها.
 3) تحديد مواقع فروع المؤسسة وعناوينها وأرقام تليفوناتها وفي حال تحديد الفرع المطلوب يمكنك الانتقال مباشرة الى خريطة جوجل.
 4) إمكانية طلب المساعدة عن طريق ارسال بريد الكتروني.

listings.name: التأمينات ذخر
listings.description:
تهدف المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية من خلال استراتيجيتها إلى تحقيق سعادة ورضا الجمهور الكريم عن طريق تقديم أفضل الخدمات الالكترونية والارتقاء بمستوى العمل وتسهيل إنجازات المعاملات وأن تتم بسرعة فائقة وجودة عالية ومواكبة التطور التكنولوجي العالمي.
لذا قامت المؤسسة العامة للتأمينات الاجتماعية في دولة الكويت بطرح الباقة الأولى من الخدمات الالكترونية في تطبيق الهاتف الذكي  
وصفحة الانترنت ويتوفر بلغتين العربية والانجليزية ، آخذه بعين الاعتبار المحافظة على السرية التامة والخصوصية للمستخدمين. 
سيتم تسجيل الدخول لتلك الخدمات بطريقتين : ارسال رسالة نصية برمز التحقق الى رقم الهاتف المسجل لدى المؤسسة بشكل آمن أو عن طريق ادخال اسم المستخدم وكلمة السر الصادرة من الهيئة العامة للمعلومات المدنية.
من أهم الخدمات : 1) تحديث بيانات الأفراد وهي متاحة لجميع المسجلين لدى المؤسسة (صاحب معاش – مستحق – مؤمن عليه )
                      2) المقاصة لاستبدالات أصحاب المعاشات وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
                      3) رد الاستبدال وتتم عملية الدفع أون لاين عن طريق الكي نت وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
                      4) صرف معاش مقدم وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
                      5) طلب صرف 7 صافي المعاش التقاعدي وهي متاحة لأصحاب المعاشات.
                      6) الدفع الالكتروني لصاحب العمل وهي متاحة لجميع أصحاب الأعمال المسجلين لدى المؤسسة.
                      7) الدفع الالكتروني للمؤمن عليه باب خامس وهي متاحة لجميع المسجلين كمؤمن عليهم باب خامس لدى المؤسسة. 
من أهم المزايا :   1) خدمة الاشعارات حيث يتم ارسال رسالة نصية الى الهاتف المسجل لدى المؤسسة فور انجاز وتنفيذ الخدمة.
                      2) خدمة التعريف بالخدمات يمكن الاستعانة بها لمعرفة طبيعتها.
                      3) تحديد مواقع فروع المؤسسة وعناوينها وأرقام تليفوناتها وفي حال تحديد الفرع المطلوب يمكنك الانتقال مباشرة الى خريطة جوجل.
                      4) إمكانية طلب المساعدة عن طريق ارسال بريد الكتروني.
                      5) إمكانية تحويل لغة التطبيق بين العربية والانجليزية.

bluejetty:00122964:ios.description:
How to track your expenses successfully? We know that it’s easy. You only need to add each expense you do… no more than that! And Monefy is going to help you. Just add new transactions when you are buying a coffee or taking a taxi. It’s done in one click, because you do not need to fill anything except the expense amount. It has never been so quick and enjoyable!
Do you own a phone and a tablet? Or you want to track expenses together with your significant other? Monefy fits the best. You can safely synchronize data between devices using your own Google Drive or Dropbox account. Create or change records, add new categories or delete old ones and they will be present on another devices right away!
Key features which make tracking enjoyable and powerful:
1. Intuitive and easy to use user interface. No redundancy
2. Add new records extremely fast
3. See your spending distribution on the nice and informative chart or get detailed information from the records list
4. Multi-currency support
5. Manage categories if defaults do not work for you
6. Be safely synchronized using your own Google Drive or Dropbox account
7. Choose the report period
8. Track recurring records easily
9. Passcode protection
10. Multiple accounts support
11. Built-in calculator
MONEFY PREMIUM:
The app offers an auto-renewing Premium Subscription. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Any prices referenced are in US Dollars (USD). Pricing in other currencies and countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

bluejetty:00026679:ios.summary: The COtrip app is the Colorado Department of Transportation's (CDOT) official real-time traffic and traveler information app. The COtrip app provides statewide travel information for Colorado’s interstates, U.S. routes and state highways. I
bluejetty:00026679:ios.description:
The COtrip app is the Colorado Department of Transportation's (CDOT) official real-time traffic and traveler information app. The COtrip app provides statewide travel information for Colorado’s interstates, U.S. routes and state highways. It does not include information for county roads or city streets.
Features:
- Zoomable and mobile-friendly map display
- Traffic speeds and road conditions
- Real-time updates on road maintenance, construction, restrictions and road closures
- Camera images and live streaming video
- Trucker mode with resources specific to commercial motor vehicle operators
- Winter weather conditions (seasonal)
- Plow tracker
- Hands-free, eyes-free feature to announce upcoming road conditions that will impact your route
Please Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease device battery life.
Drop the Distraction
The primary responsibility of every driver is the safe operation of their vehicle. While traveling, mobile communication devices should be used only when the motor vehicle is at a complete stop off the traveled portion of the roadway. Do not text and drive (it's against the law) or use this app while driving. For more information about distracted driving in Colorado and safety tips, visit https://distracted.codot.gov.
Feedback
We welcome your feedback on this app. Please send your suggestions, questions or concerns in an email to cdot_cotrip@state.co.us. For tutorials and more information, visit COtrip.org.
CDOT Privacy Policy: https://codot.gov/topcontent/privacypolicy
