The COtrip app is the Colorado Department of Transportation's (CDOT) official real-time traffic and traveler information app. The COtrip app provides statewide travel information for Colorado’s interstates, U.S. routes and state highways. It does not include information for county roads or city streets.

Features:
- Zoomable and mobile-friendly map display
- Traffic speeds and road conditions
- Real-time updates on road maintenance, construction, restrictions and road closures
- Camera images and live streaming video
- Trucker mode with resources specific to commercial motor vehicle operators
- Winter weather conditions (seasonal)
- Plow tracker
- Hands-free, eyes-free feature to announce upcoming road conditions that will impact your route

Please Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease device battery life.

Drop the Distraction
The primary responsibility of every driver is the safe operation of their vehicle. While traveling, mobile communication devices should be used only when the motor vehicle is at a complete stop off the traveled portion of the roadway. Do not text and drive (it's against the law) or use this app while driving. For more information about distracted driving in Colorado and safety tips, visit https://distracted.codot.gov.

Feedback
We welcome your feedback on this app. Please send your suggestions, questions or concerns in an email to cdot_cotrip@state.co.us. For tutorials and more information, visit COtrip.org.

CDOT Privacy Policy: https://codot.gov/topcontent/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00043894:ios.description:
Understand yourself. Navigate life with clarity.
Why do I keep repeating the same patterns? Why does this connection feel so strong—and so complicated? What is this season of my life teaching me? What is my purpose?
LumiSeer combines astrology, tarot, and AI to help you explore your questions, understand what you’re going through, and move forward with greater clarity. Get personalized insights into your personality, relationships, current life chapter, and the places you could call home.
ASK WHAT’S ON YOUR MIND
You don’t need to know how to read a birth chart or choose a tarot spread. Start with a question about your life.
• Explore love, career, personal growth, and important decisions through AI-powered chat
• Ask follow-up questions to go deeper into what resonates
• Revisit saved conversations and reflect on how your perspective changes over time
UNDERSTAND YOURSELF BEYOND YOUR ZODIAC SIGN
Your full birth chart tells a richer story than your Sun sign alone.
• Explore your emotional needs, strengths, and inner contradictions
• Recognize recurring patterns in how you think, feel, and connect
• Discover insights that help you work with your natural tendencies more intentionally
MAKE SENSE OF THE SEASON YOU’RE IN
Feeling stuck, navigating change, or ready for a new chapter? Explore the astrological themes unfolding in your life.
• Understand how current planetary movements connect with your birth chart
• Explore areas of focus, opportunities, and challenges
• Check in with daily, weekly, and monthly horoscopes
UNDERSTAND YOUR RELATIONSHIP DYNAMICS
A strong connection can still be complicated. Go beyond a compatibility score to explore what happens between you.
• Understand where you connect and where you clash
• Explore attraction, communication styles, and emotional needs
• Reflect on recurring challenges and opportunities for shared growth
• Ask questions about your connection and explore ways to work through differences
DISCOVER PLACES FOR YOUR NEXT CHAPTER
Wondering where you might feel more at home—or find a fresh start? Explore your possibilities with astrocartography.
• Discover cities aligned with themes of love, career, belonging, and personal growth
• Add a city to explore what living or spending time there could mean for you
• Explore your relocation chart for a deeper look at each location
FIND A FRESH PERSPECTIVE WITH TAROT
When you’re caught in the same thoughts, a different perspective can help.
• Explore tarot spreads for love, career, money, and personal growth
• Receive card interpretations connected to your question
• Learn tarot meanings and symbolism as you explore
• Make space for reflection with daily card insights
Whether you’re trying to understand a relationship, navigate a transition, or get to know yourself more deeply, LumiSeer gives you a place to ask, reflect, and explore your next step.
LumiSeer by HiVi. Previously AngelClaim.

A paid subscription is required to access premium features.
Terms: https://lumiseer.com/terms

bluejetty:00186934:ios.name: Amazing Mole Hole Tap!
bluejetty:00186934:ios.summary: Amazing Mole Hole Tap! is a fun and challenging mobile game based on the classic "Whack a Mole" concept. This game not only captures your attention but also keeps you and your kids entertained for hours! The objective is to quickly tap the
bluejetty:00186934:ios.description:
Amazing Mole Hole Tap! is a fun and challenging mobile game based on the classic "Whack a Mole" concept. This game not only captures your attention but also keeps you and your kids entertained for hours! The objective is to quickly tap the moles as they pop out of their holes while avoiding the rabbits to earn special coins.
Game Features:
Variety of Moles: The game features 7 different types of moles, each with unique appearances and behaviors. These moles appear at varying speeds and frequencies, keeping players on their toes.
Multiple Difficulty Levels: With 27 levels ranging from easy to hell mode, the game caters to players of all skill levels. As you progress, the difficulty increases, challenging your reaction time and hand-eye coordination.
Special Rewards: Avoiding tapping on rabbits earns you special coins, which can be used to unlock more game content or purchase items, adding to the game's fun and challenge.
Simple and Intuitive Controls: The game's controls are straightforward, requiring only taps on the screen. This makes it accessible to players of all ages, especially those new to mobile gaming.
Gameplay:
Players must tap the moles as soon as they pop out of their holes to score points. As the game advances, the moles appear faster, testing the player's reflexes and coordination. Rabbits also appear, and tapping them results in losing points or special coins, adding an extra layer of challenge.
Target Audience:
Amazing Mole Hole Tap! is suitable for players of all ages, particularly those who enjoy casual games and challenging their reaction speeds. Whether you're an adult or a child, this game offers endless entertainment. Parents can play with their kids, enhancing family bonding while also helping children improve their reaction times and hand-eye coordination.

Not like classic tile puzzle & mahjong games, 'Match Me! 3D' not only connects your brain to logical thinking but also is a free & fun matching puzzle game which is easy for everyone to play.

bluejetty:00100031:ios.description:
Find, review, and book a table at Japan’s best local restaurants, before you go or while you travel.
Tabelog is Japan’s leading restaurant search, food review, and table reservation app, trusted by locals and travelers alike. With over 800,000 restaurants nationwide and more than 82 million authentic food ratings and reviews, it’s the easiest way to discover where to eat in Japan with confidence.
Whether you’re planning a trip, on a solo travel adventure, or simply looking for cheap food at a dinner spot nearby, Tabelog helps you find the right restaurant for every moment. From sushi, yakiniku, ramen, and izakaya to cafes, desserts, and international dining, explore options loved by locals across Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and beyond.
Use Tabelog as your travel guide and food planner to search restaurants near you or anywhere in Japan. Check the menu, detailed food reviews, photos, and food tips from real diners, compare food ratings, and book a table instantly when seats are available.
Planning to visit Japan from the US? Tabelog makes dining simple for American travelers with these top features:
・Search popular lunch or dinner spots near your location, or anywhere in the country
・Discover neighborhood ramen, restaurants and cafes loved by locals.
・Book a table or make a table reservation with real-time availability
・Find restaurants with multilingual menus and cashless payment options
・Save favorite places for later. and plan your trip with ease
・Restaurant recommendations for dates, family trips, solo-dining and group outings
・Check for multilingual menus and cashless payment support before your visit.
SIX reasons to choose Tabelog:
1. Over 800,000 restaurants across Japan -- Not just Tokyo and Kyoto! 
2. 82+ million reliable food reviews and ratings from real diners
3. 3 million registered reviewers nationwide, posting photos and reviews daily 
4. Map-based restaurant finder makes navigation easy 
5. Online reservations with real-time seat availability 
6. Personal lists to save and plan your dining itinerary
*Restaurant data as of May 2024, based on internal research.
From travel meal planning to searching for cheap food nearby, Tabelog is your go-to app for dining, food discovery, local restaurant reservations, and unforgettable experiences when you go to Japan.
Privacy Policy: https://tabelog.com/en/help/privacypolicy 
Terms of Use: https://tabelog.com/en/help/rules
https://tabelog.com/en/help/reservation_rules 
[Recommended Operating Environment]
We recommend using the Tabelog app under the following operating environment. The app may not function properly or may not be installable on versions outside the recommended environment. Please update to the recommended OS version for the best experience.
Recommended OS: iOS 18.0 or later
*For any issues related to app operation or installation via the App Store, please contact Apple Inc. directly.
*iPhone and App Store are trademarks or registered trademarks of Apple Inc. in the U.S. and other countries.

-Transfer money between your accounts

-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the First Community Bank app, you must be enrolled as a First Community Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.
